rows.what: [Worklist 218, line 2](/worklist/), finished. [The morning's row declared twenty-five frames of a hundred and thirty-nine](/searched/); the rest were read the same day.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ NINE GRAH HOUSEHOLDS.**

| | |
|---|---|
| **18** | *four generations —* **Mathias** *(n. 1837)* → **Matthaeus** *(n. 1863)* → **Antonius** *(n. 1900)* → *after* |
| **19** | «**Grah Martinus**, *viduus*», *n.* **28 Oct 1827** |
| **23** | «**Grah Joannes def. Josephi**», *n.* **5 Sept 1852**, *twelve children; son* **Josephus** *n.* **1900** |
| **38** | ***two*** — *a* **sutor** *(n. 1869) and an* **agricola** *(n. 1867) whose wife is* «**Rosa n. ŠESTAN**» |
| **53** | *a* **ferroviarius**, *second wife* «**e SVETVINČENAT**» |
| *Croatian half* | «**Grah Ana**» · «**Grah Antun**», *radnik* · «**Grah Jelena**» |

*Plus* ***eight daughters married out*** *— Držetić, Dujanić, Šepuka, Opašić, a struck Krošnjak, and* **Lušetić** *twice — and a son of the house entered* «***svećenik***», ***a priest***. ⚠ *[The living are named and nothing more.](/method/)*

**⭐⭐ A DAUGHTER FOLLOWED ACROSS THE BOOK.** *House 18 enters* «**Roža**», *n.* **13.VI.1909**; *the Lušetić household of house 25 enters* «***Grach Rosa fil. Matthaei***», *n.* **13.6.1909**. ***Same day, same father, two houses apart*** — *a* status animarum *doing what a parish register cannot.*

**✔✔ AND THE ANNOTATOR SETTLES THE NAME HIMSELF:** «***Gracco ver. Grah***», *in pencil above the heading.* ***Four forms now — Grah · Grach · Grah-Mišan · Gracco*** *— and [a search under any one misses the others](/married-in/grach/).*

⚠ **One correction**: *[the house-18 wife published this morning as* «Rosaria n. **Rogar**» *is* «**Ruža r. FLEGAR**»](/corrections/), *from the same household written out again in the Croatian sequence.* ***Flegar is one of the commonest surnames in the Gologorica registers.***

---

**✔✔✔ AND A CONTROLLED NIL THAT IS WORTH AS MUCH AS THE HITS.**

***No Defranceschi appears on any of the 138 frames.*** *Cerovlje is four kilometres from Gologorica; [one priest served both parishes for ten years from 1913](/gologorica-line/#cerovljegrah); its* «Profectus» *column shows people moving between the two throughout.* **The family was not there** — *and that is now a measured fact rather than an absence of looking.*

⚠ *A third loose inter-parish document was found on the way:* «Ex libr. IV **Draguć** fol. 48», *stamped and signed at Draguć,* **5 February 1959**, *lying across M01068850 and lifted for M01068851.* ***On these reels a repeated opening is a document until proved otherwise.***

rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE GRAH ARE HERE, THREE HOUSEHOLDS DEEP.**

> **18** · «***GRAH Mathias def. Mathiae***», *rusticus*, *n.* **15 Aug 1837**, *ob.* **10 Sept 1929** · «**Maria n. KROŠNJAK**» · *and his son* «***Grah Matthaeus***», *n.* **21 Nov 1863**, *ob.* **26 Oct 1940**, *with* «**Maria n. GRŽEVIĆ**» *and nine children*

***Four generations in house 18***, *from a man born in 1837 to children born in the 1960s.* *Also* **house 19** *(«Grah Martinus, viduus», n.* **28 Oct 1827***)* *and* **house 23** *(«Grah Joannes def. Josephi», n.* **5 Sept 1852***), and three daughters married out into* **Držetić**, **Dujanić** *and* **Šepuka**. ⚠ *[The living are named and nothing more.](/method/)*

**⚠⚠ AND THREE FORMS OF THE NAME.** «**Grah**» *(the ink)* · «**Grah-Mišan**» *(the compound — [confirming this very item's guess that* «Grah · Missan» *was a byname](/worklist/))* · «**Gracco**» *(a faint later* ***pencil*** *above at least four headings, the Italianised form).* ***A search under any one of the three misses the other two.***

---

**⭐⭐ AND A CLERGY LIST, IN A CENSUS BOOK.** «***Series curatorum in Cerovlje ab 9. novembris 1871***» — *fifteen incumbents to 1979, each with his start, end and tenure to the day.* **Four served** «excurrendo» *from elsewhere, and the list names where:* «e Novaco» *three times and, for* **Ludovicus Žváček** *(24 Oct 1913–1923),* «***e GOLOGORICA***». ***Ten years in which one priest served both parishes.***

**✔ THREE CORRECTIONS TO THE FRAME MAP:** *(1) the item is* ***not one book*** *— its pages run to* **292** *and restart at* **1**, *and [the turn is visible on M01068876 where* «292» *is struck and renumbered* «2»]; *(2) the cover says* «**Cerovlje – PREVIŽ**» *where the film's card says only Cerovlje; (3) the* «Profectus in Religione» *column is being used for* ***origins*** — «e Novaco», «e Draguć», *and* «**e Gologorica**» *repeatedly — ***the Cerovlje twin of the 1826 census's* «Locus ex quo vel ad quem», *and unharvested***.

---

⚠⚠ **WHAT WAS NOT DONE, PRECISELY.** *Twenty-five frames of a hundred and thirty-nine.* **M01068802–M01068911 is unread** — *the rest of sequence 1, the whole* **Previž** *run and the whole of sequence 2.* *The book has* ***no index***: *the apparent alphabetical run at its back is not one.* ***No Defranceschi appears in what was read, and that is a nil for a sixth of the book, not for the book.***

**⭐⭐⭐ A GRAH HOUSEHOLD, AT HOUSE 174.**

| | | the child | who stood for it |
|---|---|---|---|
| **13 May 1785** | *191* | **Lucia** | *two* **Picot**, *one* «Giudice» · ***Cives*** |
| **25 Jan 1790** | *198* | **Francisca** | ***Joannes Jerbulla SUPANUS*** *&* ***Notburga Jerbulla JUDICISSA*** |

*And* ***five further appearances as godparents*** *— 30 May 1792, 8 Mar 1793, 5 Mar 1794, 20 Jun 1795, 21 Jun 1796.* ***Ten appearances in eleven years, graded* «Cives» *every time.*** *Plus* «**Anna Zulle olim GRAH**» *(1787, house 46), a daughter married out.*

---

**⭐⭐⭐ AND THE KEY ENTRY WAS ALREADY ON THIS ARCHIVE'S SHELF.**

*8 May 1802 puts* ***Joannes Salamon*** *and* ***Theresia Defranceschi*** *as godparents to a* ***Grah*** *child.* ⚠ *[The archive's Gračišće* conditio *table already cites that frame](/gologorica-line/) — «Theresia w/ Joannes Salamon · Cives · 218» — **because it swept the Patrini column for one surname and never read the Pater column beside it.** [Reading one column is not reading the book](/method/), turned round on the archive.*

---

**⚠ TWO TRAPS, BOTH NAMED.** «**Cinrich**» *reads as* «Grah» *at page scale in this hand and is a different family — rejected twice at magnification (M01070196, M01070199) and recurring on M01070222 and M01070224. And the same household is once written* «**Prach**» *(M01070202), tested against this scribe's own* **P** *and* **G** *at one magnification and* ***left as written***.

**⚠ NOT ESTABLISHED, and not claimed:** *any link between these Gračišće Grah and [Theresia née Grah](/person/theresia-defranceschi-nee-grach-gologorica/) or [the archpriest of Krbune](/married-in/grach/), both* «ex Parochia **Cherbune**».

**NAMED NIL** *for the surname on* **M01070190, 192, 194, 195, 196, 197, 199, 201, 203, 206, 207, 210–217, 219–226** *— every column of every opening.*

rows.what: [Worklist 223](/worklist/): two roster rows for a Josephus Defranceschi of Gologorica, one carrying a pedigree's **1722–1782** with all the archive's documents on it, one carrying MyHeritage's **1723–1787** with none — and [a death register that buries the documented man at the end of 1787, aged sixty-four](/gologorica-line/#mercatordeath1787). The way to settle it is to read the year the first row claims.
rows.got:
**✔✔ NIL, AND EVERY NAME IS GIVEN.** *Nine men and boys died at Gologorica in* **1782** *and the register names them all:*

| house | | |
|---|---|---|
| **55** | 25 Jan | ***Marcus Bancich***, *the archpriest, 77* |
| **61** | 12 May | **Franciscus Ignatius**, *42 days,* **Deprato** |
| **15** | 22 Jul | **Jacobus Cinich**, *one year* |
| **92** | 19 Aug | **Georgius Stojsich dictus Dobardan**, *57* |
| **103** | 7 Sep | **Matthæus Ancich**, *16 days* |
| **61** | 15 Sep | **Joannes**, *26, servant of* **Leonardus Deprato** |
| **109** | 30 Sep | **Josephus Flegar sive Giacotich**, *36y 6m* |
| **19** | 13 Nov | **Joannes Udovcich Gospod**, *five* |
| **83** | 22 Dec | **Marinus Crismanich**, *52, suddenly* |

***Not one Defranceschi.*** **The parish buried no man of this surname in 1782**, *and [the obit calendar never produced him either — this archive's own table lists* «Josephus · 1782 · a family tree» *among the six it could date no other way](/gologorica-line/#calendarindex).*

---

**✔✔ SO THE ADJUDICATION IS MADE: ONE MAN.**

*One Josephus Defranceschi is documented here — [the merchant of house 36, husband of Helena, father of five, dead at four in the morning at the end of 1787 aged 64](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/).* ***One row has his documents and the wrong years; the other has his years and no documents.*** *No book read by this archive names two living men of the name.*

**[`guiseppe-josephus-josip-defranceschi-1723` is marked `sameAs: josephus-defranceschi-1722`.](/gologorica-line/#josephusadjudicated)** *Neither id moves.*

⚠ **And a note against the archive rather than the registers.** *The identity question was real and needed this nil.* ***The mechanism was not a question*** — *[thirty rows already carry* `sameAs`, *and this archive wrote that lesson down on 5 October](/corrections/) after a session escalated a settled shape. ***This one was escalated to a worklist item for half a day.***

⚠ **Left open, and only this:** *the* **birth** *year —* **1722** *declared,* **c. 1723** *implied by the age,* **1723** *on the joined row.* ***A baptism entry would end it; nothing else will.***

The row that keeps the documented man

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Obijt JOSEPHUS DE FRANCESCHJ, MERCATOR, ætatis suæ annorum 64»: worklist 221 answered the day it opened, and the trade proved twice

rows.what: [Worklist 221, opened an hour earlier](/worklist/): «Josephus Defranceschi cannot be dead in 1783 and have a living wife in 1787 — settle it in the death registers.»
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ IT IS SETTLED, AT THE FOOT OF THE 1787 PAGE.**

> **36** · «*Die* **30**, *hora* ***4.ᵗᵃ Matutina***, *anno quo supra* [**1787**] · *Obijt* ***JOSEPHUS DE FRANCESCHJ, MERCATOR, ætatis suæ annorum 64***. *Provisus in sua infirmitate omnibus Sacramentis necessariis a* **R.ᵈᵒ D.ⁿᵒ Can.ᶜᵒ Joanne Martinich**. *Cujus corpus* **31** *dicti sepultum est in Cœmeterio extra Locum, per* **R.ᵐᵘᵐ D.ⁿᵘᵐ Parocum ANICICH Novacci**.»

***There was never a contradiction.*** *He was alive in April 1783, alive in December 1783, alive when [his wife stood at a font on 4 October 1787](/person/helena-defranceschi-1725/) — and dead seven weeks later.* **[The obit calendar's «q.» was a copyist's word](/corrections/), and [the flag this archive left on «jugalium» on 10 October is discharged in the register's favour](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/).**

**✔✔ AND THE TRADE IS PROVED A SECOND TIME.** *[This morning* «MERCATORIS» *was published from one baptism and flagged](/gologorica-line/#mercator1779):* «⚠ One construction. [The standing rule wants a second](/method/).» ***His own burial supplies it*** — *another volume, another hand, eight years on.*

**⚠⚠ AND IT CORRECTS TWO NUMBERS THE ARCHIVE HAS CARRIED FOR A YEAR:** *died* **1782** → ***end of 1787***; *born* **1722** → *aged 64, so* ***about 1723***. *[The death year is changed and declared; the birth stays, with the register's figure beside it](/corrections/).*

⚠⚠ *And [an undocumented tree row carries exactly those figures](/person/guiseppe-josephus-josip-defranceschi-1723/).* ***No merge is made; [the adjudication is on the worklist](/worklist/).***

---

**⚠ TWO STRUCTURAL FINDINGS ALONG THE WAY.**

*(1)* ***A death in this book can be entered TWICE.*** *[Margaretta's burial of April 1783 is on* **M01068991** *as published](/gologorica-line/#margaretta1783) — **and again on M01068982**, same house number, same scribe, wording not identical.* *(2)* ***The sex split is real but leaky***: *M01068982 is otherwise all male and M01068991 otherwise all female, yet each carries one stray of the other sex.* **A nil from one sequence is not a nil even for that sex, and adding the two sequences double-counts.**

⚠ *The entry names no month of its own. The entry above is* **15 Novembris** *and the burial is* «**31** dicti», *which no November has — so* **30 November with a slip, or 30 December under an omitted heading**. *The year and the day are certain; the month is left open.*
ev: The death entry, the trade proved twice, and what it unmakes
The row, corrected by five years
The duplicate row left to a deliberate adjudication

**✔ THE BOOK'S STRUCTURE, WHICH IS NOT ONE BOOK.**

| frames | |
|---|---|
| **915** | *the film's title card —* «MATIČNA KNJIGA ROĐENIH **1764-1788** · SIGNATURA **3.2**» |
| **916** | *a resolution target* |

⚠⚠ ***From 1782 this is two registers bound as one.*** *[The same split as the death book, and the one this archive once failed to carry across at the cost of a reversed descent](/method/).* **A count from M01068942–947 is a count of the boys.**

---

**⭐ WHAT THE BOOK GAVE IN ONE DAY:** *[a župan with a title and four constructions of his name](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-supanus-d-by-1764/) · [a new child, August 1787](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1787/) · [two baptisms for rows that had none](/person/petrus-defranceschi-1768/) · [a trade,* «MERCATOR»](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/) *· [a canonry attested five times](/gologorica-line/#mercator1779) · [a parish handover narrated inside the register](/gologorica-line/#canonicusetparochus) · [an origin stated,* «Buccarensis»](/person/catharina-defranceschi-jablich-gologorica/) *· [a correction raised and resolved the same day](/corrections/) · [two standing warnings](/method/).*

---

**⚠ AND WHY `walked` IS STILL FALSE.** *Every frame was read entry by entry — every date, every set of parents, every godparent clause, every officiant — and every Defranceschi magnified before transcription.* ***But the non-Defranceschi entries were read, not transcribed***, *and this log could not answer a question about the fourth godmother on M01068937 without going back to the frame.*

> ***A book read for its parties is not a book transcribed, and only the second is a walk.***

**The book is finished for the surname**: *no frame unexamined, no opening unread, the one obscured frame a duplicate of a clear one, and the sex split followed rather than fallen into.*

rows.got:
**⭐⭐ A FOURTH CHILD, AND THE TRADE WRITTEN DOWN A THIRD TIME.**

> **35 · Die 12. Augusti 1787** · «*natum ex* ***Joanne Baptista et Teresia DEFRANCESCHJ***, *conjugibus hujus Parochiæ,* ***professione TEXTOR***. *Cui nomen impositum est* ***Joannes Bapta***.»

*[This archive began the week believing house 45 produced one child in eleven years.](/searched/)* ***The couple married in 1774 now have four***: *[Josepha Mariana 1776](/person/mariana-defranceschi-d1786/), [Joannes Petrus 1780](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-1780/), [Franciscus Antonius 1785](/person/franciscus-antonius-defranceschi-1785/), Joannes Baptista 1787.*

*And the weaving runs three documents deep —* **1773** «TEXTOR EX CARNIA» *at the father's burial,* **1774** «professionis suæ Textor» *at the son's marriage,* **1787** «professione Textor» *here.* ⚠ *The house is* **31** *in 1785 and* **35** *here; recorded, not resolved.*

---

**⚠⚠ AND A CONTRADICTION THE ARCHIVE CANNOT SHRUG OFF.**

> **65 · 4 Octobris 1787** · «*Patrini fuerunt* **viduus Antonius Bovis ex Petina**, *et* ***HELLENA UXOR Josephi de Franceschi***»

***Uxor, not vidua — and the scribe writes* «viduus» *in the same clause where he means it.***

| | |
|---|---|
| **18 Dec 1769** | *Helena is the mother of [Josephus's son](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/)* |
| **30 Mar 1782** | *[Margarita](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/) is that son's sister* |
| **22 Apr 1783** | *the obit calendar makes their father* «**q.**» |
| **16 Dec 1783** | *a* «**Dominus Josephus Defranceschi**» *stands godfather* |
| **4 Oct 1787** | «***Hellena uxor Josephi***» |

***A man cannot be dead in April 1783 and have a living wife in October 1787.*** *[The weakest document is the obit calendar — a copy of about 1800, already caught two days out on Margarita's own date](/corrections/).* ⚠ **No row is changed, merged or re-dated.** *[Worklist 221 opened: find a contemporary death entry, or record a named nil for 1782–1788.](/worklist/)*
ev: The fourth child, the trade, and the contradiction

rows.src: ⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — 1784–1788 is registered TWICE: the same baptisms in Liber II and Liber IV, and neither copy is complete
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II.ᵈᵘˢ … ab anno 1764» (signatura 3.2), M01068944
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm, read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.pages: M01068944, both halves, read entry by entry — the male sequence, June 1784 to April 1785.
rows.what: Continuing the end-to-end sweep. [Liber IV opens in 1784 and Liber II runs to 1788](/gologorica-line/#bookseries); this archive had treated that as a tidy succession.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ IT IS NOT A SUCCESSION. FOR FIVE YEARS THE PARISH KEPT BOTH BOOKS.**

*Both of 1785's Defranceschi baptisms, [already on the roster from Liber IV](/person/josephus-antonius-defranceschi-1785/), are entered again here —* ***and the two registrations do not carry the same facts.***

| | **Liber IV** | **Liber II** |
|---|---|---|
| *name* | «Josephi **Anton**» | «Josephus» |
| *house* | **36** | — |
| ***born*** | — | ***5 January 1785*** |
| ***officiant*** | — | ***Carolus Covaz, Canon of ANTIGNANA*** |
| *midwife* | **Maria Chrismanich** | — |

***Anyone working 1784–1788 at Gologorica who reads one book has read half.*** *And the officiant is known: [**Carolus Covaz** buried **Joannes Petrus Defranceschi** in 1781](/person/pietro-defranceschi-1695/); here he christens the next generation, and the entry gives his seat.*

**⭐ The second child's entry separates the wives.** *13 April 1785:* «*natum ex* **Joanne Bapta Defranceschj ejusque uxore TERESIA** *… Patrini fuere* **Archipresbiter GRAH** *et* ***CATTARINA UXOR JOANNIS BAPTA DEFRANCESCHJ***». *[Liber IV says only* «Catharina Defranceschi»](/person/franciscus-antonius-defranceschi-1785/).* ***Theresia bore him; Catharina stood for him.*** **✔ And both books say house 31.**

---

**✔✔ AND A FLAG RAISED AN HOUR AGO COMES DOWN.**

*[The Holy Saturday entry of 1782 was published with a warning](/gologorica-line/#canonicusetparochus): its margin seemed to read* «**31**» *while its parents are* **Deprato**. *One of the four readings offered was that the numeral is not 31.* ***It is not.*** *Against this same priest's* **31** *of April 1785 at one magnification, his* **3** *is open and angular; the 1782 figure is a* ***closed loop***. *(The second figure, a dotted upright, matches — this hand writes* **1** *as a dotted* j.*)* **No Deprato household is placed in the Defranceschi door**; **61** *and* **81** *are the readings worth testing.*
ev: Two registers, one child, two sets of facts

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II» restarts in 1782 SPLIT BY SEX: «Catharina … nata Sablich BUCCARENSIS», and two men with one patronymic and two surnames
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II.ᵈᵘˢ … ab anno 1764» (signatura 3.2), M01068942 and M01068943
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm, read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.pages: M01068942 and M01068943, both halves, read entry by entry — the 1782 restart and the male sequence to May 1784.
rows.what: Continuing the end-to-end sweep, forward from [the handover frame](/searched/).
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ FIRST, A STRUCTURAL WARNING FOR ANYONE WHO COMES TO THIS BOOK.** *M01068942 is a fresh heading in the new parish priest's hand:*

> «**1782** · ***Masculi baptizati sub Parocho JOANNE MATHIA FRANCESCHJ***»

***From 1782 this register splits by sex***, *exactly as [the death book does and as this archive once failed to carry across](/method/). Everything from M01068942 on is the* ***male*** *sequence, and every entry carries a house number in the margin.* **A count taken from these frames is a count of the boys.**

---

**⭐⭐⭐ AND THEN THE ENTRY THE WEEK HAS BEEN WORKING TOWARDS.**

> **16 Decembris 1783** · «*Patrini fuere* **Dominus Josephus Defranceschi**, *et* ***Domina CATHARINA DEFRANCESCHI nata SABLICH BUCCARENSIS***»

*[Her earliest appearance was 3 October 1786](/person/catharina-defranceschi-jablich-gologorica/).* ***This is three years earlier***, *she is* «Domina», *and her origin is one Latin word.*

**✔ And the hand is tested inside its own paragraph.** *The chaplain* **Joannes Florcich** *writes his* **J** *three times —* «Ego **Joannes** Florcich», «**Joanne** Baptista», «**Joannes** Eusebius» *— and every one drops a long descender. The surname's initial has none.* ***This scribe writes «Sablich».*** ⚠ *It does not overturn [the 1786* «Jablich»](/gologorica-line/#twojb1786), *proved the same way:* ***both spellings are native to this parish, in different hands, three years apart.***

---

**⚠⚠ AND THE WORST TRAP THIS VILLAGE HAS SET.**

> **5 Feb 1783** · «***Joannes Baptista DEPRATO, Leonardi filius***» *(M01068943)*
> **29 Oct 1773** · «***Joannes Baptista DEFRANCESCHI q.ᵐ Leonardi***» *(M01068932)*

***Same forename pair, same patronymic, same village, same decade, two surnames, both godparents in one book.*** *[A new method row, and the existing* «the patronymic is the only thing worth trusting» *row has been qualified in place](/method/) — it separates men of* ***one*** *surname, not two.*

---

**⭐ Three more women named.** *[**Theresia Defranceschi NATA GRACH**](/person/theresia-defranceschi-nee-grach-gologorica/), 16 Jan 1784 — her maiden surname in a baptism register ten years after the wedding. [**Domina Hellena Defranceschi**](/person/helena-defranceschi-1725/), 21 May 1784, alive. And Catharina above.*

⚠⚠ *And a* «**Dominus Josephus Defranceschi**» *standing godfather on* **16 December 1783** — *[eight months after the man this archive calls Margarita's father is entered* «q.»](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/). **No row changed; the strain is recorded.**
ev: «Buccarensis», the S/J test and the two Leonardi sons

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Ego JOANNES MATHIAS FRANCESCHI, CANONICUS et PAROCHUS Gollogoritiæ»: the register narrates its own handover, and answers this morning's correction
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II.ᵈᵘˢ … ab anno 1764» (signatura 3.2), M01068941
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm, read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.pages: M01068941, both halves, read entry by entry — July 1781 to May 1782, straddling the change of parish priest.
rows.what: Continuing the end-to-end sweep. [Four hours earlier this archive withdrew a ladder](/corrections/) and left a question open in as many words: «One man or two is no longer asserted.»
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE NEXT FRAME ANSWERS IT, IN ONE PHRASE, IN HIS OWN HAND.**

> **24 Februarij 1782** · «*Ego* ***JOANNES MATHIAS FRANCESCHI, CANONICUS et PAROCHUS GOLLOGORITIÆ***, *baptizavi filium infantem natum ex* **Giorgio et Mathia Coscoli sive Uglessich**…»

***Canonicus ET Parochus. One man.*** *[The withdrawal stands — the ladder had no canonry in it and left fourteen blank years — but the question it opened is closed.](/corrections/)*

---

**⭐⭐⭐ AND THE HANDOVER IS NARRATED, WITH ITS CAUSE, INSIDE THE REGISTER.**

| | |
|---|---|
| **8 Nov 1781** | «**R.ᵈᵘˢ D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Mathias Defranceschi** *… baptizavit*» *(Bancich's hand)* |
| **26 Dec 1781** | «*baptizatus fuit* ***à me, Mathia de Franceschi Can.ᶜᵒ***» |
| **10 Jan 1782** | «*Ego Mathias de Franceschi, Canonicus Ecclesiæ Cathedralis Petinensis … (:* ***cujus Parochus infirmus est***, *D.ⁿᵘˢ presbiter* **Marcus Bancich** *:)*» |
| **20 Jan 1782** | «***Infirmo D.ⁿᵒ Parocho hujus Loci Gollogoritiæ***…» |
| **25 Jan 1782** | *[**Bancich dies**](/gologorica-line/#bancich1782)* |
| **24 Feb 1782** | «***Canonicus et Parochus Gollogoritiæ***» |

***Not a handover inferred from a gap between two books — one written down by the man who took the cure, while it happened.***

**⭐⭐ And the book changes shape with him.** *From* **8 November 1781** ***every entry carries a house number***. **Marcus Bancich numbered none in eighteen years of this register**, *and [the numbering this archive has chased through two books](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770) arrives here, all at once, with the new man.*

---

**⭐ Margarita alive**, *30 March 1782:* «*Patrini fuerunt* ***Joannes Baptista filius Josephi de Franceschi*** *et* ***Margarita ejusdem filia***». *[Her row had her death and nothing of her life](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/) — this is* ***a year and three weeks before it***.

⚠⚠ **And one problem recorded, not solved.** *That entry's margin reads* «**Sub N.ᵒ 31. Domus**» *and its parents are* «**Joanne Baptista et Cattarina DEPRATO**» — *while [this archive has identified casa 31 as the* «detti Leonardi» *Defranceschi house](/person/mariana-defranceschi-d1786/) from the 1786 death index.* ***Shared door, changed hands, an index number that is not a door, or a numeral misread at six times*** *— [nothing is decided, and the 45→31 renumbering is still open](/worklist/).*
ev: The handover, narrated by the man who took it
The correction, resolved the same day
Canon and parish priest, one man

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II» 1776–1780: «Josephi Defranceschi MERCATORIS», the canon four more times, and five rows gain dated life
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II.ᵈᵘˢ … ab anno 1764» (signatura 3.2), M01068936–M01068939
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm, read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.pages: M01068936, M01068937, M01068938 and M01068939, both halves of each opening, read entry by entry — about sixty baptisms, May 1776 – May 1780.
rows.what: Continuing the end-to-end sweep of this book, forward from [the 1775–1776 frames](/searched/).
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ A TRADE FOR THE MAN WHOSE ROW BEGAN THE WEEK AS ONE WORD.**

> **10 Februarij 1779** · «*patrini fuerunt* **Vitus Pavelich**, *et* ***Helena uxor D.ⁿⁱ Josephi Defranceschi MERCATORIS*** *ex hac Parochia*»

***Mercator — a merchant.*** *The entry is precise: the child's own father is* «**Joannis Sherbaz FABRI**», *a smith, in the same line. [It accounts for the* «Dominus», *the archpriest fetched from Cerovlje, the Pazin godparents and the* «civilitas» *of 1826](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/).*

**⭐⭐ AND THE CARNIA TIE IS A TRADE NETWORK.** *1773* «**Leonardus Defranceschi, TEXTOR EX CARNIA**» *· 1774 his son* «**Textor**» *· 1775* «**Joannes Verzin ex Carnia, professionis suæ SARTOR**» *· 1779* «**Josephus Defranceschi MERCATOR**». ***Weaver, weaver, tailor, merchant*** — *[the migration the Zagreb account describes, written into one village's baptisms](/gologorica-line/#mercator1779).* ⚠ *No kinship claimed for Verzin;* «mercator» *is one construction and [a second is wanted](/method/).*

---

**⭐⭐ THE CANON, FOUR MORE TIMES. THE BAXA FLAG IS FINISHED.**

*31 Aug **1774** · 7 Mar **1775** · 3 Mar **1777** · 5 Aug **1777** · 14 Feb **1778** — [five entries, one scribe, the title written out every time](/gologorica-line/#mercator1779), twice with* **Bancich** *naming himself in the first person as the man granting leave. [The 1781 reading is no longer the only witness.](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-1780/)* ⚠ *[Whether this canon and the Parochus of 1782–88 are one man is still not asserted.](/corrections/)*

---

**✔ FIVE ROWS GAIN DATED LIFE.**

| | |
|---|---|
| **[Theresia née Grah](/person/theresia-defranceschi-nee-grach-gologorica/)** | *godmother* **four times** *— 1777 ×2, 1779 ×2 — twice beside her husband, named* «q.ᵐ Leonardi» *in the same clause* |
| **[Antonius Defranceschi](/person/antonius-defranceschi-1742/)** | *two appearances* ***in life*** *(14 Jan, 27 May 1780); he had only a death entry* |
| **[Marianna](/person/marianna-defranceschi-fl-1780/)** | *back ten months, to* **24 Sep 1779** |
| **[Rosalia](/person/rosalia-defranceschi-gologorica/)** | *1775 and 1776 added to 1769 and 1772* |
| **[Joannes Grah of Krbune](/married-in/grach/)** | *baptising at Gologorica himself,* **9 Aug 1778** |
ev: The merchant, the trade network and the canon
«MERCATORIS» — the row that was one word

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II» 1775–1776: a girl who died at ten gets her baptism, her parents and a forename — born in the NEXT PARISH
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II.ᵈᵘˢ … ab anno 1764» (signatura 3.2), M01068933 and M01068934

rows.pages: M01068933 and M01068934, both halves of each opening, read entry by entry — about thirty baptisms, 27 April 1774 – 15 April 1776, plus a visitation note of 10 July 1775.
rows.what: Continuing the end-to-end sweep of this book, forward from [the 1772–1774 frames](/searched/).
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ A ROW THAT CARRIED ONE DEATH AND AN EXPLICIT REFUSAL NOW HAS A BAPTISM.**

> **15.ᵃ Martij 1776** · «***Josepha Mariana [Defranceschi]*** *filia legitima* ***Joannis Baptistæ*** *ejusque uxoris* ***Theresiæ***, ***nata et baptizata ad Cherbunam*** *per R.ᵈᵘᵐ D.ⁿᵘᵐ* **Joannem Jadreicich, Capellanum Cherbunensem**, *de licentia … Archipresbyteri* ***Joannis GRAH***; *patrini fuerunt* **Joannes Baptista Defranceschi**, *et* **Rosalia Defranceschi, filia D.ⁿⁱ Josephi Defranceschi**.»

*[Her row said:* «⚠ **No parents are attached. The index gives the household, not a father, and this archive does not turn a filing decision into a descent.**»](/person/mariana-defranceschi-d1786/) ***The baptism supplies the father, the mother, a first forename — Josepha — and a birthplace.*** *Baptised* **15 March 1776**, *dead* **4 Oct 1786** *at* «annorum 10» — ***ten years, six months, twenty days***.

**⭐⭐ AND IT SHOWS WHY THE VILLAGE'S OWN SWEEPS LOST HER.** «Nata et baptizata ad **Cherbunam**» *— [Krbune](/married-in/), her mother's parish. The Gologorica entry records an event elsewhere and carries no* «Ex Domo sub Numero», ***so [the house-number sweep of 9 October could not see her](/searched/)***. *That row has been qualified in place rather than left standing.*

**⭐ Joannes Grah a fifth time**, *and a man new to this archive:* «**Joannes Jadreicich, Capellanus Cherbunensis**». *A month later* «**Michaelis GRAH**» *is christening a son at Gologorica itself, with a Defranceschi godfather (15 April 1776).* ⚠ *No kinship to Theresia claimed.*

---

**⭐⭐ AND A SECOND MAN OUT OF CARNIA, IN A TRADE.**

> **7 Martij 1775** · «*baptizata est* ***ab Adm. R.ᵈᵒ D.ⁿᵒ CANONICO MATHIA DEFRANCESCHI cum licentia MEA Parochi hujus Loci***; *patrini fuerunt* ***JOANNES VERZIN EX CARNIA, professionis suæ SARTOR***, *et* **Rosalia filia D.ⁿⁱ Josephi Defranceschi**.»

*[This week's headline was* «**Leonardus Defranceschi** … professionis suæ ***TEXTOR EX CARNIA***»](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia). ***Two years on, the same register uses the same construction for a tailor of another family.*** *[The Carnia tie is not one man and one trade.](/gologorica-line/#josephamariana1776)* ⚠ *No kinship between Verzin and this family is claimed.*

**✔ And the canon a second time**, *with* **Bancich** *in the first person —* «cum licentia **MEA** Parochi hujus Loci». *[Seven months after the 1774 entry.](/gologorica-line/#canon1774)*
ev: Josepha Mariana, the Grah and the Carnian tailor
The row that gained a baptism and two parents
Her mother, who went home to Krbune
Her father, whose children are no longer one

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II» 1772–1774: a Defranceschi CANON six years before the Baxa objection, and a «q.ᵐ» tested against itself
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II.ᵈᵘˢ … ab anno 1764» (signatura 3.2), M01068931 and M01068932
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm, read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.pages: M01068931 and M01068932, both halves of each opening, read entry by entry — about twenty-eight baptisms, 29 March 1772 – 31 August 1774.
rows.what: Continuing the end-to-end sweep of this book, forward from [the 1770–1772 frames](/searched/).
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE CANONRY IS SEVEN YEARS EARLIER, AND IT LANDS BEFORE THE OBJECTION TO IT.**

> **31 Augusti 1774** · «*baptizatus est* ***ab Admodum R.ᵈᵒ D.ⁿᵒ CANONICO MATTHIA DEFRANCESCHI, de licentia Parochi hujus Loci***»

*[The Defranceschi canonry was known from one 1781 entry and flagged hard](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770), because [the same register gives the titular canonry of Pedena to a* **Mathias BAXA** *fourteen months earlier](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-1780/).* ***This is six years before the Baxa entry exists***, *in a different book, by the same parish priest, with nothing at stake.* **The flag can come down in the Defranceschi direction.**

---

**⚠⚠ AND IT WITHDRAWS SOMETHING THIS ARCHIVE PUBLISHED FOUR HOURS AGO.** *[The ladder](/corrections/) —* «1764 no office · 1766 Reverendus Dominus · 1768 Cooperator · 1782 Parochus» *— arranged five entries into one career by putting them in a line.* ***Written as the registers write them they fall into two columns:*** *plain* «**Mathias**» *(1764, 1766, 1772, 1774, 1781) who is* ***never an officer here*** *and always needs* «licentia», *and* «**Joannes Matthias**» *(1768 Cooperator, 1782–88 Parochus) who signs in his own right.* **One man or two is no longer asserted.** ⚠ *[The 1798 death entry abbreviates the parish priest to* «MATH. de Franceschi»](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/), *so the forename does not decide it.*

---

**✔✔ AND A «q.ᵐ» TESTED AGAINST ITSELF.**

> **29 Octobris 1773** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***Joannes Baptista Defranceschi q.ᵐ Leonardi***…»

*[This morning the archive argued from an absence](/gologorica-line/#twofathers1769): the September 1769 clause has no* «q.ᵐ», *so Leonardus was alive.* ***The same scribe writes the name four times — 1769 without it, 1773 and 1774 with it — and the one change falls in the gap where [the burial of 15 March 1773 sits](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia).*** **An argument from an absence is only as good as the scribe's habits, and here the habit is demonstrated.**

---

**✔ Also on M01068931:** «*a me* **Sacerdote Mathia de Franceschÿ**, ***loco Parochi***» *(Sept 1772) — a third self-written entry, a third spelling, and a formula that is again* ***not*** *an office.
ev: The canon, the two columns and the «q.ᵐ» test
The row the ladder was on

rows.src: ⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — a LOOSE SLIP inside «Liber Baptizatorum II»: a Cerovlje extract of 1793, and the same opening shot twice
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214 — «Liber Baptizatorum II.ᵈᵘˢ … ab anno 1764» (signatura 3.2), M01068927–M01068930
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm, read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.pages: M01068927 and M01068928 read entry by entry, both halves. M01068929 and M01068930 are the SAME opening: M01068930 is clear and was read on 10 October; M01068929 has a loose leaf lying across both pages and CANNOT be read entry by entry — the slip itself was read instead.
rows.what: Continuing the end-to-end sweep of this book, forward from [the 1769–1770 frames](/searched/).
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ A FRAME THAT LOOKS LIKE A SPOILED EXPOSURE IS A DOCUMENT.**

*M01068929 and M01068930 are one opening photographed twice. The difference between them is a* ***loose leaf lying on the page***, *lifted between frames — a certified extract from the baptism book of* **CEROVLJE**, *not part of this register at all:*

> «*Die* **5. Januarij 1767.** *Antonia filia legitima* **Michaelis, et Apoloniæ** *jugalium* **Persevich** *baptizata fuit a me* ***Archipræsbitero et Parocho Dominico Clinzich***…
> *Die* **12. 8bris 1770.** *Catharinam filiam legitimam, et* ***posthumam*** *… baptizavit* ***Gregorius Bosich Vice-Parochus***…
> ***Sic de verbo ad verbum ex Libro Baptizatorum descripsit*** · *Die* **18. Aprilis 1793** · **Laurentius Vicich m.p.ᵃ, Parochus**»

**⭐⭐ AND IT CORROBORATES SOMETHING PUBLISHED FOUR HOURS AGO.** *[The baptism of* **Petrus Antonius Defranceschi**, *17 April 1768, was given not by the parish priest but by](/gologorica-line/#petrus1768)* «**Archipresbyter et Parochus Cerovglienensis Dominicus Clinzich**». ***The slip has him signing in his own parish fifteen months earlier***, *in a document copied out in 1793 for reasons that have nothing to do with this family.* **Two parishes, two documents, one man.** *It also names a Cerovlje* **Vice-Parochus Gregorius Bosich** *(1770) and* **Parochus Laurentius Vicich** *(1793).*

⚠ ***And a frame under paper is not a frame read.*** *M01068929 is recorded as unreadable entry by entry; [it is M01068930 that this archive read](/gologorica-line/). A repeated opening on a reel is worth opening before it is written off as film debris.*

---

**✔ A fifth attestation of the sonship.** **19 Sep 1770** *(M01068927)* — «*patrini fuerunt* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Baptista filius D.ⁿⁱ Josephi Defranceschi***, *et* **Helena uxor ejusdem Defranceschi**», *at the baptism of a* «filia **posthuma**» *of the late* **Josephus Flegar**. ⚠ *Here* «ejusdem» *is ambiguous and could make Helena the son's wife; [the December 1769 entry writes it out in full and settles it](/gologorica-line/#cerovljeslip).*

---

**✔ NAMED NIL — M01068928.** *About twenty-four baptisms,* **11 November 1770 – 13 September 1771**, *read entry by entry:* ***no Defranceschi as parent, godparent or officiant.*** *Surnames:* **Udovcich · Flegar · Zabran · Sibina · Muge · Boer · Zaez · Gabar · Laddetich · Crismanich · Papoli · Sepulka · Culianich · Candarich**, *with* «**Leonardus Deprato**» *standing on 24 August 1771.*

rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE PRIEST SEPARATES THE TWO SAME-NAMED MEN BY THEIR FATHERS, ON ONE PAGE, TWELVE WEEKS APART.**

> **24 Sep 1769** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***Joannes Baptista Defranceschi FILIUS LEONARDI***…»
> **18 Dec 1769** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Baptista FILIUS D.ⁿⁱ JOSEPHI Defranceschi***, *et* **Helena uxor ejusdem D.ⁿⁱ Josephi**…»

*[This archive published the 1786 entry where the next priest does the same job with their wives](/gologorica-line/#twojb1786) and called it the priest doing our work for us.* ***Marcus Bancich had been doing it since 1769.***

**⭐⭐ And there is no «q.ᵐ» before «Leonardi».** *[The marriage of June 1774 has one](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-detti-leonardi-m-1774/); [the death register buries* **Leonardus Defranceschi**, «*TEXTOR EX CARNIA*», *on 15 March 1773](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia).* ***Three documents, three hands, and the* «q.ᵐ» *falls exactly where it should.*** *It is also the earliest thing on that row — five years before his wedding.*

**⭐ The other man's sonship is now written four times** — **1769**, 1772, 1786, 1813 — *and [1769 is the earliest](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/).* ⚠ *He would be* **seventeen**; *recorded as the entry's arithmetic, and nothing is adjusted on it.*

⚠ **And the two branches do not carry the same style in the same hand:** *Josephus's son is* «**D.ⁿᵘˢ**», *Leonardus's son is not.* ***One pair of entries is a thin basis for a social claim and it is offered as what the page shows, not as a conclusion.***

---

**✔ A fourth construction of the župan's name**, **5 Feb 1770** — «*Joanna* ***vidua defuncti Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***». *[Four entries, 1764–1770, and she is a godmother in all four](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/), at about eighty-six in the last.*

---

**✔ NAMED NIL — M01068924.** *Twenty-six baptisms, 26 August 1768 – 18 January 1769, read entry by entry:* ***no Defranceschi as parent, godparent or officiant.*** *The surnames on that opening are* **Zaez · Zabran · Ancich · Flegar · Cherbavaz · Jadrejcich · Krosgnial · Radoicich · Rabor · Pavelich · Udovcich · Gasparich · Soleschi · Clagnaz · Gospodnetich · Boulovich**, *with* «**Catharina uxor Leonardi Deprato**» *standing on 26 August.*

rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ A ROW THAT WAS A CENSUS LINE AND A TREE YEAR NOW HAS A BAPTISM WRITTEN AT THE TIME.**

> **17 Aprilis 1768** · «***Archipresbyter et Parochus Cerovglienensis Dominicus Clinzich*** *baptizavit* ***PETRUM ANTONIUM*** *filium legitimum* ***D.ⁿⁱ Josephi, et Helenæ jugalium DEFRANCESCHI***; *patrini fuerunt* **Josephus Belch**, *et* **Matthia uxor Jacobi Rovis q.ᵐ Matthæi**, *ambo* ***Pisinenses***.»

*[The 1826* status animarum *enters Petrus Defranceschi,* «civilitas», ***born 17 April 1768***](/person/petrus-defranceschi-1768/) — *and that was the whole of his evidence.* ***The register of 1768 gives the same day***, *and with it his father* **[D.ⁿᵘˢ Josephus](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/)**, *his mother* **Helena**, *a second forename* ***Antonius*** *nothing else records, and [a sister](/gologorica-line/#liberii1769).*

**⭐⭐ And the officiant is not the parish priest.** *The* ***archpriest of Cerovlje*** *came over to do it, with* **Marcus Bancich** *writing the entries either side; the godparents are* «**ambo Pisinenses**», *both from Pazin.* ***The «civilitas» of 1826 was already visible at the font in 1768.***

---

**⭐⭐ THE YEAR BEFORE: HELENA NAMED, AND A FORENAME TWENTY YEARS ABSENT.**

> **11 Martij 1767** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Petrus Defranceschi*** *et* ***Helena uxor D.ⁿⁱ Josephi Defranceschi***» — *at the baptism of* **Josephus**, *son of* **Leonardus and Catharina DEPRATTO**.

*Helena is named as Josephus's wife* ***two years earlier*** *than the archive had her.* *And [Joannes Petrus, whose row held three appearances — 1744, 1747, 1750, all at Gračišće](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-gologorica/), has a* ***fourth, seventeen years later, at home***. ⚠ *[Consistent with his being the* «Sig.ʳ Giovanni Pietro» *who died in 1781 aged 86½](/person/pietro-defranceschi-1695/) — he would be seventy-two — but* ***the rows are still not joined***.

---

**✔ AND THE BISHOP OF PEDENA SIGNS THE BOOK.**

> «*Die* **15.ᵗᵃ Julij 1768** *in prima Nostra G.ˡⁱ Visitatione · Revisus, et approbatus ·* **Aldragus Ant.ᵘˢ Ep.ᵘˢ PETINENSIS**»

*It dates the book's custody, and it does one small thing to [this morning's unsettled word](/gologorica-line/#supanus1764): one candidate was* «**Petinus**», *and* ***this volume writes the adjective for Pedena as*** «**Petinensis**». *The volume read against itself makes the candidate weaker and supplies no better one.* **The word still stands as «[—]ᵘˢ».**
ev: The baptism, the archpriest and the bishop, told in full
Petrus Antonius — the row that gained a baptism
His father, and Helena named in 1767
A fourth appearance, seventeen years on

Continuing the sweep forward from the first page.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE BOOK ANSWERS BOTH, TWO FRAMES ON.**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **26 Apr 1764** | *M01068918* | «*Domina Supana Joanna vidua defuncti D.ⁿⁱ Supani* ***Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***» |
| **24 Sep 1765** | *M01068919* | «*Joanna uxor defuncti Supani* ***Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***» |
| **14 Feb 1767** | *M01068921* | «*Joanna uxor defuncti Supani* ***Joannis Baptistæ Defranceschi***» |

***Three constructions, one scribe, thirty-four months.*** *[The forename pair no longer rests on a single reading](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-supanus-d-by-1764/), and [his widow is at fonts through all three](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/), into her eighties, a decade after he is first entered* «defuncti».

---

**✔✔ AND THE FLAG IS DISCHARGED.**

> **15 Octobris 1766** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***R.ᵈᵘˢ D. Mathias Defranceschi*** *et* **Euphemia uxor Judicis Antonij Flegar ex Novaco**»

*A* ***different hand*** *— the parish priest's, not his own — writes the name, and writes it the same.* [*He now carries a style*](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/): «**R.ᵈᵘˢ D.**» ⚠⚠ **[This sentence asserted a single career and is WITHDRAWN, 11 October 2026](/corrections/)** — *[the 1774 entry gives a* **CANONICUS**, *and the registers keep two sequences apart](/gologorica-line/#canon1774). One man or two is no longer asserted.*

⚠ *Only the* ***name*** *is settled. The doubtful word in his 1764 entry is still* «[—]ᵘˢ» *and [stays that way until something construes it](/method/).*

---

**⭐⭐ AND TWO MORE THINGS OUT OF ONE DECEMBER ENTRY.**

> **16 Decembris 1764** · «*baptizavi* **Luciam** *filiam legitimam* ***Supani Martini et Mariæ jugalium Udovcich Gospood***; *patrini fuere* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ Joseph Defranceschi***…»

**[Josephus is four years and two months earlier than this archive had him](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/)** *— his first appearance was 26 February 1769 — and he is* «**Dominus**» *here as there.*

**And the title has moved house.** *Eight months after the Defranceschi župan is entered dead, the register calls* **Martinus Udovcich Gospood** «**Supanus**» — *and [his children are the ones the Defranceschi widow stands for in 1765 and 1767](/gologorica-line/#supana1767).* ⚠ *A title held by a named man at a named date; ***not a succession list***, and nothing is claimed about the years between.*
ev: The three constructions, told in full
The župan, now on three entries

rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE VERY FIRST PAGE CARRIES TWO OF THE NAME, AND NEITHER WAS EXPECTED.**

> **26 Aprilis 1764** · «*patrini fuere* **D.ⁿᵘˢ Matheus Flegar**, *et* ***Domina Supana Joanna vidua defuncti D.ⁿⁱ Supani JOANNIS BAPTISTÆ DEFRANCESCHI***»

**The župan of Gologorica, named in full by his own parish.** *[The entry that made him known](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/) is his widow's burial in 1774, which calls him only* «Supani **Joannis** Defranceschi» — *and this archive's note on her row records that the full forename pair had to be carried in from the Gračišće registers.* ***It no longer does.*** **[He now has a row](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-supanus-d-by-1764/)**, *and a death* ***before 26 April 1764***, *which her burial entry does not supply.*

**⭐ And she is alive at a font**, *styled* «**Domina Supana**» *in her own right —* ***five days short of ten years*** *before she was buried in the family's* arca *under the floor of the parish church.*

⚠ **Three men of this name at Gologorica inside sixty years, and none is merged:** *[the one dead by 1709, whose wife was* **Lucia***](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-of-gologorica-d-by-1709/); the župan; and a tree-only* «elder, d. **1767**» *who cannot be* «defuncti» *in 1764 — [though a tree year is an interval, not a point](/method/).*

---

**⭐⭐ AND THE PRIEST, FOUR YEARS BEFORE HIS EARLIEST KNOWN APPEARANCE.**

> **18 Februarij 1764** · «*Ego* ***Mathias Defranceschi*** *[—]ᵘˢ* **Sacerdos** ***de licentia Parochi*** *baptizavi* **Mathiam** *filiam legitimam defuncti* **Thomæ** *ac* **Mathiæ** *jugalium* **Zabran alias Strapich**»

*He was known from* **1768** *onward, as* [**Cooperator**](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782). «**De licentia Parochi**» *says he held* ***no office in this parish*** *in February 1764: he writes the entry himself, between two of* **Marcus Bancich's**.

⚠ **One word between the surname and «Sacerdos» is not settled and is not being guessed** — «Pe» *or* «Ve», *a tall looped letter, a dotted* i, *then* «nus»; *possibly* «**Petinus**», *of Pedena.* *[A hand with one entry in it cannot be read against itself](/method/); [thirty-three frames of this book remain unread](/worklist/) and may supply the second construction.*

rows.what: [The composite item beside it has just been swept](/searched/). This is the parallel baptism register — thirty-eight frames, 1764–1788, [verified as a true register on 9 October](/searched/) and never read.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ THREE WEEKS OF 1769 GIVE TWO THINGS THIS ARCHIVE HAS WANTED.**

> **26 Feb 1769** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***Dominus Josephus Defranceschi et ROSALIA EJUSDEM FILIA***»
> **16 Mar 1769** · «*patrini fuerunt* ***Dominus Josephus Defranceschi, et HELENA UXOR EJUSDEM***»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068925,* «**Liber Baptizatorum II**» *1764–1788.)*

**1. ⭐ A MARRIAGE, thirty-five years before the widow.** *[Josephus and Helena were joined in this archive only by their daughter's death of 1783 and Helena's burial as his widow in 1804](/person/helena-defranceschi-1725/) — **both after the fact.** ***Here they stand together at a font as husband and wife.***

**2. ⭐⭐ A THIRD DAUGHTER, out of a row that was a name.** *[«Rosalia Defranceschi» had no dates, no source and no note](/person/rosalia-defranceschi-gologorica/).* ***She is godmother beside her father, and the register says whose daughter she is.*** **[The man whose whole row was the word «Dominus» two days ago now has a wife and three daughters.](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/)**

⚠ *Rosalia has no age: a godmother in 1769 was commonly fourteen or more, so* **born by about 1755** *— an inference from the role. Her mother is not named in her own entry, so the join to Helena is* **inf**.

**⚠ AND THE BOOK EXPOSES A STRUCTURAL FACT.** *It runs* **1764–1788**; *[the other baptism register runs 1770–1781](/gologorica-line/#itemswept); [Liber IV begins 1784](/gologorica-line/#bookseries).* ***So in the 1780s this parish kept THREE baptism books and TWO death books at once*** — *the same doubling that [recorded one child twice with different ages](/person/catharina-defranceschi-d1786/).* **A reader who opens one of them has not read the parish.**

⚠ **Only two of thirty-eight frames are read entry by entry.** *The rest are rendered and not yet swept; this row will grow.*

---

# ⭐⭐ AND 1772 GIVES HIM A SON

> **20 February 1772** · «*[Mat]hia filia legitima jugalium* **Leonardi et Catharinæ Deprato[—]** *baptizata est a me* **Marco Bancich Parocho hujus Loci**; *patrini fuerunt* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ JOANNES BAPTISTA DEFRANCESCHI FILIUS D.ⁿⁱ JOSEPHI, et ROSALIA FILIA EJUSDEM D.ⁿⁱ JOSEPHI***.»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068930,* «Liber Baptizatorum II», **20 February 1772**. *The ink is faint; magnified before transcription.)*

**⭐ «Joannes Baptista Defranceschi FILIUS D.ⁿⁱ JOSEPHI»** — *[this archive's only evidence that that man had a father was his own burial of 1813](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/).* ***Here he is at twenty, described the same way while his father lived.***

**⭐⭐ And «Rosalia filia ejusdem» makes them brother and sister.** ***[Josephus](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/) — a row that was the single word* «Dominus» *two days ago — now has a wife and four children, each named as his in a register:*** *[Joannes Baptista](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/) · [Rosalia](/person/rosalia-defranceschi-gologorica/) · [Margarita](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/) · [Marianna](/person/marianna-defranceschi-fl-1780/).*

⚠ **And the trap caught again.** *At page scale the child's parents read* «Leonardi et Catharinæ **Defranceschi**»; *magnified, the surname is* «**Deprato[—]**» — *and [a Leonardus Deprato died here in 1784 aged sixty](/gologorica-line/#textorexcarnia).* ***Not ours, and not claimed.***

---

# ⭐⭐ 1776 — THERESIA, AND HER HUSBAND'S BROTHER

> **13 December 1776** · «*Mathias filius legitimus* **Joannis Udovicich Jacotich** *ejusque uxoris Helenæ baptizatus est a me* **Marco Bancich Parocho hujus Loci**; *patrini fuerunt* ***ANTONIUS DEFRANCESCHI, et THERESIA JOANNIS BAPTISTÆ DEFRANCESCHI UXOR***.» *(M01068935.)*

***«Theresia, wife of Joannes Baptista Defranceschi»*** — *[the Krbune bride of 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774), two and a half years married. **Her earliest appearance in this archive.*** **And beside her [Antonius Defranceschi](/person/antonius-defranceschi-1742/)**, «q. Leonardo» *at his death —* ***her husband's brother***, *and his earliest appearance moves from 1782 to 1776.*

---

# ⭐⭐⭐ 1781 — A CASTLE MARRIAGE, AND THE CANON CONFIRMED

> **Die 20 Junij** · «***Antonius Aloysius Nicolò*** *natus die* **12 Junij**, *filius legitimus Domini* ***Joannis Andreæ Nicolò DE CASTRO ROZZI***, *et* ***MARIANNA ejus uxoris, FILIA DOMINI JOSEPHI DEFRANCESCHI***, *baptizatus est a* ***R.ᵐᵒ D.ⁿᵒ MATHIA DEFRANCESCHI, Canonico TITULARI Cathedralis Ecclesiæ PETINENSIS***, *de licentia Parochi … patrini fuerunt D.ⁿᵘˢ* **Joannes Baptista Defranceschi**, *et* **Maria uxor D.ⁿⁱ Antonij Covaz Pisinensis**.»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068940,* «Liber Baptizatorum II», **20 June 1781**.)*

**[Marianna](/person/marianna-defranceschi-fl-1780/) is wife of** «*Dominus Joannes Andreæ Nicolò* **de Castro Rozzi**» — *the castle of* **Roč**. *Her son* **Antonius Aloysius Nicolò** *born 12 June 1781; baptised by* ***Mathias Defranceschi, Titular Canon of Pedena***; *godfather her brother [Joannes Baptista](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/).*

**✔ AND IT SETTLES THE CANON.** *[Yesterday he was one sighting in the last entry of another book, flagged because a* **Baxa** *holds the same title fourteen months earlier](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770).* ***Here is a second, in a second book, baptising his own kinswoman's son — and [he attends the dying parish priest seven months later](/gologorica-line/#bancich1782).*** **Three appearances, three books.** ⚠ *The Baxa objection stands — two men can be titular canons at once — and whether this canon is [the priest who succeeded Bancich](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/) remains* **inf**.

⚠ *Noted, not chased:* «Maria uxor D.ⁿⁱ Antonij **COVAZ** Pisinensis» — *[and the Maire of Pazin who seized the registers in 1812 has a surname this archive could not read, ending* «—ovaz»](/gologorica-line/#french1812).

---

# ✔✔ 1786 — THE PRIEST TELLS THE TWO JOANNES BAPTISTAS APART, AND PROVES THE ISTRIAN SPELLING

> **3 October 1786** · «*Patrini fuerunt* ***Joannes Bapta Defranceschi MARITUS THERESIÆ***, *et* ***Cattarina nata JABLICH uxor Joannis Baptistæ FILIJ JOSEPHI Defranceschi***, *ambo ex hac Parochia.*»

*(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01068950,* «Liber Baptizatorum II».)*

**✔ Two men of one name at one font, distinguished by their wives** — «**maritus Theresiæ**» *and* «**filij Josephi**». ***[The archive has been doing by inference what the scribe did by habit.](/gologorica-line/#twojb1786)*** *And it makes the house-36 man's sonship* **doc** *a third time (1772, 1786, 1813).*

**✔✔ AND THE SURNAME TEST NOW RUNS BOTH WAYS.** *[Bakar's* «**Sablich**» *was proved from* «**Sa**bastiani» *in the same entry](/gologorica-line/#bakar1783).* ***Here the* **J** *of* «**J**ablich» *is proved against the same scribe's* «**J**oannis» *and* «**J**osephi», *fifteen letters away.*** **Both spellings demonstrated, each against its own hand** — *so the difference is two scribes, not a misreading at either end, exactly as [published two days ago](/gologorica-line/#bakar1783).*

rows.what: Chasing the renumbering between [house 45 in 1780](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-1780/) and [casa 31 in 1785](/person/franciscus-antonius-defranceschi-1785/). **The deaths of 1770–1789 are the only book that spans the change**, so its house numbers were opened to see which system it uses.
rows.got:
**✔ The numbering question is answered in passing: this book uses the 1770 system.** *Margins on one opening run* **9, 18, 25, 31, 37, 39, 45, 46, 47, 80, 87, 90, 93, 103, 107, 112, 129** — ***numbers past a hundred, matching [the house list](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770)***, *not the later system that tops out in the sixties.*

**⭐⭐⭐ AND THEN THE ENTRY AT HOUSE 46.**

> **46** · «***Joanna Defranceschi annorum nonaginta circiter, vidua defuncti Supani Joannis Defranceschi***, *munita Sacramentis … per me Parochum hujus Loci* **Marcum Bancich**, *et a me eodem* ***sepulta est 21 in Arca ejusdem existente in hac Parochiali Ecclesia***.» — **20 April 1774** *(M01068988)*

**⚠ THE ŽUPAN IS NOT NEW.** *[He has been on the direct-line page since the Gračišće sweep](/direct-line/) —* «Ioana Uxor Sup.ⁿⁱ Ioanis Bap.ᵗᵃe Defranceschi» *(1733),* «Joanna uxor Sup.ⁿⁱ Jo: Baptistæ Defranceschi de Golagoriza» *(1743).* ***What is new is that the same woman now has a death, an age, a house and a grave.***

| | |
|---|---|
| **died** | 20 April 1774, buried the 21st |
| **age** | «nonaginta circiter» → born *c.* **1684** |
| **house** | **46** |
| **grave** | «**in Arca ejusdem existente in hac Parochiali Ecclesia**» — ***a tomb inside the church***, *where everyone else on these pages is* «in hoc Parochiali Cœmeterio» |

**⭐ It documents [a row that was a name and two tree years](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/)** — «Gisanna Defranceschi 1684–1774», `myheritage`, note empty. ***Both years confirmed by one entry, and* «Gisanna» *is* «Joanna».*** *The second of [the six tree-only people](/gologorica-line/#calendarindex) documented in two days.*

---

**⚠⚠ AND IT BREAKS AN ARITHMETIC THE ARCHIVE HAD NOT CHECKED.** *[The Zagreb account makes the župan's son* **Gian Pietro** *the lord's tax-collector](/direct-line/); [yesterday this archive identified that man as* «Sig.ʳ Giovanni Pietro Defranceschi, d'anni 86½», *dead 1781, born c. 1695](/person/pietro-defranceschi-1695/).*

> ***A woman born about 1684 cannot be the mother of a man born about 1695.***

*Either she is a later wife, or one of the two ages is wrong.* **No parentage is attached on the strength of it.** ***A household reconstructed from three sources can be arithmetically impossible, and nobody notices until a fourth source gives somebody an age.*** *[Told on the line page.](/gologorica-line/#zupanwife)*

---

# ⭐⭐⭐ AND 1783 GAVE MARGARETTA, WHO UNMAKES THREE THINGS PUBLISHED YESTERDAY

> «**Die 22. Aprilis anno 1783.** ***Margaretta Ancilla annorum 22, mensium 9, filia Josephi et Hellenæ jugalium de Franceschi*** … *cujus corpus die* **25** *… sepultum est* ***in Arca Parentuum*** *per R.ᵐᵘˢ* ***Archipresbiterum et Parochum CHERBUNÆ D.ⁿᵘˢ Joanes Gràch***.» *(M01068991.)*

**⭐⭐ THE ARCHPRIEST OF KRBUNE, A THIRD TIME.** *[He marries this family in 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774), ***buries it in 1783***, and [stands godfather to it in 1785](/person/franciscus-antonius-defranceschi-1785/) — **three rites in eleven years, all at Gologorica, by the archpriest of a parish four kilometres away.** *That is a relationship, not a coincidence.*

**⚠ And it corrects yesterday:**

| | published | the register |
|---|---|---|
| *died* | **20 April** *(the calendar)* | ***22 April***, *buried the* **25th** |
| *age* | *about* **35** *(the tree's 1747)* | ***22 years 9 months*** → *b. c.* **July 1760** |
| *her mother* | **inf** | ***doc*** |

**⚠⚠ The obit calendar is two days out on a death it copied** — *[the first case where the copy can be checked against its source](/corrections/).* ***Still the only route to 1646–1770; every date from it now carries a tolerance, and where the register survives the register wins.***

**⚠ And the tree is thirteen years out on her birth** — *the first of [the six tree-only people](/gologorica-line/#calendarindex) a register has badly contradicted.*

⚠ *«Ancilla» left as written and not interpreted; and the register does* **not** *call her father dead, where the 1800 calendar does. [Both flagged.](/corrections/)*

---

# ⭐⭐ READ FORWARD 1772–1784 — three more results

**1. ⭐ «1783. STERILIS ET FAMES»** — *the parish priest's own heading for the year:* «**barren, and famine**» *(M01068991).* *[The archive holds the famine of 1815 and the hunger of 1817 from the later book](/gologorica-line/);* ***1783 is new, and the first written as a heading rather than inferred from a column of causes.*** *It is also [the year Margaretta died at twenty-two](/gologorica-line/#margaretta1783) — stated as context, not as cause.*

**2. ⚠⚠ THE 1773 DEATHS ARE READ IN FULL AND HOLD NO DEFRANCESCHI.** *Eight entries — 7 Mar, 12 Mar, 4 May, 3 Jul, 1 Aug, 12 Sep, 13 Oct, 27 Nov —* ***not one of them ours***. *[The tree gives Leonardus a death in 1773](/person/leonardus-defranceschi-1697/) and [the 1774 marriage says the groom's father was already dead](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774).* **So the 1751 Leonardo is now the stronger candidate for that father.** ⚠ *Eight deaths in a year is a low count for 130 houses — a reason to doubt the book before the tree. The year is not changed.*

**3. ⭐ The Defranceschi priest is Parochus from 13 March 1782**, *four months earlier than yesterday's earliest, and signs the deaths through the year —* «Parochum Franceschi», «Parochum Mathia Franceschi», «M. Franceschi». ***Eight attestations of the name across five books.***

**⭐ And the book gives the parish's burial topography free:** «in hoc Parochiali Cœmeterio» · «**in Crypta Infantium**» · «in tumulo apud Ecclesiam» · «ante Portam Majoris» · «**in Arca**». ***Five places to be buried in one small parish, and [the Defranceschi are in the Arca](/gologorica-line/#zupanwife).*** *The church is named:* «Ecclesiam **S. Petri et Pauli**».

---

# ⭐⭐⭐ THE REGISTER IS SPLIT BY SEX, AND THE MALE HALF HAS HIM

⚠ **The «1773 holds no Defranceschi» published above was eight WOMEN.** *[This volume's baptisms are headed* «Masculorum» *and* «Fœminarum», *and its deaths follow the same split* — men at M01068975–987, women at M01068988–996.](/corrections/) ***A nil taken from half a register is not a nil.***

> «**45** · **Die 14 Martij obijt** · ***Leonardus Defranceschi annorum septuaginta sex***, *provisus Sacramento Pœnitentiæ per me* **Marcum Bancich Parochum**, *sepultus vero est* **15** *in* ***Arca D.ⁿⁱ Petri Defranceschi*** *in hoc Parrochiali Ecclesia existente.* **( : *professionis suæ* TEXTOR EX CARNIA : )**» *(M01068977.)*

| | |
|---|---|
| **age** | **76** → b. *c.* **1697** — *[both the tree's years confirmed by one entry](/person/leonardus-defranceschi-1697/)* |
| **house** | **45** — *[the Defranceschi house of the 1770 list](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770)* |
| **trade** | «**TEXTOR**» |
| **origin** | «**EX CARNIA**» |
| **grave** | «**Arca D.ⁿⁱ Petri Defranceschi**», *inside the church* |

**⭐⭐ «EX CARNIA» IS THE FIRST TIME A GOLOGORICA REGISTER PLACES ANY DEFRANCESCHI OUTSIDE ISTRIA.** *[Every other Carnian document this archive holds comes from somewhere else.](/carnia/)* ⚠ *It does not reach Mione by itself and no join to that household is made.*

**✔ And it makes [the 1774 marriage](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774) *doc*:** *the groom's* «q.ᵐ Leonardi» *is this man, dead fifteen months earlier at the same house* — ***and father and son are both* «Textor».***

**⚠ A second correction from the same frames:** *[Joannes Grach, archpriest of Krbune, also buried* **Leonardus Deprato** *on 28 May 1784](/corrections/)* — ***so his repeated appearances at Gologorica are not family-specific***, *and the sentence that called them so is withdrawn.* *That entry also gives Deprato a death: 27 May 1784, aged 60, house* **61** — *where the 1770 list has him at* **75**. ***One man's house, two numbers, fourteen years.***

**⚠ And the female baptisms 1770–1781 (M01068967–974) are swept: NO Defranceschi daughter at houses 45 or 46.** *[So the earlier house-46 nil was males only](/searched/); it is now both. **House 45 produced one recorded child in eleven years and house 46 none** — which is unremarkable once the register is read: [45's head married only in June 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774), and [46's was the župan's widow, who died at ninety in 1774](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/).*

---

# ⭐⭐⭐ AND THE RICHEST ENTRY IN THE BOOK: the parish priest's own death

> «**Domo sub 55** · *Die* **25 Januarij** *hora nona elapsa ante meridiana obijt R.ᵐᵘˢ Archipresbiter et Parochus hujus loci Gollogoritiæ* ***D.ⁿᵘˢ MARCUS BANCICH, 75 annorum***, *… nec non in articulo mortis Pontificiis benedictionis Apostolicæ* ***per CANONICUM FRANCESCHI***; *sepultus vero* **27** *in* **Monumento Parochiali ante aram majorem** *… per Reverendissimum Dominum* ***Vicarium Generalem PETRUS SEGHER***, *et assistentes alios* **Canonicos Cathedralis PETINENSIS**» *(M01068981).*

**✔ 1. THE SUCCESSION IS DATED.** *Bancich dies* **25 January 1782**; *[the first* «Parochum Franceschi» *signature is* **13 March 1782**](/gologorica-line/#sterilis1783). ***Seven weeks.*** *[The archive could previously date it only to* «between late 1780 and July 1782»](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782).

**⭐ 2. «PER CANONICUM FRANCESCHI»** — *[the canon of the 1781 baptism](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770) is at the dying parish priest's bedside, seven weeks before a Parochus Franceschi starts signing.* ***The obvious reading is one man.*** ⚠ *Still* **inf**; *the Baxa objection is untouched.*

**⭐⭐ 3. A SECOND NAMED VICAR GENERAL OF PEDENA** — **PETRUS SEGHER**, *burying an archpriest with the cathedral chapter in attendance.* *[Worklist 212 exists to find such a name and had exactly one, Corsi of 1732.](/worklist/)*

⚠ *And one number recorded rather than smoothed:* «**Domo sub 55**» *where [the 1770 list puts the* **Parochia** *at* **69**](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770).

---

# ✔ THE ITEM IS SWEPT — and its real structure is six sections, not three

| frames | what is actually there | Defranceschi |
|---|---|---|
| **956–958** | «Nota delle Case abitate, e disabitate» — *the house list, 1–130* | **45**, **46** |
| **958–959** | *three blank printed return-forms* | — |
| **959–966** | «**Notatio Baptizatorum MASCULORUM** a 1ᵐᵒ Julij 1770» | *Joannes Petrus, h.45, 2 Jul 1780* |
| **967–974** | «**Notatio Baptizatorum FŒMINARUM**» | *none* |
| **975–985** | «**Notatio Defunctorum MASCULORUM**» | ***Leonardus, h.45, 14 Mar 1773,* «Textor ex Carnia»** · *D.ⁿᵘˢ Joannes Petrus, h.36, 8 Sep 1781* |
| **986–996** | «**Notatio Defunctarum FŒMINARUM**» | *Joanna h.46 1774 · Margaretta h.36 1783 · **Catharina h.36 1786*** |
| **997–1005** | «**Notatio Personarum Matrimonio junctarum** a 1ᵐᵃ Julij 1770» | *Joannes Baptista × Theresia, 9 Jun 1774* |
| **1006** | *1768–69 marriages,* **out of sequence** | *the Cooperator's signature* |

***Eight Defranceschi events out of a book nobody had opened, and four of the people in them had nothing but a family tree behind their rows.***

**⭐ The last, found on the final pass:** «**36** · Die **12 Martij** [1786] · ***Catharina filia Joannis Baptæ de Franceschi ejusque uxoris Catharinæ, ætatis suæ dierum 12***» *(M01068993).* *[Her row has always said her parents were* **inferred** *from the index and the house](/person/catharina-defranceschi-d1786/).* ***They are named here.***

**⚠ AND SHE PROVES TWO DEATH REGISTERS RAN AT ONCE.** *[Mortuorum II covers 1770–1789; Mortuorum III begins 1784](/gologorica-line/#bookseries).* ***Both record this child — same day, same house, eleven days in one and twelve in the other, parents named in one and not the other.*** **Neither is a copy of the other.** *For 1784–1789, reading one of these books alone is reading half the parish's record of its own dead.*

⚠ **This is a sweep, not a walk.** *Every frame examined and every section read for one surname; the entries that do not carry it were scanned. [A walk would serve every family in the parish and has not been done.](/method/)*

rows.what: [The 1784 baptism book's cover carries a Roman numeral](/searched/) — «IV.». A parish that numbers its books tells you free of charge whether you hold all of them, so the other covers were opened.
rows.got:
| the cover says | the book | frames |
|---|---|---|
| «LIBER BAPTIZATORUM **II.ᵈᵘˢ** … 1764» | *baptisms* **II** | M01068915–952 |
| «Liber Baptizatorum **III.ᵗⁱᵘˢ** et Mortuorum **II.ᵈᵘˢ**» | *baptisms* **III** *+ deaths* **II**, *from 1 July 1770* | M01068953–1007 |
| «**IV.** LIBER BAPTISATORUM … ab anno 1784» | *baptisms* **IV** | M01069008–181 |
| «**Liber Mortuorum Primus**» | *[the obit calendar](/gologorica-line/#calendarindex), compiled 1800, covering from 1646* | M01069199–223 |
| «Liber Mortuorum **III.ᵗⁱᵘˢ** … ab anno 17[84]» | *deaths* **III** | M01069224–314 |

**✔ The death series is complete: I, II, III.**

**⚠⚠ The baptism series runs II, III, IV.** ***LIBER BAPTIZATORUM I IS NOT ON THESE REELS*** — *the book of this parish's baptisms before 1764, and [the 1679 window the whole Carnian argument turns on](/carnia/) is inside it.* **[The archive already knew the early registers were not in its hands](/undigitised/); what it did not have was the parish's own name for the one it is missing.** *A book you can ask for by its number is a different request from* «whatever you have from before 1764».

**⭐ And one reading, offered as a reading.** «**Liber Mortuorum PRIMUS**» *is the catalogue* **compiled in 1800** — *while the deaths of 1770–89 are* **II** *and those from 1784 are* **III**. *So the numbering goes by period covered, not by date written, and the parish gave its earliest slot to a digest.* ***The obvious reading is that the real first death book was already gone by 1800 and Mocovich's catalogue was shelved in its place.*** ⚠ *An inference from a numeral and a date; nothing on the cover says it. But it would explain why a priest rebuilt a hundred and fifty-four years of his dead out of older pages — not as an index, as a replacement.*

⚠ *The frame map carries none of this.* **Four things that table does not say have now turned up in two days** — *[two books mis-described, one document missing](/corrections/), and now the books' own series numbers.* *Its frame* **ranges** *have been right every time.*

rows.got:
**⚠ NIL ON THE OBJECT.** *Cover, flyleaf, a birth certificate of 1824, then the register.* ***There is no house list and no concordance at the front of this book.*** **So the renumbering is not declared where the first numbering was, and that route is closed.**

---

**⭐⭐ WHAT THE FLYLEAF HAS INSTEAD — and it is a second witness to something already published.**

> «**Sotto il fù Governo Francese.** *Li* **20. Luglio 1812** *fu consegnato questo Registro per ordine del* **Maire S.ʳ Fran.ᶜᵒ [—]ovaz** *all'Uff.ᵒ municipale di* **Pisino**, *e li* **5. Gen.ᵒ 1814** *restituito dall'amministrazione Dominale della Contea* ***con li altri sei*** *a mani di me Parroco* **Mocovich**.» *(M01069011.)*

**⚠ VERIFICATION, NOT DISCOVERY.** *[The seizure, both dates and the municipality were published weeks ago from the Latin note in the death register](/gologorica-line/) (M01069247).* ***This is the same event, in the baptism book, in Italian.*** **Three things are new:**

| | Latin | Italian |
|---|---|---|
| *how many* | «cum aliis» | «**con li altri SEI**» — ***seven registers*** |
| *who ordered it* | — | «**Maire S.ʳ Fran.ᶜᵒ [—]ovaz**» |
| *signature* | «Parochus Mocovich» | «Parroco **Mocovich**» |

**⭐ Seven registers passed through the Municipality of Pisino for eighteen months** — *a number worth having before anyone goes looking for [the French communal records](/worklist/).*

⚠ **The Maire's surname is recorded as present and UNREAD**, *not guessed: a short abbreviation (possibly* «avv.»*) and a surname ending* **—ovaz** *whose capital this archive cannot read. A Maire of Pazin in 1812 is a findable man.*

**✔ And it discharges a flag set yesterday.** *[The obit calendar was published with its compiler as* «Antonio Ferdinando **M[?]ocovrich**», *initial letter flagged](/gologorica-line/#calendarindex).* ***The flyleaf signature is the same man and the capital is an unambiguous M.*** **Mocovich: compiling the catalogue of the dead in 1800, still in the cure in 1814** — *and [the archive's table of priests, which begins in 1826, does not carry him](/gologorica-line/).*

**⭐ One more from the cover:** «**IV.** LIBER BAPTISATORUM … ab anno 1784». ***The parish numbered its own books and this is the fourth*** — *a cheap way to test [whether a book is missing from the reels](/gologorica-line/#framemap).*

rows.got:
**✔✔ THE FIRST HIT LANDED ON THE PREDICTED HOUSE.**

> **45** · «***Joannes Petrus Defranceschi, filius legitimus Joannis Bapt[istæ] Defranceschi et ejus uxoris Theresiæ***, *baptizatus est a me* **Marco Bancich, Parocho hujus Loci**; *patrini fuerunt* **Rev.ᵈᵒ D. Mathias Baxa, Canonicus Titularis Cathedralis Eccl. Petinensis**, *et* **Marianna filia Domini Josephi Defranceschi**» — **2 July 1780** *(M01068965)*

**Three findings in one entry:**

| | |
|---|---|
| **[Joannes Petrus](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-1780/)** | *a son of [the weaver's marriage of 9 June 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774)* — ***new, and the eldest child of that couple this archive holds*** |
| **[Marianna](/person/marianna-defranceschi-fl-1780/)** | «filia Domini Josephi Defranceschi» — ***a second daughter for [the man whose row was one word this morning](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/)*** |
| **Mathias Baxa** | *a* **titular canon of Pedena cathedral** *as godfather in a village of 130 houses* |

**✔ And the house number confirms the list's dating from the other direction.**

**⚠ House 45 in 1780 against [«casa 31» in 1785](/person/franciscus-antonius-defranceschi-1785/) for the same couple.** ***The renumbering caught between two documents for the first time*** — *recorded as a question.*

---

**⭐⭐ ⚠ AND THE REGISTER'S LAST ENTRY NAMES A DEFRANCESCHI CANON OF PEDENA.**

> «*Michael Gasparich … baptizatus est* ***a Rev.ᵐᵒ D. MATHIA DEFRANCESCHI, CANONICO TITULARI Ecclesiæ CATHEDRALIS PETENENSIS***» — **17 September**, *1781 by position (M01068966)*

*[The handle on the Pedena chapter this archive has wanted since 1720](/worklist/), carrying this surname.* **⚠⚠ But fourteen months earlier the same register gives the same title to** «**Mathias BAXA**». ***Two men, both Mathias, both titular canons of Pedena, in one parish inside fourteen months.*** *Both magnified; they are not the same word.* **Either the chapter had two, or one entry has the title on the wrong surname.** ⚠ *That the canon is [the Gologorica priest](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/) is* **inf** *and no second row is minted.*

⚠ **NIL for house 46** — *no baptism at the second Defranceschi house in the whole register.* **And the register is short: eight frames for eleven years** *(M01068959–966), which is few for a village of 130 houses and worth noticing before anyone treats its silences as evidence.*

⚠⚠ **QUALIFIED 11 October 2026.** *This figure counts children* ***baptised at Gologorica***. *[Josepha Mariana, daughter of the house-45 couple, was* «nata et baptizata ad Cherbunam» *in March 1776](/gologorica-line/#josephamariana1776) and her entry carries no* «Ex Domo sub Numero», ***so a house-number sweep cannot see her***. *The number stands for what it measured, not for how many children the house had.*

rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE OVERLAP IS NOT A DUPLICATE. The first openings of the composite item are not a baptism register at all.**

> «**Nota delle Case abitate, e disabitate nel Territorio, e nel nostro Luoco di Gollogorizza**» *(M01068956–958)*

***A numbered list of every house in the village, 1 to about 130***, *one line each: the number, the head of the household by surname, forename and often a patronymic or byname, and against the empty ones* «**Disabitata**».

**⚠ Each line carries a second smaller figure and it is NOT a second house number** — *it skips every* «Disabitata», *so it is an ordinal counting the* **inhabited** *houses.* ***House 45 is the 35th inhabited, house 46 the 36th*** — *and a* «36» *beside a Defranceschi is exactly what this archive would otherwise have read as a house number.*

**⭐⭐ TWO LINES ARE OURS, AND BOTH RECORD A HANDOVER:**

> **45** ⁽³⁵⁾ Defranceschi — ~~Leonardus~~ **Antonius**
> **46** ⁽³⁶⁾ Defranceschi — ~~Joannes [Baptista]~~ **Josephus**

*The first name in each is struck and the successor written over it, so the list was* **kept up**. **⭐ And Leonardus → Antonius is the same succession [the obit calendar reached today by another road](/person/antonius-defranceschi-1742/):** «Antonio Defranceschi, N.º 29, **q. Leonardo**, d'anni 60 — 1802».

---

**⭐ AND IT SHOWS WHAT THE WHOLE ITEM IS: one administrative project with a single start date.**

| frames | what |
|---|---|
| **956–958** | *the house list* |
| **958–959** | *three blank printed return-forms —* «Formolare … dei **Battezzati**», «dei **Copulati**», «dei **Morti**», *ruled* «Delle Case · Maschi · Femine» |
| **959–** | «**Notatio Baptizatorum Masculorum a 1ᵐᵒ Julij 1770**», *with a column* «**Ex Domo sub Numero**» |
| **997–** | «**Notatio Personarum Matrimonio junctarum a 1ᵐᵃ Julij 1770**» |

***Both registers begin on the same day, 1 July 1770, and both are keyed to the numbers in the list at the front.*** ⚠ *The shape will be familiar to anyone who knows the Habsburg house-numbering and conscription returns of 1770–71; nothing is claimed from the resemblance.*

**⚠ THE LIST IS UNDATED** — *no year in its heading, and the striking means its names belong to more than one moment.* ***So it cannot yet be tied to the* «domus 36» *of the death register, the* «casa 31» *of the baptisms, or the* «N.º 12» *of the index.*** **But it is the first document here that STATES the numbering instead of using it.** *[Told on the line page.](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770)*

*Also checked and correct: the separate item* **M01068915–M01068952** — «Rođeni 1764–1788» *— is a true baptism register,* «Ego Marcus Bancich … baptizavi», *from 1764. [That row of the frame map stands.](/gologorica-line/)*

---

# ✔✔ AND IT IS DATED — by its own strikings, on the first test

*[Worklist 220, written minutes earlier](/worklist/), named the cheapest test: the baptisms behind the list carry an* «**Ex Domo sub Numero**» *column from 1 July 1770, so check whether their numbers match the list.*

| the baptism | the list | |
|---|---|---|
| «Michael **Joannis Udovicich**» · Ex Domo **5** | **5** «Udovicich alias Juffinich Matthias» | *same surname* ✓ |
| «Josephus **Joannis Udovicich**» · Ex Domo **128** | **128** «~~Udovicich~~ **Joannes Giacotich**» | ***the STRUCK name is the register's family*** ✓✓ |

**✔ The second is the proof and it is better than a plain match.** *House 128's original entry was* **Udovicich**, *struck, with* **Giacotich** *written over it — and the 1770 register puts a Udovicich there.* ***So the list was written in the register's numbering and updated afterwards.*** **The list is the numbering of 1 July 1770.**

⚠ *The house-5 row agrees but does not prove — same surname, different forename.*

**✔ So: in the 1770 numbering the Defranceschi are at houses 45 and 46.** ⚠ ***This says nothing yet about* «domus 36», «casa 31», «N.º 12», «house 17» *or* «N.º 29»** — *later numberings, [related many-to-one](/gologorica-line/#renumber). **What the archive has is a dated baseline at one end of the problem, where before it had numbers and no document.** [Told on the line page.](/gologorica-line/#houselist1770)*
