rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE LAST FRAME OF THE ITEM IS OUT OF SEQUENCE, AND ITS FIRST ENTRY IS THE PRIEST'S.**

> «*…nulloque legitimo impedimento detecto.* ***Ego JOANNES MATTHIAS DE FRANCESCHI, COOPERATOR hujus loci***, *viduum* **Michaelem Gadda q.ᵐ Andrea ex CHERBUNE**, *rusticum, ætatis suæ* **40** *annorum, et* **Catharinam, celibem filiam Joannis Gadda dicti Picin**, *ætatis suæ* **26**…» *(M01069006,* **1768**.)*

***A fifth attestation of the full name and the earliest*** — *and a different office:* «**Cooperator**», *the curate.* **[His career in this parish now has a shape: curate 1768 → parish priest by July 1782 → still parish priest Feb 1788 → buried 1797/8.](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/)** **⚠ Which narrows «one man or two» to a window — Gallignana in roughly 1769×1782** — *where before there was only* «before 1782 or after 1785».

---

# ⚠ AND THE ITEM'S STRUCTURE IS NOT WHAT THE FRAME MAP SAYS

| frame | what it actually is |
|---|---|
| **M01068996** | ***the END of the DEATHS***, *1768* — «Obijt in D.no… cujus corpus sepultum est in Cœmeterio extra locum». **Not marriages.** *Right-hand page blank.* |
| **M01068997** | ***the marriages BEGIN***, *under the heading* «**Notatio Personarum Matrimonio junctarum a 1ᵐᵃ Julij 1770**» — *a* **short-form list**: name, date, spouse, house number in the margin |
| **M01068998–M01069005** | *1771 → Feb 1788, forward, frame by frame* |
| **M01069006** | ⚠ ***1768–1769, OUT OF SEQUENCE***, *and in the older* **full narrative formula** — an earlier gathering, filmed last |

**So the marriages proper do begin 1 July 1770 as the frame map says** — *but the item also contains* **1768–69 marriages on its final frame**, *in a different hand-formula, which the table does not mention. [Second structural surprise in this item today.](/corrections/)*

---

**⚠ THE SURNAME RESULT FOR THE WHOLE BOOK.** *Every frame of the marriage section has now been examined.* ***In eighteen years of Gologorica marriages there is exactly ONE Defranceschi bride or groom:*** **[Joannes Baptista q.ᵐ Leonardi, the weaver, 9 June 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774).**

⚠ *That is a scan, not a walk — only M01068999 and M01069003 were read entry by entry — and [* «walked» *means every entry](/method/). But a surname this long and distinctive in a short-form list is about as findable as a scan gets.*

**⭐ And more Krbune traffic:** «**Michael Gadda … ex Cherbune**», *a widower of forty marrying into Gologorica in 1768.* ***Not a Grah*** — *but [the two parishes exchanged people constantly, which is the context every Grah nil has to sit in](/searched/).*

rows.got:
**⭐⭐ IT IS NOT A REGISTER. IT IS AN OBIT CALENDAR, AND THAT IS WORTH FAR MORE.**

*Each opening carries two months; the* **days of the month** *run down each page; against each day stand the people who died on that day* ***in any year***, *with the year in a ruled column at the right.* **It is the book a priest reads to know whose anniversary falls today.**

> **30.** · ***Pietro Defranceschi*** — *170—* · Luca Zabran — *1750* · Bortolo Dobradon — *1752* · Giuseppe figlio di q. Matteo Flegar Lucotich N.º 109 — *1782* · [—] Zabran Tulla N.º 86 d'anni 50 — *1788*

*(30 September — M01069217.)*

| | |
|---|---|
| *verified openings* | **M01069204** Jan–Feb · **M01069212** Jun–Jul · **M01069214** Jul–Aug · **M01069217** Sep–Oct · **M01069218** Oct |
| *so it runs* | *the full twelve months, within roughly* **M01069202–M01069221** |
| *language* | **Italian**, not Latin |
| *and it does not stop in 1806* | *the same pages carry* **1817, 1819, 1857, 1887** |

# ⭐⭐ WHY IT MATTERS

**Six of this archive's oldest Gologorica people carry a death year, the place, the source `myheritage`, and a note of nothing at all:**

| | died |
|---|---|
| **[Pietro Defranceschi](/person/pietro-defranceschi-d1701/)** | 1701 |
| **[Gian Battista](/person/gian-giovanni-ivan-battista-defranceschi-1673/)** | 1743 |
| **[Leonardus](/person/leonardus-defranceschi-1697/)** | **1773** |
| **[Gisanna](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/)** | 1774 |
| **[Pietro](/person/pietro-defranceschi-1695/)** | 1781 |
| **[Josephus](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/)** | 1782 |

***Every one of them dies before 1784, which is where [the death register this archive HAS walked end to end](/searched/) begins.*** **That is why none has ever been documented — the book that would do it is the one nobody opened.**

**⭐⭐ And the one that matters most is Leonardus 1773.** *[This morning's marriage calls the groom](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774)* «q.ᵐ **Leonardi** filius», *and the identification of that dead father with this man [was published as* **inf** *because it rests on the tree's year alone](/person/leonardus-defranceschi-1697/).* ***A death entry here would make it doc.***

**⚠ THE ONE READING TAKEN, AND ITS DEFECT.** «Pietro Defranceschi» *under* **30 September**. *At eight times the year is* «**170**» *plus a faint upright with a dot — beside the same scribe's unmistakable* **1750, 1752, 1782, 1788** *in the four lines beneath.* ***The decade is certain; the final digit is not, and it is NOT being read off the family tree***, *which says 1701 and is consistent with — not confirmation of — what is on the page.*

**So the honest finding is: a Pietro Defranceschi died at Gologorica on 30 September in the first decade of the eighteenth century.** *[A day the archive did not have, for a man with no document at all.](/person/pietro-defranceschi-d1701/)*

⚠ **NIL so far on the Grah**, *which is what the row sent this reading to look for — but only five of about nineteen openings have been read, so this is* ***not*** *a nil on the book. [Specified as its own row.](/worklist/)*

---

# ⭐⭐⭐ AMENDED — the sweep was continued and March gave up the priest

> **29.** · Gregorio Zabran — *1752* · Matteo Udovich Juricich — *1758* · ***Rev.ᵈᵒ Sig.ʳ Gio: Mattia Defranceschi, Paroco del luogo, d'anni 66*** — ***1797*** *(M01069207)*

**Same day as [the burial this archive already held](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/). Three things differ.**

| | obit calendar | the 1784–1880 register |
|---|---|---|
| *day* | **29 March** | **29 March** |
| *year* | **1797** *explicit* | **[1798]** *bracketed — taken from a page heading, not written on the entry* |
| *age* | **66** | **62** |
| *style* | «**Paroco del luogo**» — *Gologorica's own* | «**ex Parocho Gallegnanensi**» — *Gračišće's former* |

**⭐ A fourth independent attestation of the forename, and the first in Italian** — *after* «Joannē Mathiam» *(1785),* «Ego Joannes de Franceschi» *(1786),* «Ego Joannes Matthias de Franceschi» *(1788).*

**⭐⭐ And the two styles together are the strongest statement yet for «one man, two cures»** — ⚠ *not proof, and [the day's correction still stands](/corrections/).*

**⚠ Neither the year nor the age is changed on his row. [The tension is published.](/gologorica-line/#calendarindex)**

⚠ *Checked and NOT claimed on the way: a* «Moglie di q. Giovanni—» *under 20 February which resolved at magnification into* **Zadetich**.

---

# ⭐⭐ AND NOVEMBER (M01069219) GAVE A FATHER AND A SON

> **2.** · ***Leonardo Defranceschi*** — ***1751***
> **13.** · Pietro Sepcich — *1647* · ***Matteo figlio q. Leonardo Defranceschi*** — ***1755***

**[«Leonardus Defranceschi the elder» had no dates, no source and no note](/person/leonardus-defranceschi-the-elder-gologorica/).** *He has a death day.* **And [Matteo](/person/matteo-defranceschi-d1755/) is a new person**, *whose own* «q.» *confirms the father was dead by 1755.*

**⚠⚠ IT WEAKENS THIS MORNING'S FINDING.** *[The 1774 groom is* «q.ᵐ Leonardi filius»](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774), *published as probably the Leonardus the tree dates 1697–1773.* ***A man marrying in 1774 whose father died in 1751 is a man of twenty-three or more.*** **Two candidate fathers now, one documented and one from a tree, and neither is chosen.**

⚠ **And the year needed the magnification to save it from the wrong answer.** *At page scale it read* «177—», *which would have made the morning's identification* **doc**. *At eight times it is* **1751**. ***Sixth first impression today that did not survive enlargement, and the first that would have produced a false confirmation rather than a false discovery.***

---

# ⭐⭐⭐ APRIL — MARGARITA'S DEATH, HER FATHER, HER HOUSE, AND A CONTROL ON THE WHOLE BOOK

> **20.** · Lorenzo Cirich — *1701* · Mattio Muca Possin — *1705* · ***Margarita figlia q. Sig.ʳ Giuseppe Defranceschi, N.º 36*** — ***1783***

> **26.** · Santina moglie q. Andrea Gabaro — *1728* · ***Santina Defranceschi, cœlibe, N.º 36, d'anni 58*** — ***1792***

*(M01069209.)*

**⭐⭐ THE SECOND ENTRY IS THE CONTROL, AND IT IS THE MORE IMPORTANT OF THE TWO.** *[This archive already holds Sancta's burial from the other death register](/person/sancta-defranceschi-d1792/):* «[domus] **36** · **26 aprilis** [1792] · SANCTA DEFRANCESCHI, **CŒLEBS** · annorum **58**». ***The calendar matches it in every particular — day, year, age, status and house — from a different book.*** **A finding aid compiled after the fact has to be tested on a case you can check before its uncheckable cases are trusted. It passes.**

**⭐ And Margarita:** *[her row carried a tree year and one marriage she witnessed](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/).* ***Now: died* **22 April 1783** *(this row first said the 20th, from the 1800 calendar)*; *father* «**q. Sig.ʳ Giuseppe Defranceschi**»; *house* **36**.*** *Which also answers the question that row raised this afternoon —* «nor is it established whether she was born a Defranceschi or married one» — **«figlia»: born one.** *And it gives [Josephus, whose entire row was the word* «Dominus»](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/), ***a daughter.***

**⚠ AND IT CORRECTS A SENTENCE THIS ARCHIVE PUBLISHED FOUR HOURS EARLIER.** *That row said she was* «dead within fourteen months» *of the witnessing — arithmetic off a bare tree year with no month in it.* ***It was five months and eleven days.*** *[Published.](/corrections/)*

---

# ⭐⭐⭐ THE SWEEP, CONTINUED TO SIXTEEN OPENINGS — ELEVEN ENTRIES

| died | entry | frame |
|---|---|---|
| **30 Aug 1709** | «Vittoria figlia q. Gio: Battà Defranceschi» | M01069215 |
| **20 May 1720** | «Lucia moglie di q. Gio: Batta Defranceschi» | M01069210 |
| **11 Sep 174—** | «Gio: Battà Defranceschi … d'an: 70» | M01069216 |
| **2 Nov 1751** | «Leonardo Defranceschi» | M01069219 |
| **13 Nov 1755** | «Matteo figlio q. Leonardo Defranceschi» | M01069219 |
| **30 Sep 170—** | «Pietro Defranceschi» | M01069217 |
| **8 Sep 1781** | «Sig.ʳ Giovanni Pietro Defranceschi, N.º 36, d'anni 86½» | M01069216 |
| **20 Apr 1783** ⚠ *the register says the* **22nd** | «Margarita figlia q. Sig.ʳ Giuseppe Defranceschi, N.º 36» | M01069209 |
| **26 Apr 1792** | «Santina Defranceschi, cœlibe, N.º 36, d'anni 58» · **control** | M01069209 |
| **29 Mar 1797** | «Rev.ᵈᵒ Sig.ʳ Gio: Mattia Defranceschi, Paroco del luogo, d'anni 66» | M01069207 |
| **17 Sep 1802** | «Antonio Defranceschi, N.º 29, q. Leonardo, d'anni 60» · **control** | M01069216 |
| **26 Aug 1804** | «Signora Ellena Ved.ª q. Gius.ᵉ Defranceschi, d'anni 84» · **control** | M01069215 |

**⭐⭐ THREE CONTROLS, THREE PASSES.** *Sancta 1792, Antonio 1802 and Hellena 1804 are deaths [already held from the other register](/searched/); the calendar matches all three in day, year, age, status and house.* **That is what licenses the nine that cannot be checked.** *And two of the controls add what the Latin did not — Antonio is* «**q. Leonardo**».

**⭐ Three new people minted**: *[Vittoria](/person/vittoria-defranceschi-d1709/), [Lucia](/person/lucia-defranceschi-d1720/) and [the Giovanni Battista dead by 1709](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-of-gologorica-d-by-1709/)* — ***a household a full generation older than anything this archive had documented at Gologorica.***

**⭐ And a join:** «Sig.ʳ **Giovanni Pietro** Defranceschi» *is [Joannes Petrus, the Gračišće godparent of 1744, 1747 and 1750 whose row said* «no parents, age or house are attached to him»](/person/joannes-petrus-defranceschi-gologorica/). **inf**, *not merged.*

**⚠ A row-level problem exposed:** *[the documented 1804 death sits on a row dated 1725–1809 while a row dated exactly 1720–1804 sits empty beside it](/person/ellena-defranceschi-1720/).* **Flagged on both, merged on neither.**

**⚠ Sixteen openings of nineteen** *(M01069200–202 unread)*, *and across every one of them* ***not a single Grah***.

---

# ⚠⚠ AMENDED AGAIN — the title page, and it corrects this row

> «**Catalogus mortuorum in Parochia Gollogoritiæ ADULTORUM, ab anno Christianæ 1646 usque ad nostra tempora, ex antiquis et recentioribus paginis COACTUS A ME ANTONIO FERDINANDO M[?]OCOVRICH, PAROCHO LOCI, Anno Domini 1800.**»

*— «Catalogue of the dead* **adults** *of the parish of Gologorica, from the year 1646 down to our own times,* **gathered by me**, *Antonio Ferdinando M[?]ocovrich, parish priest of this place,* **out of the old and the more recent pages**, *in the year 1800.»* ⚠ *The compiler's surname is read* «Mocovrich» *and the initial letter is not certain.* *(doc — DAPA* **ZM34K-214**, *M01069202, the title page.)*

**1. «Three controls, three passes» is withdrawn as stated.** ***The calendar is a copy, made in 1800, of the registers*** — *including the one the controls compared it to.* **One source and two copies of it is one source.** *What the controls do show is that the compiler copied accurately, which is why the nine uncheckable entries can be used at all. [Corrected.](/corrections/)*

**2. ⭐⭐ «ADULTORUM».** ***The catalogue is of adults only.*** **So this row's nil on the Grah is a nil for ADULT Grah** — *a family burying only children here would be invisible in it — and the same goes for every other absence taken from this book.*

**3.** *And the compiler is named:* **Antonio Ferdinando M[?]ocovrich, parish priest of Gologorica, 1800** — *successor to [the Defranceschi priest who died in 1797 or 1798](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/), and a hand this archive's [table of hands](/gologorica-line/) does not have.*

---

# ✔ THE ITEM IS NOW FULLY INVENTORIED — and there is no death register in it

| | |
|---|---|
| **M01069199** | *printed title card —* «ŽUPA: GOLOGORICA · MATIČNA KNJIGA UMRLIH 1646-1806 · SIGNATURA 5.1» |
| **M01069200** | *resolution test target* |
| **M01069201** | *the volume's own cover —* «**Liber Mortuorum Primus**» |
| **M01069202** | *the title page, and January begins* |
| **M01069202–221** | ***the calendar, twelve months, all read*** |
| **M01069222** | *endpapers, with a list of priests* |
| **M01069223** | *KRAJ / END OF ITEM* |

***Every one of the twenty-five frames is accounted for, and not one of them is a narrative death entry.*** ⚠ **This row was briefly set `walked: true` and that was wrong, within the minute.** *Every frame of the item has been* **examined**; *the twenty calendar openings were* **scanned for one surname**, *with each hit magnified. That is not the same as reading every entry, and* [`walked` *means every entry*](/method/). ***It is back to `false`, and the distinction is the whole point of the flag:*** *this reading counts for the Defranceschi and for nobody else. A second pass reading every line would serve every family in the parish and has not been done.*

**⚠⚠ TWO CONSEQUENCES.**

**1. The film's title card is wrong about its own book, and [the frame map's rule that the cards are «the authority» is corrected](/corrections/).** *A card printed by a filming project in 1997 is a third-hand description; the book's title page is the authority.*

**2. ⚠ GOLOGORICA'S PRE-1784 DEATH REGISTERS ARE NOT ON THESE REELS.** *This archive has believed since 30 September that it holds them.* ***It holds an 1800 digest.*** **So [the eleven entries](/gologorica-line/#calendarindex) cannot be expanded — there is no fuller entry to go to** — *which both raises the calendar's value and [closes the work-list item that asked where the register sits](/worklist/).*

⚠ *And the two tree-only people the sweep did not reach — [Josephus 1782](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/) and [Gisanna 1774](/person/gisanna-defranceschi-1684/) — are not in the three «unread» openings, because there were none: they are either entries this sweep's eye passed over, or they are children or non-adults the calendar excludes, or they are not in it.*

rows.what: [Worklist 218, written an hour earlier](/worklist/), set this as the cheapest first step after [the Krbune film came back a nil](/searched/): the Gologorica death index is alphabetical by household and would hand over a Grah block with page numbers in one sitting.
rows.got:
**⚠ THERE IS NO GRAH BLOCK. THE SITTING TOOK FIVE FRAMES AND THE ANSWER IS A SECOND NIL.**

**The complete** «G» **run of the index, in order, M01069302–M01069303:**

> **Gasparich alias Millos** *N.º 37 et 38* · **Gaspetich** *N.º 5* · **Gherbaz alias Juranis** *N.º 22* · **Gherfan Martinus** *N.º 108* · **Gherfan Matth.** *N.º 98* · **Giurando Jo.** *N.º 115* · **Giuratich** *(cross-referenced to Crossmaich and Zabran Giuratich)* · **Gregorovich Bortoni** *N.º 86*

*Then the* «I» *column, blank, and* «L». ***Gr— begins and ends with Gregorovich.*** **No Grah. No Grach.**

**⚠ And that nil has a known hole, which is why the second half of this search was done.** *[This index is a HOUSEHOLD directory and a married woman is entered under her husband's surname](/searched/).* ***So a Grah daughter who married into Gologorica is invisible in it*** — *[Theresia is under* «Defranceschi Joanes Bapta detti Leonardi N.º 12»](/person/mariana-defranceschi-d1786/) *and nowhere else.* **Only a Grah heading a house would show.**

---

**⭐ SO THE EXTRANEI LIST WAS READ, WHICH IS THE ONE PLACE A KRBUNE PERSON WOULD BE FILED.** *[The index closes with a column of people who died in the parish and did not belong to it, each with the place they came from](/searched/).* ***It is six names for the whole of 1784–1880***, *so it is short enough to be complete:*

| | from |
|---|---|
| **Ghercovich Maria**, *widow* | *ex* **Cerouglie** *— Cerovlje* |
| **Pellegia Jacobus et Ludovicus**, *boys, their father a surgeon* | *ex* **Monfalcone** |
| **Musul Maria**, *sister of Nicolaus* | *ex* **Padoa** |
| **Afflich Michael Andreovich** | *ex Capo—* |
| **Chiuch Antonius**, *furlanus, a ditcher* | *ex Castro—* |
| **Lucia**, *widow of the late Marinus,* ***nata BORTLICH q. Joanis*** | ***ex territorio CHERBUNE*** |

***One person from Krbune died at Gologorica in ninety-six years, and she is a Bortlich.***

# ⭐⭐ THE SHAPE THIS LEAVES

**Three books, three nils, and together they say something the archive could not say this morning:**

| | |
|---|---|
| *Krbune's own register,* **1803–1870** | *[no Grah at all — controlled against 457 Valcovich](/searched/)* |
| *Gologorica deaths,* **1784–1880**, *by household* | **no Grah household** |
| *Gologorica deaths,* **Extranei** | *one Krbune incomer in 96 years, and she is a Bortlich* |

***Every Grah this archive holds is a person attached to somebody else's household*** — *[the archpriest at a font](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774), [a Catharina standing godmother in 1787](/married-in/), [a Marianna in the Bubich house in the 1826 census](/worklist/), and [Theresia herself, filed under her husband](/person/theresia-defranceschi-nee-grach-gologorica/).* **Not one of them heads a house, dies in either parish, or appears in Krbune's surviving book.**

⚠ **What that is NOT.** *It is not evidence the family was poor or small — an archpriest is neither.* ***It is evidence that whatever the Grah were, they were it somewhere this archive has not yet opened***, *and the two obvious parishes are now both excluded.* **[Gračišće and Cerovlje are next, and both are on the reels in the house.](/worklist/)*

**⭐ One thing found while looking:** *the index's* «D» *block confirms* «**Deprato LEONARDUS N.º 6**» *as a Gologorica household head —* ***which documents [this afternoon's warning](/gologorica-line/#parochus1782) that a* «Leonardus» *of this village may be a Deprato and not a Defranceschi.***

rows.got:
**⭐ IT IS INDEXED, COMPLETELY, AND NOBODY HERE HAD CHECKED.** *[The row that opened this volume on 9 October recorded* «no indexes are available for this image» *from the film's header card](/searched/) — **which is true of the header card and false of the register.** *Image 70 carries a full* **Image Index** *panel:* «Fusca Valcovich · Female · 0 · 1821», «Josephus Fonevich · Male · 65 · 1756».

**THE CONTROL, RUN FIRST**, *because [a nil without one is worthless](/method/) and [this archive manufactured false nils from hand-built FamilySearch URLs twice today](/corrections/):*

| query | result |
|---|---|
| *whole film, no surname* | **27,775 indexed records** |
| **`q.surname=Valcovich`** *(a name read off image 70)* | ***457 records, all* «Krbune, Istra, Hrvatska»**, *baptisms, burials and marriages, 1803–1865, with parents named* |

***The instrument reaches this volume and reaches it thoroughly.*** **So what follows is a real nil.**

**THE TERMS TRIED, ALL SCOPED TO FILM 005497822:**

| query | result |
|---|---|
| **`Grah`** | **2** — *fuzzy matches only:* **Joannes Grassi** *(burial, Pola)* and **Michaël Graudisse** *(father, Pola).* ***Neither is a Grah.*** |
| **`Grach`** | **0** |
| **`Gra*`** *(wildcard, the whole beginning of the name)* | **17 surnames**, *and the complete list is:* **Grassi · Grandissevich · Grandišević · Grandisco[vić] · Grandisse · Grandich · Gradinar · Gradinor · Gradisco · Gracaglich · Gramovich · Graus · Graudisse**. ***Not one Grah. Not one Grach.*** |

# ⭐⭐ WHAT THIS MEANS, AND IT IS NOT NOTHING

**[Theresia née Grach came out of this parish](/person/theresia-defranceschi-nee-grach-gologorica/)** — *the 1774 marriage says* «ex Parochia Cherbune» — *and [her kinsman was its archpriest](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774).* ***By the time this register opens in 1803 there is not one of them left in it.*** *Not a birth, not a marriage, not a burial, in sixty-seven years.*

**⚠ So worklist 168's walk should not be done.** *A hundred and twenty-four images at viewer magnification, for a surname a controlled index search says is not there, is a session spent proving a negative that is already proved.* **[The row is redirected.](/worklist/)**

**⚠ WHAT A NIL IN AN INDEX IS AND IS NOT.** *This is the volunteers' reading, not the book.* *A surname can hide behind a transcription —* **but 457 Valcovich from the same volume is the kind of coverage that makes a surname's total absence meaningful**, *and the* `Gra*` *wildcard was run precisely so that a misspelling would still surface.* ***If the Grah are in this book they are under a first letter other than G.***

**⭐ And the family did not vanish — it moved, and the archive already holds the evidence.** *[The 1826 Gologorica census has* **Marianna Grah, daughter of Mathias and Justina**](/worklist/), *in the Bubich household.* ***They are at Gologorica, whose books are on the family's own hard drive***, *which is [the third time today that the answer to a Krbune question has turned out to be in a Gologorica book](/method/).*

rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ ALL THREE, AND A FOURTH NOBODY ASKED FOR.**

> «**Die 10 9bris** *pro domo* **D. Sebastiani Sablich**, *Nuptiis in facie Ecclesiæ contractis inter* ***D.ⁿᵘᵐ Joannem Bap.[tistam] [De]franceschi ex GOLLOGORIZZA*** *et* ***D. Catharinam Sablich***, *tradidit D. Parochus Buccarensis* **Jacobus Polian**, *præsentibus Senatore D.* **Josepho Walis** *et D.* **Josepho Smich**»

| asked for | got |
|---|---|
| **the date** | **10 November 1783** — *she is seventeen* |
| **the groom's patronymic** | *none given — but* «**Joannem Bap.**», *which [answers the objection this archive published against its own join an hour before](/gologorica-line/#jablichnil): the INDEX dropped the* «Bap.», *the register has it* |
| **the bride's father** | **D. SEBASTIANUS SABLICH** — *and the wedding was held* «pro domo» *his* |
| *and* — | «**EX GOLLOGORIZZA**» ***written into the entry***. *This is not a join made by matching names; the Bakar scribe recorded the groom's village.* |

**⭐ It fits the nil to the month.** *[M01069003 was read entry by entry and covers Nov 1782 – Jan 1785](/searched/).* ***10 November 1783 is inside it, with no Defranceschi marriage on it.***

**⭐ And a social fact:** *both parties* «Dominus»/«Domina», *married by the parish priest of Bakar* **Jacobus Polian**, *before a* **Senator of Bakar**. *[Three years later the couple are* «Cives Gollogoricenses» *at a Gologorica font.](/person/catharina-defranceschi-jablich-gologorica/)*

**⚠ TWO THINGS THIS BREAKS.**

*1. [The Bakar household page read this same entry from the index as* «either the same man remarried, or a brother»](/crikvenica-house/). ***He is neither.*** [Corrected](/corrections/), with [a method row about what indexing strips](/method/).*

*2.* **Her surname.** *Gologorica:* «nata **JABLICH** ex Buccari». *Bakar, her own parish, twice:* «**SABLICH**». ***Neither declared correct***; *the test is the Bakar scribe's own unambiguous* **S** *and* **J** *on page 161, at one magnification.*

**⭐ And [the arrow David drew on his own map by hand](/mymap/), «Bakar to Gologorica», now has a document under it.**

---

# ✔✔ AMENDED — the surname is SETTLED, and it did not need the rest of the leaf

*This row left her surname open and named the test: the Bakar scribe's own unambiguous* **S** *and* **J**. **David authorised the image download; it came down at 5975×4206 and was cropped with the same tooling used on the DAPA plates all day.**

| line | words |
|---|---|
| **1** | «in domo D. **Sabastiani Sablich**» |
| **3** | «et D. **Catharinam Sablich**» |
| **4** | «**Jacobus** Polian» |
| **5** | «et D. **Josepho** Smich» |

**The J in** «Jacobus» **and** «Josepho» **drops a long descender below the baseline and hooks left. The Sablich initial has none.** ***And the clincher is inside the name: «Sabastiani» and «Sablich» open with the identical letterform, and in Sebastian that can only be an S.*** **[Plated.](/gologorica-line/#bakar1783)**

⚠ **It does not make Gologorica's** «Jablich» **a misreading** — *that scribe probably wrote exactly that.* ***Two scribes a hundred and thirty kilometres apart, not two readings of one page.*** *[Her row is renamed* «née Sablich (Jablich)» *and re-declared; the pid stays frozen.](/person/catharina-defranceschi-jablich-gologorica/)*

**⭐ THE PRIEST IS EARLIER AGAIN, AND HIS PREDECESSOR IS DATED.**

| | |
|---|---|
| *autumn **1780*** | «per me **Marcum Bancich Parochum huius Loci**» — *the man who [married the Defranceschi groom in 1774](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774)* |
| *19 Nov **1781*** | «per me **Antonium Carnihar**, Presbyterum, **de licentia Parochi**» — *names no incumbent* |
| *11 July **1782*** | «**per me Parochum Franceschi** in facie Ecclesiæ» |

***The cure passes between late 1780 and July 1782***, *and the first sighting moves from 12 November to* **11 July 1782**. ⚠ *[But see the correction](/corrections/): in this parish* «Parochus» *is a style two* «De—» *men wear within weeks of each other, so a handover is not a tenancy.*

**⭐⭐ AND TWO OF THE NAME AS WITNESSES, 9 NOVEMBER 1782.**

> «...*per* **Parochum Franceschi** *in facie Ecclesiæ, coram testibus nimirum* ***Antonio Defranceschi***, *et Dominico Bachialab ex Novaco, et* ***Margare[t]ha de Franceschi*** *ex hac Parochia*»

| | |
|---|---|
| **[Antonius Defranceschi](/person/antonius-defranceschi-1742/)** *1742–1802* | *everything held of him was his burial.* **Twenty years earlier, aged forty.** |
| **[Margarita Defranceschi](/person/margarita-defranceschi-1747/)** *1747–1783* | *her row was a name and two tree years and* ***no document at all***. *Dead within* **five months** — ⚠ *this row first said* «fourteen», *computed off a bare tree year; [her actual date, **22** April 1783, was found in the contemporary register](/corrections/).* |

⚠ *Both* **inf** *— the entry gives* «ex hac Parochia» *and no ages, houses or fathers. Women witness routinely in this book, so nothing is read into her standing there beyond her being there.*

**⚠⚠ AND THE BRIDE IS A WARNING WORTH MORE THAN THE WITNESSES.** «**Mariana filia LEONARDI DEPRATO**, annorum 22» — *born about 1760.* ***A Leonardus of the OTHER* «De—» *family was raising children in this village in the 1760s***, *while this archive has a Leonardus Defranceschi, a son Leonardus in the death index, and a branch called* «detti Leonardi». *[The standing Gologorica warning now reaches the forenames as well as the surnames.](/gologorica-line/)*

**⚠ THE THING LOOKED FOR WAS NOT FOUND.** *No Defranceschi bride or groom on either frame.* **Catharina née Jablich's marriage is not on M01069003 or M01069004.** *Frames M01068996–98, M01069000–02 and M01069005–06 remain cropped and unread.*

**⭐⭐ WHAT THE FRAMES DID GIVE, from the officiant line rather than the names.**

*A marriage entry written* «per me» *means the officiant is the scribe, so these pages are in the hand of the man who signs them — and for these years that man is a Defranceschi.*

| | |
|---|---|
| **12 Nov 1782** | «**per me Parochum Franceschi** in facie Ecclesiæ» |
| **12 Jan 1785** | «**per me Parocum Joannē · Mathiam Franceschi**» |
| **22 Nov 1785** | «**Ego idem Parochus de Franceschi hujus loci**» |

**⚠ VERIFICATION, NOT DISCOVERY, on the name.** *[This archive already carries him as* **Joannes Mathias Franceschi**](/person/joannes-mathias-franceschi-gologorica/) — *the row was written on 6 October from his burial of 1798.* ***What is new is that these are the first documents in which he names himself***, *and the first evidence for the* «Joannes» *half.* ⚠ *Which is itself an abbreviation with no second construction, and is flagged as such.*

**⭐ WHAT IS NEW: he held this cure four years earlier than the archive had him.** *The earliest sighting was the* Sepeliens *column heading* **1786**; *this is* **12 November 1782**, *and with the fuller title* «Parochus». ⚠ **AMENDED SAME DAY.** *This row went out saying the finding* «narrows the open «one man or two» question: Gallignana must fall before 1782 or after 1785». ***That is withdrawn.*** *[M01069004 has a* **Deprato** *styled* «Parochum» *on 1 February 1785](/corrections/), inside the span — the entries between the Franceschi sightings had not been read, because they do not carry the surname.* **[Method row.](/method/)**

**⭐⭐ AND [WORKLIST 217 IS ANSWERED THE DAY IT WAS OPENED](/worklist/).** *The marginal numbers are* **house numbers**. *The column is headed* «**Num. Domus**» *once at the top of the left page, and six entries on one opening repeat the margin inside the prose as* «sub N.º» — ***13·13, 108·108, 70·70, 41·41, 9·9, 12·12***. **The objection that killed the first attempt — «115 is too large for a house» — is false:** *one match is* **108** *and a bride comes* «ex Salignana **sub N.º 109**». ⚠ *All of it is in the post-1782 hand; nothing is attached to the 1774 entry's margin of 45.*

**⚠ A trap recorded before anyone falls into it.** *The groom at* «N.º 12» *on 30 January 1785 is a* **Bubich**, *while the death book's index files the casa 31 Defranceschi under* «N.º 12». ***Two systems, same figures.***

**And one of ours as a witness:** **9 February 1784**, «in Ecclesia **Sanctæ Anastasiæ** coram testibus Supano Martino Zabran, et **Domino Jacobo de Franceschi**» — *[forty-two years earlier than anything else on that man's row, if it is him](/person/jacobus-de-franceschi-1761/); he would be twenty-one, and the* «Dominus» *is flagged.*

*Also noted: a chaplain* **Joannes Florcich** *working* «cum licentia Parochi» *under him in 1783–84.*

Nothing in this log had ever been inside it. The marriages were opened looking for **Catharina née Jablich's** marriage to the house-36 Joannes Baptista.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ WHAT WAS FOUND IS THE OTHER HOUSE'S MARRIAGE, AND IT ANSWERS A QUESTION THE ARCHIVE WAS GOING TO WRITE A LETTER ABOUT.**

> «**Die 9 Junij** [1774] · 45ᵃ ***Joannes Baptista Defranceschi q.ᵐ Leonardi filius***, *professionis suæ* ***Textor***, *copulatus est cum Virgine* ***Theresia, filia Antonij Grah ex Parochia Cherbune***, *à Rev.ᵐᵒ D.ⁿᵒ* ***Archipresbytero et Parocho Cherbunensi Joanne Grah***, *in facie Ecclesiæ coram testibus ibidem notatis.*»

**Four things, and three of them were open questions:**

| | |
|---|---|
| **The archpriest is named** | «**Joanne Grah**» — [the married-in page said «no forename is given» and proposed a diocesan clergy list at Poreč-Pula](/married-in/), which means a letter, which means [the standing hold](/errands/) |
| **Theresia's father is named** | «**Antonij Grah ex Parochia Cherbune**» — a generation above anything held for the Grach |
| «**detti Leonardi**» **is a patronymic** | «q.ᵐ Leonardi filius» — [the death book's index byname](/person/mariana-defranceschi-d1786/), in Latin, from the parish itself |
| **The groom is a WEAVER** | «*professionis suæ* **Textor**» — the only man on the page who is not «Agricola» |

**⭐ And the facing page separates the two Joannes Baptista by patronymic, nine months apart, in one scribe's hand.** *15 September 1773, a witness at the Udovicich marriage:* «...et **Joanne Baptista Defranceschi filio D.ni Josephi**, omnes Religionis Catholicæ» — *[the house-36 man, whose 1813 death entry calls him* «defuncti Josephi filius»](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/). ***This archive has been telling the two apart by their wives. It can now do it the way the parish did.***

**The trade word was verified before it was published**, *against the same scribe writing* «textore» *nineteen days later and* «Agricola» *twice on the same page, all at one magnification —* «Tector», *a plasterer, is one letter away. [Plate.](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774)*

⚠ **NIL, stated in its terms.** *Catharina née Jablich's marriage — the thing actually being looked for —* **is not on M01068999**. *Frames M01068996–M01068998 and M01069000–M01069006 are cropped and not yet read entry by entry; she was about twenty in 1786 so her marriage should fall in the early 1780s, inside this book. The search continues there.*

⚠ **The marginal numbers on this opening are not understood** — **25 · 110 · 62 · 102 · 50 · 6 · 82 · 27 · 115 · 45 · 62 · 34 · 65**, *in no order and with repeats. Not read as house numbers, and nothing is inferred from them.*

**[The whole finding is told on the line page.](/gologorica-line/#marriage1774)**

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — the 1826 census «Nativitatis» column across all ten Defranceschi pages: nobody born between 1789 and 1803
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214, signatura 7.1 — Gologorica Status Animarum 1826
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm, read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.pages: M01069320, 321, 323, 325, 326, 328, 329, 331, 332, 333 — the Nativitatis block on every Defranceschi-headed page
rows.what: Worklist 216's second test: [the fifteen-year hole in this family's childbearing](/gologorica-line/) had three possible readings, and the 1826 census — already in the house — is the book that can rule one of them out.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ A THIRD INDEPENDENT SOURCE, AND IT CLOSES A READING.** *The* «Nativitatis» *block read across all ten Defranceschi-headed pages gives:* **1764 · 1766 · 1768 · 1772 · 1779 · 1789** *— then* ***nothing until 1803***, *then 1814, 1815, 1818, 1819.*

**The three books now agree and none was read for this question:**

| | |
|---|---|
| *Gračišće baptisms, Pater* **and** *Mater* | no Defranceschi parent, **1784–1808** |
| *Gologorica baptisms* | no Defranceschi baptism, **1788–1806** |
| *the 1826 census* | nobody born **1789 → 1803** |

**⭐⭐ IT RULES OUT «A THIRD PARISH».** *A child born elsewhere in 1792 is* **thirty-four** *in 1826 and in this census; one born in 1802 is* **twenty-four**. ***Neither is there, and nobody of that age is there at all.*** *For the third-parish reading to hold, every child of those twelve years would have had to be born away* **and never come home**, *while their parents stood godparent in two parishes throughout.*

**⭐ And the silence has a date at each end.** *[Maria Rosalia, born 20 July 1789](/person/maria-rosalia-defranceschi-1789/) — struck through on page 11, because she died in 1826, the year the book was made. [Maria Antonia, born 1791 and dead at six months that July](/person/maria-antonia-defranceschi-1791/), «mens. 6 · Vermes». Then [Hermenegildus, 4 October 1803](/person/hermenegildus-defranceschi-1803/) — whose date this archive already took from this very census.*

**⚠ The limit of a census, stated.** *It lists the living and resident: a child born in 1795 who died young, or a daughter married away before 1826, would not appear.* ***It corroborates the other two books rather than proving anything alone*** — *but it removes the one explanation they could not touch.* *[Told in full.](/gologorica-line/)*

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica STATUS ANIMARUM 1826, the «Nrus. Domus» column: the direction settled, and the renumbering is many-to-one
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-214, signatura 7.1 — Gologorica Status Animarum 1826, frames M01069315–M01069435 (title card to KRAJ)
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.what: Worklist 191: harvest the «Nrus. Domus» column end to end and settle which of the two figures is live, so a renumbering concordance can be built.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE DIRECTION IS SETTLED, AND IT IS THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT THIS ARCHIVE CONCLUDED.** *At twenty times magnification the* **upper** *figure carries a diagonal strike; the lower is left standing.* **20**→**27** *(p.19,* Domus Ecclesiæ*),* **35**→**64** *(p.43),* **30**→**64** *(p.44).* **`doc`**, *plated.* *[Correction published](/corrections/) — the old claim and the ordering argument behind it both fail, since the book is bound in the order of neither numbering.*

**⭐⭐ AND THE CONCORDANCE CANNOT BE A FORMULA.** *Pages 43 and 44 carry the same new number* **64** *with* «Nrus. Inquilinorum» **1** *and* **2**, *and different struck uppers* **35** *and* **30**. ***Two old houses became two tenant families of one new house.*** *The mapping is* **many-to-one**, *which is why no constant difference exists, and why* «36 vetus · 14 novus» *and the census pairs can run in opposite directions without either being wrong.* **A concordance here must be a lookup table keyed by HOUSEHOLD.**

**⭐ Structure of the book, for the next reader.** *M01069315 is the title card, M01069435 the* «KRAJ» *target, and* ***page N sits at frame M0106(9318+N)*** *— p.2 at M01069320, p.32 at M01069350, p.62 at M01069380.* *Pages 1–15 are a* «**civilitas**» *section before the house order begins.* ⚠ *[This archive had already read every Defranceschi-headed page of this census on 7 October](/searched/) and listed eight.* ***This walk adds two it missed*** *— p.14* «Jacobus Defranceschi» *and p.15* «Franciscus Xaverius Defranceschi» *(M01069332, M01069333) —* **so the count is ten, not eight.** *The established reading of those pages (houses named by whoever answered for them, seven of eight holding no household) stands and is not re-argued here.*

**⚠ THE COLUMN IS NOT HARVESTED END TO END, AND THIS ROW WILL NOT PRETEND IT IS.** *About sixty pages were read at a magnification that fits four to a sheet;* ***two of those readings proved wrong when re-cropped at twenty times*** *(«28» and «36» for what are* **35** *and* **30***), so none of the rest is stated here.* **Only the three cells read at 20× are published.** *⚠ A paper repair label physically covers the number column on several frames (M01069328–330, M01069362 among them).* ***Finishing this needs better images of one narrow column than this film carries*** — *a targeted DAPA request, not another pass over the same pixels.*

rows.src: ⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-215 — Gračišće BAPTISMS 1784–May 1808, the PARENTES block (Pater AND Mater) swept row by row: a clean nil
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-215, sig. 3.2 — Gračišće MKR 1746–1840, frames M01070190–M01070226
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.what: Close the SECOND half of the limit this archive flagged itself. Its warning named two hiding places — «a mother's maiden name or a godparent». The Patrini column was swept and gave twenty-one. This reads the Parentes block, Pater and Mater together, at four times the magnification of the original Pater pass.
rows.got:
**CLEAN NIL, and it is the useful kind.** *All thirty-seven frames, 1784 to May 1808, roughly nine hundred baptisms, Pater and Mater read row by row at 1500px per page-half.*

> **Not one Defranceschi father. Not one Defranceschi mother. Not one mother entered «olim Defranceschi».**

**⭐ The third clause is new and does real work.** *This register writes maiden names as routine —* «Maria Salamon **olim** Milotich», «Lucia Milotich **olim** Bergliaffa», «Mathia **olim** Pedignan», «Joanna Bitina **olim** Berbetich» — ***so a Defranceschi daughter married to a Gračišće man would be legible in that column.*** *None is. [That rules out «the daughters married in» as the explanation for this window.](/gologorica-line/)*

**⭐⭐ Set against [the twenty-one godparent appearances](/searched/), the shape is unambiguous:** *across* **twenty-four years** *the family is at this font twenty-one times and in the parents' columns* ***not once, in any of the three ways the register could have recorded them***.

**⭐⭐⭐ AND THE SAME HOLE IS IN THE OTHER PARISH.** *⚠ This row first said the children must have been baptised at Gologorica; [the archive's own folio-by-folio read of that book says otherwise](/searched/) —* «No Defranceschi child is baptised between **1788 and 1799**», «No Defranceschi baptism between **1799 and 1806**», *«but the family is on almost every page as* **godparents**». *[Corrected.](/corrections/)*

> ***For roughly fifteen years the Defranceschi baptise no children in EITHER parish, while standing at both fonts constantly, styled* cives *in both.*** *[Told on the line page.](/gologorica-line/)*

**✔ It also confirms the original *Pater* pass**, *which [was read «at contact-sheet magnification» and said so](/searched/). At four times that it agrees entirely.* ***A stated limit that turns out not to have mattered is still worth having stated.***

**⭐ Two decanal visitation marks not previously held**, *both in the Gračišće book:* «Revisus in Visitatione Decanali die **10ma Julii 1804**» *(M01070221) and* «…die **5.ta [Julii] 1805**» *(M01070222).* *With [the Anicich mark of 7 October 1807](/searched/) and [the Gologorica marks of 1804 and 1808](/searched/),* ***the dean signed these parishes off annually***, *and a deanery protocol is implied for every one of those years.*

*⚠ Also seen and not pursued: a* «Pater Ignotus», *a foundling* «exposita ex Territorio Petinensi», *and the noble* **Servulus Martinich / Francisca nata de Rapicio** *household recurring at least five times with Pazin godparents.*

rows.src: ⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-215 — the twenty-one Gračišće godparent entries DATED, 1791–1808, and the maiden-name test run
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm read from the family's own copy of the reel.
rows.what: Worklist 215, both halves: date each of the Defranceschi godparent entries found in the Patrini sweep, and test whether the register ever gives Theresia a maiden name.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ THE SERIES IS DATED. Twenty-one appearances, unbroken 1791–1808 but for 1803–05.** *Each frame's* «Annus» *heading and date column read against the Patrini cell on the same line. [The full table is on the line page.](/gologorica-line/)*

**Four people, not a crowd:** **Theresia** *×13 (1792–1806)*, **Joannes** *×5 (1794–1802)*, **Antonius** *×4 (1799–1808)*, *plus* **Joannes Baptista with Vincenca** *(13 May 1796)* *and* **Anna de Franceschi**, «Nobiles Pisinenses» *(13 Feb 1791)*.

**⚠⚠ THIS ROW'S OWN CORRECTIONS WERE THEMSELVES WRONG, AND ARE WITHDRAWN.** *It reported the 16 October 1798 godmother as* «Catharina Defranceschi» *and re-dated four entries to 1802.* ***Both are wrong***: *re-cropped at twenty times with the mother's cell alongside, the word is* «**Theresia**» — *the first reading was right — and the entries are* **1801**. *[The apparent «disorder» between M01070217 and M01070218 was a misread page header and does not exist.](/corrections/)* **There is no Catharina at Gračišće; the 1785 Gologorica Catharina is untouched, and the bridge built between them is withdrawn.**

**❌ THE MAIDEN-NAME TEST FAILS, and that is the useful half.** *[The plan was to find one entry reading* «Theresia Defranceschi **nata Grach**»](/worklist/). *All twenty-one Patrini cells were re-read:* ***the godparent column gives bare names*** — *never a* nata *or* olim — *though it does carry* «vidua», «filia», «uxor» *when it wants them, and the* **Mater** *column writes maiden names as routine.* **So the omission is the scribe's habit for married women, not damage, and this book cannot settle the identification.** *The question moves to the Gračišće marriage books MKV 1194/1195, or the house-5* Status Animarum.

**⚠ Open:** *the 1803–05 gap (M01070219–M01070222 carry none) is not explained; and the year headings on M01070217 (1802) and M01070218 (1801) sit opposite to their folio order, which [this book's documented disorder](/gologorica-line/) may or may not cover.*

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-215 — Gračišće BAPTISMS 1783–May 1808, the PATRINI column swept row by row (M01070190–M01070226): ~20 Defranceschi, all «cives»
rows.film: DAPA ZM34K-215, signatura 3.2 — Gračišće MKR 1746–1840, frames M01070190–M01070226
rows.waypointNote: No FamilySearch waypoint: DAPA microfilm, read from the family's own copy of the reel. Recorded by signatura and frame range.
rows.what: Close the gap this archive flagged itself and left open: the 1783–1808 ruled half had only its PATER column read, and the log said in writing that «a Defranceschi could stand as … a godparent». Read the Patrini column of all 37 frames.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐⭐ THE GAP WAS REAL AND IT WAS FULL.** *The* **Pater** *column nil stands — [not one Defranceschi father in ~900 baptisms](/errands/).* ***The Patrini column of the same frames holds about twenty Defranceschi appearances.***

| who | times | conditio |
|---|---|---|
| «**Theresia Defranceschi**» | ~**13** | **Cives** |
| «**Antonius Defranceschi**» | **4** | **Cives** |
| «**Joannes Defranceschi**» | **4** | **Cives** |
| «**Joan: Bapta**» + «**Vincenca Defranceschi**» | **1** *(13 May 1796, M01070209)* | **cives** |
| «**Anna de Franceschi**» | **1** *(13 Feb 1791, M01070200)* | ***Nobiles Pisinenses*** |

**Frames carrying the surname:** *M01070200, 203, 204 (×2), 206 (×2), 209, 211 (×2), 212, 213, 215, 216, 217 (×3), 218, 223, 225, 226.* *Three re-read at six times on M01070217 and certain.*

**⭐⭐ The conditio column is the finding.** *This register grades godparents —* rustici, villici, agricolæ, supani, judices, cives, nobiles. *The Defranceschi are* «**Cives**» *almost every time, and carry* ***no place-epithet at all*** — *unlike [the previous book, which labels them* «Gollagoriciensis» *five times over](/gologorica-line/).* **In 1746–1808 they are of the place.**

**⚠ SO A PUBLISHED CONCLUSION IS WITHDRAWN.** «The family was not established at Gračišće in the eighteenth century» *was drawn from the father column alone.* ***Corrected to:*** *the Defranceschi were at Gračišće as* **cives** *continuously from at least* **1791 to 1808**, *and in those eighteen years had* **not one child baptised there**. *[Published as a correction.](/corrections/)*

**⭐ A candidate identification, flagged as inference.** *[The archive already holds a* «**Theresia Defranceschi nata Grach**», *wife of Joannes Baptista of Gologorica casa 31, entered* «Cives»](/gologorica-line/) — *mother of the boy who becomes [head of Gračišće house 5](/direct-line/).* ⚠ *Her Grach are placed at* **Krbune**, *not Gračišće, so this is* `inf` *with a live objection. [Test raised.](/worklist/)*

**⭐ Also new:** «**Revisus in Visitatione Decanali die 7ᵐᵃ 8bris 1807 — Petrus Anicich, Cæs. Reg. Parochus et Decanus**» *(M01070225) — the same dean who signs the* **Gologorica** *books on 25 June 1808, now signing* **Gračišće** *nine months earlier. One decanal round, two parishes, one protocol to ask for.*

**⚠ Limits.** *Read at working magnification, three verified at six times. Precise dates not taken for most — page-year headings give 1791, 1794, 1795, 1796, 1799, 1805, 1806, 1807, 1808. No descent traced to the direct line here.*

rows.src: ⭐⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-215 — Gračišće BAPTISMS 1667–1745 (sig. 3.1), swept frame by frame — COMPLETE, 188 frames
rows.what: Verify this archive's own claim that the whole 1667–1745 Gračišće baptism book was read leaf by leaf and the surname occurs five times in it — Count Damian in 1720, Presbiter Philippus in 1734, and a Defranceschi of Gologorica standing godparent in 1733, 1743 and 1744.
rows.got:
**✔ COMPLETE. M01069943–M01070130 — 188 frames, every one read, none skipped, none sampled.** *Title page to the film's* «KRAJ · END OF ITEM» *card.* ***This row began as a verification of [the archive's own claim that the book had been read leaf by leaf and the surname occurs five times](/worklist/). All five are now verified on the page, and no sixth exists.***

**THE FIVE, EACH CHECKED AGAINST THE REGISTER:**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **25 Mar 1720**, f.117 | «Domini Comitis **Damiani de Franceschis** ac Ursulæ eius coniugis» | ✔ as published |
| **8 Jan 1733**, f.138 | «**Joana Uxor Sup.ni Joanis Bapt.æ Defranceschi**» | ✔ as published |
| **19 Mar 1734**, f.138 | «**Presbiter Philippus de Franceschi** Baptizavit» | ✔ — *father corrected* «Marinich»→«**Martinich**» |
| **26 Jun 1743**, f.158 | «**Joanna uxor Suppani Jo: Baptistæ Defranceschi de Golagoriza**» | ✔ — *preposition corrected* «à»→«**de**» |
| **5 May 1744**, f.160 | «**D.nus Joannes Petrus Defranceschi** et Mattia uxor **Suppani** Joannis Grach» | ✔ — *corrected* «supradicti»→«**Suppani**»; *child named* **Joanna** |

*[Three published transcription errors found and withdrawn](/corrections/), each settled by the same hand writing the same word elsewhere rather than by staring.*

**⭐⭐⭐ AND THE BACK OF THE BOOK HELD EVIDENCE THIS ARCHIVE HAD LISTED AND NEVER READ.** *⚠ The rolls were [recorded from the film's title card on 30 September](/direct-line/) —* «MATIČNA KNJIGA **KRIZMANIH** 1690-1694». ***What is new is the reading, not the existence.*** *Folios 165–175 are* **two confirmation roll-calls**, **16 [7bris] 1690** *(Bishop* **Joannes Marcus Rossetti**) *and* **15 June 1694** *(Bishop* **Petrus Antonius Delle de Hohenberg**, *numbered to 74).* ***No Defranceschi child and no Defranceschi sponsor in either.*** *A confirmation roll is the parish's children gathered on one day in the bishop's presence — [which does not share the weakness the 1732 visitation exposed in the baptism half](/gologorica-line/), where entries were admitted to have been omitted through negligence.* **[Told in full.](/gologorica-line/)**

**⚠ The nil, stated exactly.** *Through two confirmation roll-calls and seventy-eight years of baptisms, the Defranceschi appear* **five times, every one as a visitor, never as a household of the parish**. *The baptism half's nil carries the 1732 decree with it; the confirmation rolls' nil does not need to.*

**⚠ Limits of this read, recorded because they are real.** *The 1690 and 1694 rolls are several hundred lines of small contracted hand:* **the name was looked for line by line on every leaf and not found**, *which is a careful reading and not a transcription.* *The baptism half was read entry by entry at full magnification.*

**⚠ Three frame-pairs are two exposures of ONE opening** — *M01070086/87 (f.137), M01070093/94 (f.143), M01070116/117 (f.164v–165), each re-shot with a loose slip moved.* ***The film's frame count is not the book's leaf count.***

*Also recovered in the sweep: [the 1732 visitation decree and the block of late entries that obeyed it](/gologorica-line/); [the sign-off* «Revisum in Visitatione &c. die 5. Maij 1745»](/gologorica-line/); *[three more children of the judge's household and the rota that stood for them](/gologorica-line/); [four bishops of Pedena in one volume](/gologorica-line/); and [a Capuchin letter-cover addressed to Fiume on the last written leaf](/worklist/).*

rows.src: ⭐⭐ A «Smrtni list» sent to David by a Defranceschi — Grga Defranceschi, d. Zagreb 11 November 1931, OLD CATHOLIC
rows.what: A photograph of a death certificate, passed to David by a Defranceschi and read here.
rows.got:
**A certified «Prepis» of an entry in** «**matica umrlih hrvatske Staro-katoličke župe sv. Križa u Zagrebu**», **svez. I, str. 13, br. 17**.

«**Grga Defranceschi**, bravar kod sekcije **Držav. željeznica u Zagrebu**» — a fitter with the State Railways. Died «jedanaestoga novembra, Hiljadu devetstotina trideset i prve» — **11 November 1931**. Spouse «**Marija rodj. Lovrencin, supruga mu**». Born «**Ližnjan (Istra)**». Resident and died at «**Zagreb, Mošćenička ul. 12**». Religion «**starokatolička**».

**⭐ TWO THINGS THE ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE.** (1) **Grga is a new person** — no Grga, and no Defranceschi death of 1931, was on the books. (2) **«starokatolička» appears nowhere else here**: the Croatian Old Catholic Church, founded 1923, kept its **own registers outside the Roman Catholic system this archive has been walking**. Raised as its own row.

**⭐ And it fills an empty row.** «Marija Lovrencin / Lorencin (Defranceschi)» was on the roster from David's tree with **no dates, no place, no note**. She is now the named widow of a man with a date, a trade, a street and a parish.

**⚠ The form is a re-issue.** The printed «KRALJEVINA JUGOSLAVIJA … Banovina Savska» is overstamped «**Hrv. st. katolička Crkva · Nezavisna Država Hrvatska**», and the header reads «Za regulisanje penzije kod Financijske direkcije» — **so the copy was drawn under the NDH, 1941–45, for a pension claim on a death of 1931**. The document is evidence of two moments, not one.

**⚠ NOT READ: his birth date.** The row «dan, mjesec i godina rodjenja» is **below the bottom edge of the photograph**. Only the place is legible. A second photograph taken lower would give it; raised.

**⚠ Not claimed:** any link to the «Gregorio Defranceschi, 1822, Ližnjan» already on the books. Grga is the Croatian form of Gregorius, so they share a name — and a man dying in 1931 is not one born in 1822.

rows.src: ⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-215 — Gračišće BAPTISMS 1746 – May 1808 SWEPT IN FULL (M01070132–M01070226): six Defranceschi, all godparents, five «of Gologorica»
rows.what: Worklists 204 and 206: sweep the whole filmed Gračišće baptism register for the surname — the prose half frame by frame at full magnification, the ruled half by its Pater column.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ THE WHOLE FILMED BOOK IS READ.** Fifty-eight prose openings one at a time (M01070132–M01070189) plus thirty-six ruled-table frames (M01070190–M01070226). **1746 to May 1808**, roughly fifteen hundred baptisms.

**SIX occurrences of the surname. NOT ONE as a parent.**

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| 12 Mar 1747 | M01070137 | «Joannes Petrus de Franceschi» — for **Judge Ignatius Martinich**'s son |
| 2 Apr 1750 | M01070142 | «Josephus de Franceschi **Gollagoriciensis**» — for the same couple's son, **christened «Joannes Petrus»** |
| 6 Feb 1752 | M01070145 | «D.na **Elena** uxor D.ni Josephi Defranceschi … **Gollagoritia**» — same couple |
| 16 Feb 1755 | M01070150 | «Petrus Defranceschi **a Gollagoriza**» — for **Michael Grach**'s daughter |
| 13 Apr 1766 | M01070164 | «Antonius Defranceschi **ex Gollagorizia**» |
| 8 Jun 1783 | M01070183 | «**Joannes Bapta et Helena Defranceschi Gollogoricienses**» — for **Judge Franciscus Martinich**'s son |

**⭐⭐ Five of six carry an «of Gologorica» epithet** — the register says in five separate hands that these people came from the other village. **Four of six stand for the Martinich village judges**, across forty years and two generations, counting the 1744 entry this archive already held from the previous book.

**⭐ Helena's life gets 52 years longer:** known from one line of a death register in 1804, she is now a married «Domina» standing godmother at Gračišće in **1752**. The 1783 pair are very likely her and her son Joannes Baptista — **labelled an inference, not proved**.

**⚠ So «Gallignana house 5» is not where the line came from**, and the family had not settled at Gračišće by 1808. The arrival is after the film breaks.

**⚠ Limits:** six hits in ~1,500 entries is a count a single tired page could change; every frame is named above so any of them can be rechecked. The prose half is also flagged «WATER DAMAGE» by the filmers.

rows.src: ⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-215 — Gračišće BAPTISMS, the PROSE half swept frame by frame (M01070132–, in progress): the first Defranceschi, and he is «Gollagoriciensis»
rows.what: Worklist 206: sweep the pre-1783 prose half of the Gračišće baptism book, which has no column a surname can be read down, one frame at a time at full magnification.
rows.got:
**⭐ THE FIRST DEFRANCESCHI IN THE BOOK: 12 March 1747** (M01070137). «Franciscus Gregorius filius legitimus **Judicis Ignatij** [Martinich] et Luciæ uxoris ejus baptizatus est à me Canᵒ Vito Drusetich. Patrini fuerunt **Joannes Petrus de Franceschi** nec non **Joanna uxor Judicis Joannis Salamon**.»

**⭐⭐⭐ THE SECOND, 2 April 1750** (M01070142), and it carries the word that matters: «Joannes Petrus filius legitimus judicis Ignatij Martinich et Lucia jugalium … Patrini fuerunt **Josephus de Franceschi GOLLAGORICIENSIS** et Maria Milotich uxor Gregorij.»

***«Gollagoriciensis» — of Gologorica.*** Taken with [no Defranceschi father anywhere in the book from 1746 to 1808](/gologorica-line/), the mid-century Defranceschi at Gračišće are **visitors from Gologorica**, not residents. This archive has treated Gračišće as the origin and Gologorica as the second home; the register of 1750 points the other way.

**⭐⭐ And the same household asked them three times in six years, then named a child after one.** 5 May 1744 (folio 160, previous book, already held here) — «D.nus Joannes Petrus Defranceschi et Mattia uxor … Joannis **Grach**» at the baptism of Ignatius Martinich and Lucia's **daughter**. 12 March 1747 — Joannes Petrus stands for their **son**. 2 April 1750 — their next son **is christened «Joannes Petrus»**.

**Co-godparents across the three: a Grach wife, and twice «Joanna uxor Judicis Joannis Salamon»** — both married-in surnames of this family, Salamon seventy-two years before Francisca Salomon married into the direct line.

**Checked before writing:** both frames and the epithet «Gollagoriciensis» return **nothing** anywhere in the archive; «Joannes Petrus Defranceschi» is an existing roster row that carried **no note at all** and now carries three dated appearances.

**⚠ Not claimed:** that either godfather is an ancestor of this line — no entry gives a father, age or house; that the two men are related; or that one epithet on one day describes the whole surname.

**⚠ IN PROGRESS:** frames M01070132–M01070143 read; **M01070144–M01070189 still to do.**
rows.pages: M01070132–M01070143 read in full at full magnification; M01070137 and M01070142 read closely

rows.src: Is Gračišće 1808–1840 free anywhere? — asked again, and the archive had answered it four ways already
rows.what: David asked whether the Gračišće baptisms of 1808–1840 — the stretch [the film breaks before](/gologorica-line/) — can be reached free online instead of by letter.
rows.got:
**⚠ VERIFICATION, NOT A SEARCH. The answer was on file and no new query was run.**

| | |
|---|---|
| **15 Sept** | all **3,488 FamilySearch collections** walked — Gračišće, Gologorica and Pićan filmed nowhere; Austria and Hungary tested by name against a control |
| **22 Sept** | Record Atlas harvest of FamilySearch's **open browse endpoint** — 1,733 collections, 4.25M volumes, **0 hits** for Gračišće / Gallignana / Gracisce |
| **15 Sept** | **Matricula Online, the whole portal** — **Croatia is not on it at all**; twelve countries, no Croatian section |
| **15 Sept** | **ARHiNET** (arhinet.arhiv.hr) — does not resolve at all; second attempt, second nil |
| **6 Oct** | re-verified; absent list extended to the whole DAPA ZM34K parish set (+ Cerovlje, Lindar). **«ZM34K-216 cannot be short-circuited.»** |

**And [errand 35](/errands/) was already drafted** — reel **ZM34K-216**, frames **M01070239–M01070310**, a Croatian letter, and the note that the family already holds ZM34K-214 and 215 from the same series. Unsent, and staying unsent under the standing hold.

**⭐ What this re-check DID produce:** the draft was missing an entry. «**Joanna**, born **25 June 1818**, Gallignana house **4**» is on the same reel and would name her father; she is now in the ask and in the Croatian text. And the sweep of the filmed half — no Defranceschi father in 36 frames, 1783–May 1808 — means the missing reel is where the family's **arrival** at Gračišće should become visible, which is a better reason to ask for it than two baptisms.

**⚠ And a correction came out of it:** this session published «NASTAVLJA SE» as a discovery an hour earlier. Errand 35 already had it in those words. Fifth instance in three days; [published, with the specific failure named](/corrections/).

rows.src: ⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-215 — Gračišće BAPTISMS «1746–1840» swept for the surname: the book stops at May 1808 and the film says so
rows.what: Worklist 204: find the FIRST Defranceschi in the Gračišće baptism register, to date the family's arrival there.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ THE BOOK DOES NOT REACH 1840 ON THIS FILM.** M01070226 is the last page of register, ending «18 Maij» 1808. **M01070227 is a filmed target reading «NASTAVLJA SE · TO BE CONTINUED».** The last ten frames of reel 215 are a trailer — a laboratory card, then title cards for Gologorica Status Animarum 1862/1894/1921 and both Gračišće baptism books — then blank film.

**⚠ This corrects the archive's own frame map**, which assigned M01070131–M01070236 to the book. Corrected to M01070131–M01070226, with the trailer described as its own entry. The ink-coverage scan that built the map finds title cards; a «NASTAVLJA SE» target is not one.

**⭐ THE SWEEP, AND ITS TERMS.** The *Pater* column read across **thirty-six consecutive frames, M01070190–M01070226** — 1783 to May 1808, roughly **nine hundred baptisms**. **Not one Defranceschi father.** The column is full of the surnames this family would marry — Salamon, Fernasar, Sestan — with Picot, Milotich, Miandrusich, Lanza, Brosan, Bursich, Zulle, Poldrugovaz, Vuxa, Jerbula, Dermit, Cincopan, Vlahovich, Carlin, Scubla, Marletta, Berdebich, Zruselich.

**⚠ NAMED GAP, NOT A NIL:** before about 1783 the book is **continuous Latin prose** with no column to read down, and the leaves carry the filmers' label «**WATER DAMAGE · OŠTEĆENO OD VLAGE**». Frames M01070132–M01070189 are **unswept** and raised as their own row.

**⭐⭐ AND A CERTIFICATE LOOSE IN THE BOOK (M01070134) CONFIRMS THE DIOCESE FROM A SECOND PARISH.** Letterhead: «**Diocesi di Trieste - Capo d'Istria nel Litorale austriaco**», «**Distretto di Pisino**». A «Fede di Nascita» for Pietro, son of the late Martino Krisman and Maria née Jerach, born at **Scopliaco** (parish of Gallignana) house **11** on **28 June 1836**, baptised by **Don Antonio Scubla**; godparents Giovanni Runco and his wife Mattea; midwife Maria Trelesco. Issued at Gallignana **25 March 1867**, signed **Mattia Zimmermann, Parroco**. **This is nine years earlier than the Dobrila signature at Gologorica that established the diocese on 6 October, and from a different parish and a different kind of document.** Two Gračišće parish priests newly named; «Scopliaco» raised for the gazetteer.
rows.pages: M01070190–M01070226 (Pater column, all 36); M01070194–M01070195 and M01070134 read in full; M01070227–M01070236 identified as trailer

rows.src: ⭐⭐ DAPA ZM34K-215 — Gračišće (Gallignana) BAPTISMS 1746–1840, frames M01070190–M01070201: 1783–1792 read for the surname
rows.what: Get at the generation above Joannes Baptista Defranceschi (b. 13 Aug 1787, «Gallignana house 5») without an errand: a baptism names a father, and the Gračišće baptism book is on reel 215, which this archive holds.
rows.got:
**⚠⚠ HIS BAPTISM IS NOT IN THE REGISTER.** M01070195, headed «Annus 1787», runs 27 July → 2 September unbroken. Between 30 July and 23 August it holds **three** entries: 30 July h.196 Josephus, father «Josephus **Fernasar**»; an entry of ⟨—⟩ August h.179 Francisca, father «Georgius Limatich», **struck through and annotated «rescissa»**; and 23 August h.96 Josephus, father «Mathæus Vojscovich». **No 13 August, and no Defranceschi.**

**⭐⭐ AND NO DEFRANCESCHI FATHER IN THE DECADE.** Father column read across **twelve consecutive frames, M01070190–M01070201** — roughly **300 baptisms, 1783–1792**. Recurring surnames: **Salamon** (Joannes, Maria, Josephus, Barbara), **Fernasar** (Josephus, Georgius, Maria, Appolonia), **Sestan** (Joannes, Antonius, Joanna), Picot, Milotich, Miandrusich, Lanza, Brosan, Bursich, Zulle, Poldrugovaz, Vuxa, Jerbula. **Not one Defranceschi.**

**⭐⭐⭐ Against this archive's own count of FIVE occurrences in the whole 1667–1745 Gračišće book**, that makes the family **not established at Gračišće in the eighteenth century**. «Gallignana house 5» is somewhere the line ARRIVED, between 1792 and 1819. Raised as its own row.

**⚠ Limits of the nil, stated:** the **father** column was read, at contact-sheet magnification; a Defranceschi could stand as a mother's maiden name or a godparent, and [one pair does in 1808](/gologorica-line/). ~25 entries per page in a small hand. **«None seen in twelve frames» is the claim; «none exists» is not.** And the 13 August 1787 date is itself from a Status Animarum, not a register.

**Also seen:** the original certificate at the foot of M01070195 — «Exhib. In Visitatione **Spirituali Gallignianæ** die 24 Aprilis», signed «M. Bruñus Francovich … Cancel. Epis.» and «P. Petr. Martinus Hocovich … Cancell. Visit.» — the parish's own copy of the 1788 spiritual visitation this archive knows only through Orbanić's printed edition.
rows.pages: M01070190–M01070201 (father column, all twelve); M01070194–M01070195 read in full

rows.what: Read the Gračišće house 5 Status Animarum this archive already holds, to find Francisca born 3 February 1819 who came from «Parochia Gallignana sub N.ᵒ 5».
rows.got:
**⚠ FIRST: the page was already transcribed in full on the direct-line page, all seven names.** This is a verification, not a find.

**⭐ What reading it adds — FRANCISCA IS NOT ON IT.** The couple's children run **1823, 1825, 1829, 1830/36, 1833, 1840** and the marriage is **1819**. A daughter born 3 February 1819 is not theirs. So «Gallignana house 5» points at the **generation above** Giovanni Battista — the one this archive holds only from the family chart, not from a register page. Work-list 202 retargeted.

**⚠⚠ TWO INTERNAL CONTRADICTIONS**, found by setting three files against one image: the plate caption says Joan. Bapt. died **1 September 1846** where the direct-line page transcribes **14. Sept. 1846**; the direct-line page gives Regina Theresia **1830** where her roster row gives **1836**. **Neither is resolvable from the photocopy held** — reel ZM34K-217 is not one this archive owns. Raised as its own row; the plate caption now states the doubt.

**⭐ Two people move from inference to document:** Raymundus de Franceschi (1823) and Regina Theresia de Franceschi (1836) both carried «tree-derived: no register has been read for this person here». This is a register page and it names them both, with father, mother and house. Both notes corrected.

**⚠⚠ AND THE SERIOUS ONE.** Joanna's Gračišće **house 4**, her marriage of 13 February 1843 and the «two brides in three years» pattern — all published here yesterday as new — were **documented in this archive on 30 September** on her own roster row, from the same frame. Third instance in two days. Published as a serious correction.

**⭐⭐ COMPLETE. All ~119 openings, M01069319–M01069434** (M01069435 is the film's «ITEM» end target). Every entry gives a place, the house number at the far end, and a year.

**Gračišće 16** (Gallignana houses 4, 5, 24, 32, 50, 86, 89, 92) · **Paz 9** (5, 7, 9, 13, 24, 28, 41, 83) · **Novaki 8** (2, 25, 42, 54, 62, 93, 95) · **Krbune 6** (4, 15, 23, 33) · **Gradinje 6** (8, 9, 20, 24, 27, 28) · **Pazin 4** (84, 89) · **Cerovlje 3** (20, 46) · **Draguć 3** (12, 17) · **Lindar 2** · **Dol 2** · **Žminj 1** (56) · **Vrsar 1** · **Volosca 1** · plus **9 moves inside Gologorica** (houses 2, 21, 24, 32, 40, 42, 49, 55).

**⭐⭐ Gračišće wins by nearly two to one — and it is this archive's own origin parish.** The two villages were one marriage market, not a line's origin and its destination. Raised as its own row.

**⚠ Krbune comes back: six times**, with four house numbers. The superlative withdrawn this morning stays withdrawn (six against sixteen), but Krbune is the fourth-equal partner and the row keeps its place on merit.

**⚠ The leader changed three times while this was being built** — Krbune, Paz, Gračišće, Gračišće. Only the last is a finding; two of the others were published mid-count and withdrawn. Method note added.

**Method, so the numbers can be checked:** the column was taken off every frame in contact sheets at moderate magnification and read where the hand is plain. **Counts are «at least»** — faint and part-legible cells were **excluded rather than guessed**, and several read only «ex Parochia sub N.ᵒ …» with no parish named. The ranking is robust to that; the exact figures are not.

**Named nil:** no Defranceschi appears by surname anywhere in the column — it names households by house number — so only the two Gallignana brides already recorded are matched to this family.

rows.src: ⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica STATUS ANIMARUM 1826, the «Locus ex quo vel ad quem» column (M01069323): the half of the opening this archive had not been reading
rows.what: Worklists 184, 194, 196 and 197 had all been chasing where two Defranceschi brides came from. Before opening another book, read the half of the census opening the search log itself recorded as unread.
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ THE ANSWER WAS IN THE COLUMN.** M01069323, right-hand half, printed heading «**Locus ex quo vel ad quem**», bracketed across Antonius Sestan and his wife with the marriage date «**13 Februarii 1843**»:

> «**Ex Parochia Gallignanæ sub N.ᵒ 4**»

**«Joanna uxor nata Defranceschi», b. 25 June 1818, came from Gračišće house 4.** Her counterpart **Francisca** came from **house 5** — two adjacent houses, two brides, three years apart, and house 5 is this archive's direct line.

**⚠⚠ AND HALF OF THIS WAS ALREADY HERE.** Francisca's origin, her house number and the marriage-inside-the-surname were recorded on **30 September**, sourced to M01069328 — the frame this walk had open. Two work-list rows were raised yesterday to find what the archive already held, and a published sentence claimed the archive «cannot yet name» the other Defranceschi family. **Withdrawn as a serious correction**; row 196 withdrawn, 197 rewritten, 184 closed, and two method notes added.

**The structural lesson, which is the bigger gap:** an opening of this census is ONE table across two pages — left = names, rank, birth; right = confirmation, marriage, death, «Locus ex quo vel ad quem», vaccination. **This archive has been reading the left half.** ~119 openings remain unread on the right. Raised as its own row.

**Also opened, and new:** the **Gračišće MKR 1746–1840** on reel ZM34K-215 (M01070131–M01070236), which has **no search row in this archive at all**. Sampled at M01069212 (1797–98) and **M01070226**, the opening headed «Annus 1807» running into 1808, page 186–187: at **8 February 1808**, house 253, the baptism of Lucia, daughter of Antonius Lanza Ceresnar and Mathæa née Pernich, the godparents are «**Antonius Defranceschi**» and «**Theresia Defranceschi**», condition «**cives**», priest Joannes Martinich. **Not a discovery of Defranceschi at Gračišće** — that is the archive's origin parish and the 1667–1745 book was walked leaf by leaf long ago — **but this volume had never been opened, and these two are not matched to anyone on the books.**
rows.pages: M01069323 (right half, read closely); Gračišće MKR 1746–1840 sampled at M01070212, M01070220, M01070226, M01070232

rows.src: ⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica BAPTISMS 1784–1880, folios 67–69 (M01069080–M01069082): 1816–1819 read entry by entry
rows.what: Worklists 194 and 196: find the baptisms of «Joanna uxor nata Defranceschi, b. 25 Junii 1818» and «Francisca uxor n. Defranceschi, b. 3 Februarii 1819», which would name their fathers.
rows.got:
**⚠⚠ BOTH ABSENT, and the register is CONTINUOUS across both dates.** Folio 67 runs 24 Dec 1816 · «Anno 1817» · 25 Feb · 6 May · «Anno 1818» · **1 March 1818** · **2 July 1818**. Folio 68: 12 Sept · 30 Sept · 12 Oct · **17 Nov 1818**. Folio 69: **6 March 1819** · 23 May · 15 June · 25 July · 11 Aug (twins). **25 June 1818 and 3 February 1819 both fall inside dated, unbroken runs.**

**The obvious objection was tested before this was written.** Six baptisms a year looks far too few for a village numbering houses to 119, and the suspicion was that only half of each opening had been read. **It had not been** — the facing page carries the SAME entries continued («Nomen et Cognomen Patrinorum», «Status Baptizati», «Conditio Patrinorum», «Nomen et Cognomen Obstetricis», the priest), not a second set. The register is genuinely thin in the famine years.

**⭐ So both Defranceschi brides married into Gologorica from OUTSIDE** — for a one-name study, evidence of a second Defranceschi population within marrying distance. Raised as its own row.

**⭐ «Mathea uxor Leonardi Defranceschi» stands godmother FOUR times in 1819** (23 May, 25 July, 11 Aug ×2), and the «Conditio Patrinorum» column reads «**Civis**» against her where it reads «Rust.» against the men beside her — «civis» doing social work twenty-nine years before it appears in the death register.

**⭐ «Stanislaus Brajuha *gradignensis*»** confirms Gradigna as a real neighbouring place, which the death book's «Extranei» list had left as an unidentified reading. Midwife throughout: «Oliva uxor Antonii Ancich **ex Rizmagnifa**».

**Also corroborated:** «Amalia Alexandra Josepha», b. 25 Feb 1818, bapt. 1 March, **house 17**, parents «Dⁿˢ Joseph Defranceschi et Dⁿᵃ Lambertina ejusdem uxor **nata Peschle**».

rows.src: ⭐ Catholic-Hierarchy, Wikipedia (Juraj Dobrila; Diocese of Pedena; Diocese of Poreč and Pula) — identifying the bishop who signed the Gologorica death book
rows.what: Worklist 185: «G. Dobrila, Ep.s» signed a canonical visitation at Gologorica on 7 July 1876, where every other inspection in 96 years is signed «Decanus». Which bishop, and — since he makes a canonical visitation of his own diocese — which diocese was Gologorica in?
rows.got:
**Juraj Dobrila (1812–1882): Bishop of Poreč–Pula 1857–1875, installed Bishop of Trieste and Capodistria 29 May 1875, died in office 13 January 1882.** So on 7 July 1876 his see was **Trieste**, and the signature names Gologorica's diocese.

**The chain, each link separately sourced:** the diocese of Pićan (Pedena) was **suppressed 20 August 1788**, its territory added to Gradisca; when Trieste was restored on **12 September 1791** the former Pićan territory **remained incorporated in it**; Poreč–Pula **gained territory from the diocese of Trieste on 17 October 1977**. This archive already held the first link from the other end — Orbanić's edition of de Buset's 1788 spiritual visitation covers Gologorica parish by parish «in the last year of the diocese of Pićan».

**Dobrila was born at Veli Ježenj, Tinjan parish** — about ten kilometres from Gologorica, the first Istrian Croat made a bishop.

**⚠ Consequence, and it corrects this archive:** the errand ref reading «MKR / MKU Pićan (Pedena), diocese of Poreč-Pula» was the present written over the past. The **diocesan** layer for every Gologorica register walked here is at **Trieste**, not Poreč or Pula. Corrected, and raised as its own row under the standing hold on letters.

**Not established and not guessed:** whether the pre-1977 Istrian diocesan material stayed at Trieste or moved with the parishes in 1977 — that is the first question any letter must settle. And why there is exactly one bishop in eighty-five years of deans.

rows.src: ⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS index, letters U–Z and «Extranei» (M01069309–M01069313): THE INDEX IS WALKED
rows.what: Finish the death book's index. The previous row left U–Z unread and said so.
rows.got:
**The index runs M01069299–M01069313 and the next frame is the film's own «KRAJ · END OF ITEM» target — so the book and its index are both read end to end.**

**⭐ The last column is headed «Extranei»** — six people who died in the parish and did not belong to it, each with where they came from: «ex Cerovglie» (p. 4), «ex **Cherbune**» (p. 13, illegitimate twins), «ex Gradigne» (p. 15), «ex Paas» (p. 41), «furlanus … ex Castro ⟨—⟩otti, **fossor**» (p. 48), «ex territorio **Cherbune**» (p. 53). **Krbune twice.** Pages 41, 48 and 53 are all famine-year pages.

**⭐ The index carries a fact the register does not.** Page 48 entry 17 reads «Petrus Chiuch ex Castro ⟨—⟩otti fossor», d. 6 March 1817, «annᵒ circiter 75», cause «Volvolus». The word «**furlanus**» is in the index only. Verified against the page (M01069252).

**Twelve Udovicich households** at houses 36, 41 *et* 102, 48, 64, 65, 66, 67, 69, 74, 75, 77, 79 — an unbroken run. **Nine Zabran** at 46, 47, 49, 50, 51, 52, 59, 73, 92. **Five Zajz** at 111–115. «Travaglia N.º 119» is the highest number in the index. «Zwey N.º 1» is the parish house (its entry is the priest's maidservant).

**«Udovicich Tulla N. 41 et 102» — one household, two house numbers**, the inverse of the six numbers carrying two households each.

**Two headings were revised in use:** «N.º 70 *nunc* Antonius», «N.º 48 *nunc* Blasius».

**«judex» three times as an office:** Zabran Ciglian N.º 47, Zajz Cucevar N.º 111, Zajz Cuevarich N.º 112.

**Named nil for this family:** no Defranceschi, Deprato, Grach, Jablich, Peschle or Orlis/Ortis block anywhere in U, V, Z, and none of the six «Extranei» is one. Terms looked for across U–Z: Defranceschi, De Franceschi, Franceschi, Deprato, De Prato, Grach, Grah, Jablich, Jablicich, Peschle, Peschel, Orlis, Ortis, Salomon.
