rows.got:
**Four Defranceschi entries in three frames, and a reading this archive is deliberately refusing to claim.**

**⭐ MATTHEA DEFRANCESCHI (1772–1858) gets her first document.** *Folio 103, 30 October 1841, house 2: at the baptism of* **Fortunatus Sestan** *the godparents are* «**Franciscus Defranceschi ac Matthea Defranceschi**», *the pair entered* **cives**. *She is sixty-nine and still being chosen. Until today she was a name off the family tree with an empty note.*

**⭐ BOTH SESTAN MEN OF HOUSE 2 MARRIED A DEFRANCESCHI.** *Joannes Sestan with* **Sancta Alexandra** *(sons Franciscus 1840, Fortunatus 1841); Antonius Sestan with* **Joanna**, *out of Gračišće house 4 — daughter* **Maria**, *folio 104.* *The same* **Franciscus Defranceschi** *stands godfather at both houses' baptisms.*

**⚠ AND THE REGISTER CONTRADICTS THE CENSUS ON JOANNA'S DAUGHTER.** *The 1826* status animarum *gives Maria born* **8 October 1843, house 3**; *the baptism register gives her born* **7 November 1843, baptised the 11th, house 2**. *The two month-numerals were compared against each other on the same page and are plainly different, so this is not a misreading here.* **Both are doc and the gap is left visible**, *because [the rule that the census records baptism dates](/gologorica-line/) does not close it.*

**⭐ A DATE MADE EXACT.** **Teresia Defranceschi**, *daughter of Antonius and Francisca, carried here as* «ABT 1843», *is* **born 14 November 1843, baptised the 15th**, *house 5.*

**⚠⚠ «ANTONIO SALAMON» — A SIGHTING, NOT A FINDING.** *Teresia's godparents are entered* «**Antonio Salamon** et Maria soror», *conditio* cives. ***This archive withdrew a «Salman» lead on the Salomon line four days ago, because the family proved to be PALMAN and a patronymic settled it.*** *The word here has* **not** *been tested against the same scribe writing Palman — and a specimen exists eleven folios earlier, «Franciscus Palman sutor» on folio 102 (M01069115, 28 April 1841), in the same hand.* **[Worklist 172](/worklist/) held the test — and it was run the same hour.**

**Also recorded:** *a seventh child of Franciscus Palman × Antonia née Brusich (folio 102, 28 April 1841), the father* **sutor** *again — consistent with the* «Sutor» *of 1825 and the* «Artifex» *of 1833.* *And a caution on Joannes Sestan's own trade, which the book gives four ways —* «sutor» *and* «lapicida» *struck on the draft folio 101,* «agricola» *on the fair copy folio 102,* **«textor»** *on folio 103.* **No trade is taken.**

rows.what: Settling whether the 1843 godfather «Antonio Salamon» is in fact another Palman, by comparing the two words in the same scribe's hand at one magnification — the test this archive's own method requires and which the withdrawn «Salman» lead did not get.

ev: The test, and the plate that shows it
Worklist 172 — closed; worklist 174 — what would make it a line
rows.got:
**The 1843 word is NOT Palman, and the archive now has a lead on the Salomon line that has survived its own test.**

*Both words were cut from the film at one magnification and set one above the other. [The plate is published](/gologorica-line/) so a reader can check the archive rather than take its word.*

| | Palman, 1841 | Salamon, 1843 |
|---|---|---|
| **initial** | *tall closed majuscule bowl, the same form as his* **B** *in* «Brussich» | *small low pointed stroke, no bowl* |
| **body** | *a · l · m · a · n* | *a · l · **a** · m · **o** · n* |
| **letters** | six | seven |

***The medial «a» between the l and the m is the clincher: Palman has nothing there.***

**WHAT IS ESTABLISHED:** *a man surnamed* **Salamon**, *entered* **civis**, *with* «Maria soror» *beside him, standing godfather to a Defranceschi child at Gologorica on 15 November 1843.* **A household, not a stray name.**

**⚠ WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED:** *any connection to Francisca Salomon's people at Gračišće. Nothing here ties him there.*

**⭐ AND THE METHOD POINT, which is why this row exists at all.** *The withdrawn «Salman» lead was published on 1 October, downgraded on 4 October and withdrawn on 5 October — six days of public error — **because it was written up before it was tested**. This one was tested before it was written up, and the whole of it took twenty minutes once the frames were open.* ***The test is not expensive. Skipping it is.***

rows.got:
**Seven Defranceschi mentions in two frames, and one of them states a relationship instead of listing a name.**

**⭐ «FRANCISCUS DEFRANCESCHI e MARIA SORELLA», both entered cives** *(folio 105, 1844).* ***Sorella*** *— Italian for sister, dropped into a Latin entry. So the Franciscus who keeps standing godfather on these pages has a sister Maria beside him.* *The only adult Franciscus-and-Maria Defranceschi sibling pair this archive can name at Gologorica in 1844 is* **Franciscus Xaverius Joseph (1816–1893)** *and* **Maria Aloysia (1811–1897)**, *Carlo's own brother and sister.* **(inf — and the pages say so.)** ***The weakness is published with it:*** *«the only pair this archive can name» is not «the only pair», and these very folios have produced three grown Defranceschi women the pedigree does not contain.*

**⭐ SANCTA ALEXANDRA'S THIRD CHILD** — «Josephus natus hodie», *21 March 1844, house 2.* **And by 1845 the register calls her «Sancta Sestan»**, *her married name — so a Defranceschi daughter vanishes from a name-indexed search the moment the priest decides she is established. Worth knowing by anyone searching these books.*

**⭐ JOANNA'S SECOND CHILD AGREES WITH THE CENSUS EXACTLY.** *Antonia, baptised 17 July 1845, born* «heri» *— the 16th; the 1826* status animarum *gives* **16 July 1845**. ***So the census is not generally unreliable about this family***, *and [the month-wide gap over her elder sister Maria](/gologorica-line/) is an anomaly in one entry rather than a property of the source. The question got sharper, not softer.*

**⭐ A TREE DATE GIVEN A REGISTER.** **Maria Defranceschi**, *daughter of Antonius and Francisca of house 5, «nata 18 hujus», baptised 20 July 1845 — the archive already held 18 July 1845 off the tree.* **Verification, not discovery**, *and the row had an empty note until today.*

**Also:** *Francisca and Matthea Defranceschi each stand godmother again; the mother of house 5 is written* «Francisca **n.** Defranceschi» *a third time.*

**NIL on the second surname, in the exact terms tried.** *Both frames were read for* **Salamon · Salomon · Salmon · Salaman** *in every column.* **Neither frame carries it.** *(The sweep for this name begins here and runs forward; folios 1–104 were read for Defranceschi and will need a second pass — [worklist 174](/worklist/) says so.)*

ev: «et soror Adelaidis» — the register places a woman the pedigree could not
rows.got:
**A godparent cell put a person into a family, which is not what godparent cells usually do.**

**⭐ «MAXIMILIANUS DEFRANCESCHI ET SOROR ADELAIDIS», cives** *(21 October 1847, house 7).* *[Adelaidis](/who/adelaidis-defranceschi/) has stood in this roster as* «tree-derived: no register has been read for this person here», *line* **unplaced**. *Her brother is* **Maximilianus Antonius Josephus, born 8 January 1828**, *son of Josephus and Lambertina — so she is their daughter, and the* «Maria Adelgidis» *the 1826 census lists sixth of their ten children is her.* ***And it is independent of the census***: *the census and the tree are two readings of one household, and nothing outside them said these two were siblings. A different priest, twenty-one years later, says it in three words.*

**⚠ It also opens a question, now [worklist 175](/worklist/): Anastasia (tree, b. 8 Dec 1824), Maria Adelgidis (census) and Adelaidis (roster, b. 1824) may be one child or two. Nothing merged — the December 1824 folios answer it and have not been re-read for a given name.**

**⭐ LEONARDUS DEFRANCESCHI — a birth and a death seventy years apart on one line.** «Januarii 23 · domus 5 · **LEONARDUS** natus **heri**» *of Antonius and Francisca, with* **«† 20.XII.1917»** *added beneath in a twentieth-century hand.* **Born 22 January 1847, died 20 December 1917** — *both years were already held off the tree with an empty note; both are now exact days.* **Verification.**

**⭐ A COHORT, AND IT POINTS AT ONE PARISH.** *A* **Lucia Defranceschi** *stands godmother in 1846; this roster holds a Lucia born* **1820 at Gračišće**. *With [Joanna](/who/joanna-defranceschi-sestan/) (b. 1818,* «Gallignanæ sub N.º 4») *and [Francisca](/person/francisca-defranceschi-1819/) (b. 1819,* «sub N.º 5»), *that is* ***three Defranceschi women of almost the same age, all out of Gračišće, all at Gologorica in the 1840s***. *Gračišće house 5 is the direct line's own second generation.* **(inf for Lucia; the other two are doc.)**

**Also:** *Sancta Alexandra's fourth child (Francisca, 7 February 1846) and two more for Joanna; Antonius Defranceschi standing godfather in his own right.*

rows.got:
**The baptism register has now given all five children of [Joanna née Defranceschi](/who/joanna-defranceschi-sestan/), and that is the first entry-by-entry test the 1826 *status animarum* has ever had in this archive.**

| child | census | register | |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Maria** | 8 Oct 1843 | **7 Nov 1843** | *a month apart* |
| **Antonia** | 16 Jul 1845 | **16 Jul 1845** | **exact** |
| **Catharina** | *— not listed —* | **1 Oct 1846** | *omitted by the census* |
| **Antonius** | 4 Jun 1849 | **4 Jun 1849** | **exact** |
| **Joannes** | 6 Jun 1852 | **6 Jun 1851** | *a year apart* |

**⭐ THE DAY OF THE MONTH IS RIGHT EVERY TIME.** *Where the two disagree they disagree on the* **month** *or the* **year**, *never the day — the signature of a figure miscopied when the household was written up, not of a source that guesses.* ***So a census date is strong evidence for the day and weaker for the month and year***, *and anyone leaning on one should say which part.* **⚠ And the census omits a child outright**, *so its list of a family's children is a floor and not a ceiling. This archive has been reading such lists as complete.*

**⭐ A marginal death of 1935** — «Joannes natus heri · **† 27/2 1935**» — *the latest this book carries, written eighty-four years after the baptism.*

**⭐ «About 1849» made a day:** **Antonia Defranceschi**, *daughter of Antonius and Francisca,* ***born 23 December 1849, baptised on Christmas Eve***, *house 5.*

**⚠ NIL — and a whole year of it.** *Folio 111 (M01069125) carries the entire year* **1850**: *fourteen baptisms, read entry by entry for* **Defranceschi · De Franceschi · Defrancesco · Franceschi · Francesco**, *Latin and Italian, in every column.* ***Not one sighting*** — *the first clear year of this walk without the name, in a village where it stood at four fonts the year before.*

rows.got:
**The man whose baptism opened this day's work turns up in it again, twenty-two years older.**

**⭐ «ENRICO DEFRANCESCHI ET SOROR ADELAIDIS», cives** *(13 March 1852, folio 113).* *That is* **[Enrichus Jacobus, born 11 March 1830](/who/henricus-jacobus-defranceschi/)** — *two days past his twenty-second birthday, alive at Gologorica and chosen to stand at its font, where this archive had him as a tree name with a death at Trieste in 1906 and nothing in between.* ***And the register calls him ENRICO.*** *Three hands now — the 1826 census, his own baptism, this —* **and not one writes the H.**

**⭐ It is also the third use of the «et soror» formula for this household**, *and the second time [Adelaidis](/who/adelaidis-defranceschi/) is named a sister — by a different brother. That is as firm as a godparent column gets.*

**⭐ TWO GERMAN NAMES IN THE PESCHLE HOUSE.** *«Julii 28 · domus 2 ·* **CONRADUS, JOSEPHUS ac VICTORIUS** *natus 20 hujus», of* **«Albertus Peschle, D.r Medicinæ, Civis»** *and* **«Victoria nata Calligarich»** *— a household [this archive already held from the census](/married-in/), so* **verification, not discovery**. *What is new: the baptism date, and the godparents* **«Cost. SCHROTT»** *and* **«Carolina WALSER»**.

*The 1822 evidence for [worklist 170](/worklist/) was one godmother read as* «ex Silesia» — ⚠ *[a misreading of* «**ex Volosca**», *corrected 11 October 2026](/corrections/), which withdraws the item.* ***What is here is two German surnames chosen by a Peschle household for its own child*** — *a circle rather than a visitor, and on its own it never pointed at Silesia.* **⚠ Neither name is Silesian in particular and neither is tied here to a place**, *and a physician in Habsburg Istria moved among German speakers as a matter of course.* *It strengthens the reason for the search without shortening it — and gives it two more surnames to try.*

**⭐ Joanna's sixth child, and the census out by two years:** **Franciscus**, *born and baptised* **31 January 1853**; *the census says* **31 January 1855**. ***Day and month exact, year two out*** — *the third failure of that exact shape in one household.*

**A sixth deanery visitation:** «Vidi. Petinae die **16 Januarii 1854**» — **Coverlizza, Decanus**.

ev: Three collisions, one book, and the case for opening the register of the dead
rows.got:
**Another «about» made a day, another marginal death — and the third unresolved death-year collision in this one family.**

**⭐ «Februarii 5ᵃ · domus 6 · ANTONIUS natus 3ᵃ hujus · † 17.II.1913»**, *of* «Antonius Defranceschi» *and* «Francisca nata Defranceschi»; *godparents* «Joannes Udovich et **Sancta Sestan**» — *[the Defranceschi daughter of house 2](/who/sancta-alexandra-defranceschi-sestan/) under her married name.* ***Born 3 February 1855 where the pedigree had «about 1853»***, *and a death from the margin where there was none.*

**⚠ AND IT COLLIDES.** *A second roster row,* `antonius-defranceschi-1855` *(MyHeritage, line «unknown», no place), has the same birth year and a death of* **1918** *against the register's* **1913**. **Not merged** — *[worklist 177](/worklist/) holds it.* ***That makes three unresolved death-year collisions in this family*** — *Clementina (1840 v 1870), Josephus Lambertus (1857 v 1878), Antonius (1913 v 1918) — and [all three are closed by the same ninety-one frames](/gologorica-line/).*

**⭐ Sancta Alexandra's sixth child**, «Maria nata heri», *30 June 1854, house 9. And by 1855 she is standing godmother herself as* «Sancta Sestan». ***Six children in fourteen years.***

**A sighting not identified:** «**Gius.e Defranceschi**» *stands godfather on 13 April 1854 with* «M. Ved. Clensich» *— a widow — both* **cives**. *Giuseppe is Josephus; [Josephus Lambertus, born 1808](/who/josephus-lambertus-defranceschi/), is the obvious candidate and is* **not claimed**, *because his own death year is one of the three in dispute.*

**Two more deanery visitations:** *Petinae,* **15 January 1855** *and* **12 January 1856**, *both* **Coverlizza, Decanus** — *eight recorded years running.*

**NIL on Salamon and on Peschle, in the exact terms tried**, *across both frames.*

Eight children, compared against the census
Worklist 168 — Krbune, confirmed a parish in its own right
rows.got:
**Two families finished, and the 1826 census's score settled.**

**⭐ [Joanna née Defranceschi](/who/joanna-defranceschi-sestan/) had EIGHT children, not the six the census names.** *Francisca (30 May 1856) and Catharina (1 October 1846) are both in the register and absent from the household page.* ***Of eight, the census names six, gets three exactly right, and is out on three by a month, a year and two years — never by a day.*** *[The full table is published](/gologorica-line/); it is the only entry-by-entry test the 1826* status animarum *has had here.* **A census list of a family's children is a floor, not a ceiling.**

**⭐ [Sancta Alexandra's seventh child](/who/sancta-alexandra-defranceschi-sestan/)**, *Franciscus, born 6 May 1857, with* **«† 18/1 1932»** *in the margin.* ***Seven children between 1840 and 1857***, *all documented today, for a woman who had a blank note, no husband and no children this morning.*

**⭐ A PRIEST OF KRBUNE AT THE GOLOGORICA FONT.** *«Franciscus P— **Ad.r PAR. CHERBUNIS**», 1 February 1858 — the administrator of Krbune, standing in for Milcetich.* *[Worklist 168](/worklist/) feared that Krbune's single bound volume might be a fragment, since the atlas lists one collection for it against thirty-two for Gračišće.* ***This shows Krbune with its own administrator, lending him to a neighbour — a parish that lends a priest keeps a register.*** **⚠ The priest's surname is NOT published**: *it reads* Pasnich, Papich *or* Bascich *and has had no second construction.*

**Three more deanery visitations** — *Petinae,* **15 Jan 1857**, **8 Jan 1858**, **7 Jan 1859**, *all* **Coverlizza, Decanus**. ***Nine consecutive years***, *which makes the visitation annual and its protocols a series.*

**NIL on Salamon and Peschle, in the exact terms tried**, *across all three frames.*

ev: A Peschle stands godfather by proxy, and the next generation opens at house 7
Her baptism, confirming both ends of a September correction
rows.got:
**The book turns a corner: after thirty years as godparents and wives, a Defranceschi is a father again — at house 7, his own father's house.**

**⭐ «1860. 9bris 4ᵃ · domus 7 · ANNA-MARIA FRANCISCA nata 28 8bris»**, *of* «**Franciscus Defranceschi, civis**» *and* «**Clotildis Ortis**», *midwife* «Catharina Cattenar», *with* **«† Tergesti 22-6-1941»** *added above by a later hand.* ***Both dates this archive already held — [a correction made on 13 September](/corrections/) — and the register agrees with both to the day.*** **Verification, and the page says so.** *New: the baptism date, the house, the midwife, the godparents.*

**⭐ A FOURTH PESCHLE, AND HE WAS NOT THERE.** *The godfather is* **«ANSELMUS PESCHLE … per procuratorem»** — ***by proxy***, *with* «Beatrice Ortis»; *both* **cives**. *This archive has never met an Anselmus Peschle. With [Lambertina](/who/lambertina-defranceschi-peschle/) (m. 1807), **Amalia «ex Volosca»** (1822) and **Dr Albertus**, physician of house 2 (1826–53), that is* ***four Peschle across fifty years at one small village*** — *one out of Volosca, one a doctor living at Pazin, one summoned in absentia.* **⚠ A family with reach and still not a family with an origin.** *A proxy godfather tells you he was away without telling you where. [Worklist 170 carried him; the one word of 1822 it rested on [reads* «**ex Volosca**»*](/corrections/) and the item is withdrawn.](/worklist/)*

**⭐ And the two Sestan households finish.** *[Sancta Alexandra's eighth child](/who/sancta-alexandra-defranceschi-sestan/) (Catharina, 24 June 1859) and [Joanna's ninth](/who/joanna-defranceschi-sestan/) (15 September 1859).* ***Between them the two Defranceschi daughters of house 2 bore fifteen children that this register names***, *where this archive held none at all at breakfast.*

**NIL on Salamon, in the exact terms tried**, *across both frames.*

ev: The page where a parish priest stops writing, and a son is called «possessor»
rows.got:
**A page that shows a man dying, a child dated, and a byname worth more than it looks.**

**⭐ THE PARISH PRIEST STOPS WRITING.** *«Petrus Milcetich, Parochus» signs the first six entries of 1862 and his last on* **13 March**; *from* **13 April** *every entry is* **«Blasius Zwölber, Administrator»**. *The 1826* status animarum *says Milcetich died* **22 March 1862**, *aged 58y 2m 15d.* ***The register brackets that date without naming it*** — *last signature nine days before, successor's first three weeks after.* **Two independent books, one man, and they agree** — *worth recording after [a day of finding places where they do not](/gologorica-line/).* *And for once the roll of priests and the hand in the book are the same list: Zwölber is one of the eight.*

**⭐ VICTOR JOSEPHUS DEFRANCESCHI, born 22 April 1862, baptised the 27th, house 7** — *of* «**Franciscus Xav. Defranceschi, POSSESSOR**» *and* «Clotildis Ortis»; *godparents* «Natalis Stefanovich» *and* «**Maria Defranceschi**», *cives.* *The pedigree had the year and nothing else.* **⚠ «Possessor» is new** — *a holder of property, where this family is elsewhere* **civis**. *One word on one line is not an estate and nothing is built on it, but it is the kind of word [the 1820 cadastre](/gologorica-line/) would answer.*

**⭐ Sancta Alexandra's ninth child**, *Elisabetha, 7 July 1862 — and her husband's word changes a fifth time, to* **possidens**. *[The book has given him four trades that do not agree and none is taken](/who/sancta-alexandra-defranceschi-sestan/).*

**⚠ «GRAH · MISSAN».** *Two women entered* «Mariana **Grah** / Missan» *and* «Cathar. **Grah** / missan», *the second word written beneath the surname in both.* **Byname or place is not settled and neither is claimed** — *this register writes bynames as* «Flegar **alias** Sidre» *and places as* «ex Cerouglie», *and this uses neither word, only position.* *Recorded for [worklist 168](/worklist/) because the Grah are the family behind the Krbune item and a second word on a common surname is what makes one findable.*

**NIL on Salamon and Peschle, in the exact terms tried**, *across both frames.*

---

**⚠⚠ `walked` WITHDRAWN, 5 October 2026, same day.** ***The crop used to read these frames cut the page at 62% of its height, and the written area runs further down.*** *It was found at folio 124 (M01069138), where six numbered entries stood below the crop; checking back showed the same on earlier folios — folio 89 has a sixth entry (Martinus Zajez, 12 November 1830) this archive never saw, and folio 90's lower band carries the whole opening of 1831, including an eighth Palman child.*

**So «every entry read» was not true of this row and the flag is set to false.** *The surname findings above stand — they were read and cited frame by frame — but* ***the nils in this row cover only the part of each page that was cropped***, *and a nil over part of a page is not a nil.* **[The correction is published](/corrections/)**, *and the lower bands are being read now; this row will be replaced by one that names what was actually covered.*

ev: A second set of these registers left the parish every year
The truncated crop, and the deanery seat withdrawn
rows.got:
**The strip this archive had been throwing away held the most useful thing on the film.**

**⭐⭐ A SECOND SET OF THESE REGISTERS LEFT THE PARISH EVERY YEAR.** *Foot of folio 98 (M01069111), ruled across the page beneath the last baptism of 1835:* **«Quae copiae collationatae anni 1835 concordant cum hoc originali libro. Ex officio Decanatus, Petinae die 7 Maij 1836.»** ***The parish copied each year's entries; the dean collated the copy against the original and certified that the two agreed.*** **So a certified duplicate went out of Gologorica annually and the film holds the one that stayed.** *[What that is worth — and the long list of what is not known about it — is on the page](/gologorica-line/) and in [worklist 178](/worklist/). **It bears directly on [the first errand](/errands/)**: if Gračišće sent copies to the same deanery, there is a second route to the entries on the reel the family does not hold.*

**⭐ THREE DEFRANCESCHI BAPTISMS WERE IN THE STRIP.** **[Joannes Baptista Defranceschi](/who/joannes-baptista-defranceschi/)**, *«n. 19 huj.», baptised* **21 June 1842**, *house 5, of Antonius and Francisca; godfather* **Antonius Sestan**, *who married [Joanna née Defranceschi](/who/joanna-defranceschi-sestan/) eight months later.* **The pedigree's date is confirmed to the day** *and the row had an empty note.*

**⭐ FIVE ATTESTATIONS OF A KRBUNE PRIEST**, *one of them named —* **«Franciscus Xaverius, Parochus Cherbunensis»** *(1832),* **«Josephus Dekalice, Administrator parochialis Cherbunes»** *(1848), and three more in 1841, 1842 and 1858.* ***Krbune had a parish priest of its own for at least twenty-six years***, *which settles [worklist 168](/worklist/)'s worry that its single volume might be a fragment.*

**⚠ AND A CORRECTION THE STRIP FORCED.** *A certificate of 15 March 1849 reads* **«Vidi. PIZINAE»** — ***Pazin***, *not the* «Petinae» *of the five this archive had read.* **[The claim that the deanery was «still seated at Pićan» is withdrawn](/corrections/)**; *both towns are now named on [worklist 169](/worklist/) and neither is preferred.*

**Also recovered:** *an* **eighth** *and* **ninth** *Palman child (1831, 1838); the bynames* «Zabar **alias** Baron» *and* «Udovicich **alias** Gospod», *which make [«Grah · Missan»](/worklist/) likelier to be a byname than a place; and about seventy entries of ordinary village baptisms that the day's nils had been silently excluding.*

**NIL in the recovered strip, in the exact terms tried** — **Defranceschi · De Franceschi · Defrancesco · Franceschi · Francesco · Franceschini · Salamon · Salomon · Peschle · Pesle**, *Latin and Italian, every column of every band read* — ***except the one Joannes Baptista entry above***. *The surname is in none of the rest.

**⭐ TWO MORE CHILDREN, both from folio 112 (M01069126) and both invisible to the day's crop:**

*«Decbris 28ᵃ · domus* **6** *·* **FRANCISCUS** *natus* **heri**» — ***[Franciscus Defranceschi, born 27 December 1851](/person/franciscus-defranceschi-1850/)***, *son of Antonius and Francisca, where the pedigree had* «about 1850». *And this archive held him twice: a MyHeritage row with the register's own year and a death of 1884 is now marked* `sameAs` *the pedigree row.*

*«8bris 29ᵃ · domus* **9** *·* **FLORENTIUS** *natus* **heri**», *with* **«† 10/VIII 1920»** — ***a tenth child for [Sancta Alexandra](/who/sancta-alexandra-defranceschi-sestan/)***, *born 28 October 1851. **He is the clearest single reason the correction was worth making**: a child of the archive's own line, in a book it had walked, in the band it was throwing away.*

**⚠ THE EXTENT IS NOW ESTABLISHED RATHER THAN ASSUMED.** *Every lower band from M01069102 to M01069138 was rendered and read.* ***The truncation bit on folios 81–113 (M01069102–M01069127), where the pages are long; from folio 114 (M01069128) on, the pages are shorter and the original crop reached the foot.*** *That was checked frame by frame — [the ink-coverage proxy tried first was useless](/corrections/), scoring the one frame that proved the fault lower than frames that had nothing below the line.*

ev: A Caesar Peschle is born, and an army doctor stops being a stranger
The Peschle, and the man the army lists carried
rows.got:
**A man this archive could not place for weeks now has a cradle.**

**⭐ «REMIGIUS CÆSAR natus 1 Oct.», 9 October 1864, Gologorica house 4** — *son of* **«Albertus Peschle, Doctor medicinæ»** *and* **«Victoria nata Calligarich»**; *godparents* **«Luigi De Franceschi»** *and* «Celestina V.da Calligarich»; *conditio* **«industriante»**.

*[The Peschle page](/married-in/peschle/) has carried* **Dr Cäsar Peschle**, *K.K. Landwehr medical officer commissioned 1 August 1895 and still on the lists in 1918 — fifty-one Hungaricana hits — under the sentence* **«Nothing joins him to Lambertina.»** ***Four things now agree at once***: *surname, an uncommon given name, the profession already in the household, and the age —* **born October 1864, he is just under thirty-one at that commission**, *exactly when an* Assistenzarzt *is commissioned.* **⚠ (inf) — the army lists give rank and regiment, no birthplace, and neither record names the other.** *It also changes what the Gorizia coincidence is worth: a coincidence between two strangers is worth less than one between a man and his mother's family's village.*

**⭐ AMALIA LAMBERTINA DEFRANCESCHI**, *«nata 14 Dic. 1863», baptised 20 December, house* **7**, *of* «Franciscus X. Defranceschi, **poss.**» *and* «Clotilde n. Ortis»; *godparents* **Raimondo** *and* **Marietta Baxa**, *cives.* **The pedigree already had 14 December 1863 from the 1894 census and the register agrees to the day** — *verification; the baptism, house and godparents are new.* **⚠ The figure first read as 19**; *cut past the cell it is an open-topped* **4** *against the closed-loop* **9** *of the entry number on the same line.* ***The fourth reading this rule has corrected today.***

**⭐ «Luigi De Franceschi» stands godfather** — *Luigi is Aloysius, and [Aloysius Defranceschi](/who/aloysius-defranceschi/) (1832–1870) was thirty-two in 1864.* **(inf.)**

**And «Grah-Missan» twice more, both hyphenated** — *«Marianna n. Grah-Missan» and «Rosa Grah-Missan» (M01069140), which makes [the compound a byname rather than a place](/worklist/) far likelier than the first sighting did.*

**NIL on Salamon, in the exact terms tried**, *across both frames and both halves.*

ev: A child published as a son is a daughter
Beatrix Hermengildis, under the id her error minted
rows.got:
**A child this archive published as a son is a daughter, and the correction joins two rows that were each half right.**

**⭐ «1865 Aprilis 23ᵗⁱᵃ · domus 7 · BEATRIX HERMENGILDIS n. 10 Apr.»**, *of* «**Franciscus Defranceschi, Possidens**» *and* «**Clotilde n. Ortis**»; *godparents* «Luigi Ortis» *and* «Ermina Marina», **cives**; *midwife* «Joanna Crismanich». ***The* Sexus *column marks her female.***

*The pedigree carried* **«Hermenegildus Defranceschi, 1865»**, *a son.* ***The date it held was right; the name and the sex were not.*** **And a second row** — `beatrix-hermenegildis-de-franceschi-1865`, *off David's live MyHeritage tree — had* **the right name**, *no place and the line* «unplaced». *Between them the register settles both: marked* `sameAs`, *neither id moved, and the MyHeritage row leaves «unplaced» for the carnia line.* **[Correction published](/corrections/).**

**⚠ The birth day was read twice.** *«n. 1—. Apr.» read as* **18** *at page scale; cut past the cell the second figure is an open oval with no crossing stroke —* **10**. *Baptised thirteen days later.*

**NIL otherwise, in the exact terms tried** — **Defranceschi · De Franceschi · Franceschi · Francesco · Salamon · Salomon · Peschle · Pesle · Grah**, *both halves of both frames, every column.* *Beyond Beatrix Hermengildis the surname appears only as* «Franciscus Palman, sutor», *fathering a child by* **Maria n. Udovicich** *in August 1865 — a second wife, where the Palman of 1825–1841 had* **Antonia n. Brusich**. *Recorded, not pursued.*

*Two more deanery visitations: Petinae,* **13 January 1865** *and* **11 February 1864**, *both* **Coverlizza, Decanus**.

ev: Twins, and the register says which came first
The younger twin, named for her aunt
rows.got:
**The pedigree has had two daughters of this marriage born on the same day since the tree was imported, and said nothing about it. The register settles it in three words.**

**⭐ «1868 Maji 31ma · domus 7 · MARIA HENRICA die 5 A[prilis] PRIUS NATA»** *and, immediately beneath,* **«CLOTILDIS ADELAIDIS die 5 Aprilis nata»**, *both of* «Franciscus Defranceschi, **possidens**» *and* «Clotildis nata Ortis», *midwife* «Matthæa Stojsich». ***Prius nata — born earlier. They are twins, born 5 April 1868, and the register marks the order.*** *Two rows with one date is as likely to be a copying error as a twin birth, and [this archive has found plenty of the first kind today](/corrections/).*

**⚠ Born 5 April, baptised 31 May — fifty-six days**, *the longest gap this family shows. Maria Henrica's entry adds* «praesentata», *the word for a child baptised privately at birth and later brought for the ceremonies. That one word is offered, not leaned on.*

**⭐ AND EACH TWIN IS NAMED FOR HER GODPARENT.** *Maria* **HENRICA** *has* «**Henricus Defranceschi**» *for godfather; Clotildis* **ADELAIDIS** *has* «**Henricus Defranceschi**» *and* «**ADELAIDIS DEFRANCESCHI**», *the pair entered* **possidentes**. ***Those are [the brother and sister of the «et soror» entries](/gologorica-line/)*** — *and [Adelaidis was «unplaced» in this archive until this afternoon](/who/adelaidis-defranceschi/).* **A woman chosen as godmother at about forty-four with a niece named after her in the same entry is a person with a life in this village**, *not a name that drifted into a pedigree. [Worklist 175](/worklist/) is not answered and is now harder to dissolve.*

**⭐ A FOURTH DEAN.** *The visitation of* **8 January 1867** *is signed* **«Jac. Stari—, Decanus»**, *not Coverlizza, and he signs again on 17 January 1868.* ***Coverlizza's run stands at 1838–1865.*** **⚠ The new surname is not published** — *it begins* Stari- *and the ending will not resolve.*

**Also:** *Franciscus and Clotilde stand godparents together in 1867, entered* **possidentes**; *a Palman child whose father is now* **agricola** *where he was* sutor *and* artifex; *and «Maria Flegar-**Sidre**» hyphenated, like [«Grah-Missan»](/worklist/).

**NIL on Salamon and Peschle, in the exact terms tried**, *across all five frames and both halves.*

ev: Dr Albertus Peschle at a Defranceschi font
rows.got:
**A nine-year error in the pedigree, caught by one digit — and the village doctor standing at a Defranceschi font.**

**⭐ «1869 Decemb. 5ta · domus 7 · ROBERTUS FRANCISCUS JOSEPHUS die 21 Nov. natus · † 6/8 1934»**, *of* «Franc. Defranceschi, **possidens**» *and* «Clotildis nata Ortis». ***Born 21 November 1869, baptised 5 December, died 6 August 1934.*** *The pedigree had* **21 November 1860** — ***the day and month exactly right and one digit of the year wrong***, *which is what makes the correction a copying slip rather than a judgement.*

**It also untangles two children this archive had both standing in 1860**: *[Anna Maria Francisca](/who/anna-maria-francisca-defranceschi/) is the 1860 birth, 28 October, confirmed by the same register in September; Robertus is 1869.* **One child in 1860 and one in 1869, not two in 1860.**

**⭐ AND HIS GODFATHER IS THE VILLAGE DOCTOR.** «**ALBERTUS PESCHLE**» *— [Dr Albertus Peschle, Doctor of Medicine](/married-in/peschle/) — with* «Maria Defranceschi», *the pair entered* **cives**. ***A Peschle married into this house in 1807; sixty-two years later a Peschle physician is still at its font.*** *Not a lead about origins — the shape of a relationship, and the reason the Peschle keep appearing in a Defranceschi archive at all.*

**Also:** *three more* «**Grah-Missan**» *entries, all hyphenated — a mother* «Rosalia nata Grah-Missan» *and a godfather* «Matthæus Grah-Missan» *— which makes [the compound a byname rather than a place](/worklist/) about as firm as a register can make it without writing* alias.

**NIL on Salamon, in the exact terms tried**, *across both halves of the frame.*

ev: A man who could not write acknowledges his son, and a Defranceschi witnesses it
The Palman P, at page scale and at magnification
rows.got:
**A Defranceschi appears in a role this archive has not seen the family in.**

**⭐ «Ego cum signo crucis signatus ANTONIUS RUP—OVIČ, agricola … declaro … esse verum me patrem hujus creaturæ ANTONII»** — *a declaration of paternity running the whole depth of the* Infans *column beside the baptism of 30 December 1870, house 26. *The witnesses:* **«JOANNES DEFRANCESCHI»** *and* **«FRANCISCUS PALMAN»**.

***«I, signed with the sign of the cross»*** *is the formula of a man who cannot write his own name.* **A man who signs with a cross needs witnesses who can, and the parish found two.** *Through ninety folios the Defranceschi of this book are* **cives** *and then* **possidentes** *— words that assert standing.* ***This is standing doing something.*** *The obvious candidate is [Joannes Baptista Defranceschi, born 19 June 1842](/who/joannes-baptista-defranceschi/), twenty-eight that year —* **(inf)**, *since the register gives no patronymic and «no other one known» is a reason to suspect rather than assert.*

**⚠ AND A READING CORRECTED, which is the fifth today.** *At page scale the entry of 4 December 1870 appeared to read* «Franciscus **Salman**». *Cut past the cell it is* **«Franciscus PALMAN»** *— the same tall closed majuscule* **P** *that [this morning's palaeographic test](/gologorica-line/) set against the Salamon* **S**. ***That the Palman P reads as an S at page scale is exactly how [the withdrawn «Salman» lead](/corrections/) happened***, *and it is worth recording that the book reproduced the trap once more today and the rule caught it.* *The child is* **Franciscus Palman, born 1 December 1870, died 16 June 1901.**

**Also:** *Clotildis Defranceschi stands godmother in November 1870; three more hyphenated* «Grah-Missan» *entries; and the visitations of* **1 January 1870** *and* **16 January 1871**, *both* «Vidi. Petinae», *both signed by the new dean* **Jac. Stari—**.

**NIL on Peschle and on Salamon-as-a-surname, in the exact terms tried**, *across both frames and both halves.*

ev: A 1920 state act names a de Franceschi born at Luincis in 1626
The slip, and what it covers
Worklist 179 — find the act, then find the book
rows.got:
**The only typewriting in a book of handwriting, and it reaches four hundred years back and out of Istria altogether.**

**⭐ A slip of typed paper is pasted across the entries of 2 and 10 July 1871:**

> «Giusta lettera del **Commissariato Gen. Civ. per la Venezia Giulia** dd **10/12 1920** N. **1x-4411/563** la grafia originale del cognome di questo battezzato è “**de Franceschi**”, ciò che risulta dalla **fede di nascita** del suo proavo **LEONARDO DE FRANCESCHI nato a LUINCIO dd. 23/6 1626**. D’Ordine del Commissariato Gen. Civ. — **Avv. Melone**»

***An Italian state office, in 1920, settling how this family’s surname is to be written — and citing a birth certificate of 1626 from Carnia as its authority.***

**⭐ AND IT IS THE RIGHT PARISH.** *[The Carnia chain](/carnia/) begins with a Leonardo dead before 1785, known only from his son’s styling; its deepest document is a certificate of 1808 written* «a parte **Luvincis**» *by the priest of the* **Pieve Matrice di Gorto**. ***The 1920 ruling cites that same parish’s Book of Baptisms, a hundred and sixty-three years earlier*** — *which also means the 1626 volume existed in 1920.*

**⚠ WHAT IT IS NOT, and this archive is holding the line on all four:** *(1) a 1920 ruling, not a 1626 record — the* fede di nascita *has not been seen; (2)* «proavo» *is loose, and 1626 to 1871 is seven or eight generations; (3) an office regularising surnames after annexation wants a spelling settled, and a settled spelling is not a proved descent; (4)* ***no generation has been added to the Carnia chain***, *and none will be until the book is read.*

**⚠ And the slip hides the entry it annotates** — *the baptism underneath cannot be read. Whose it is, as inference: the only Defranceschi child expected at Gologorica in mid-1871 is* **[Victor Richardus, born 15 June 1871](/who/victor-richardus-defranceschi/)**, *seventeen days before the 2 July entry. [The duplicate registers of worklist 178](/worklist/) would have it uncovered.*

**[Worklist 179](/worklist/) now carries two addresses instead of a hope:** *the act itself (Archivio di Stato di Trieste, by protocol number) and the Gorto baptisms at Luincis for 1626.*

**Also on the frame:** *a second paternity declaration, 12 November 1871, an illegitimate birth whose godfather is* **Antonius Defranceschi** *— and more witnesses, among them a Defranceschi name.*

ev: The man the 1920 ruling is about
A 1920 state act names a de Franceschi born at Luincis in 1626
Worklist 179 — now with a third handle on the enquiry
rows.got:
**An hour ago this archive wrote that the slip hides the entry it annotates and named the likely subject as an inference. The film had already answered it.**

**⭐ M01069152 is the same opening as M01069151 with the slip FOLDED BACK.** *Underneath:* «[domus] **7** · **VICTOR RICHARDUS die 15. Junii natus**», *of* «**Franciscus Defranceschi, possidens**» *and* «**Clotilde nata Ortis**»; *godparents* **Jodocus** *and* **Angelica Baxa**. *And in the margin of the entry, in the same hand as the slip:* **«vide … sub 30 protocoll.»** — ***a cross-reference from the register to the ruling.***

***So the 1920 Commissariato act is about [Victor Richardus Defranceschi, born 15 June 1871](/who/victor-richardus-defranceschi/)***, *forty-nine years old and newly an Italian subject.* **The inference is retired and the fact replaces it**, *within the hour.*

**⚠ AND A METHOD NOTE WORTH MORE THAN THE FACT.** *[The frame map](/gologorica-line/) records that these reels* «shoot some openings twice», *and [the coverage check](/searched/) discounts duplicate exposures as noise.* ***Here the duplicate IS the evidence***: one frame hides a baptism, the next shows it. **A second exposure of a page is not redundancy when something on that page can move** — *a pasted slip, a folded corner, a loose insert.* *Nobody walking this film should skip a repeat.*

rows.got:
**THE BOOK IS FINISHED.** *One hundred and sixty-four folios, 1784 to 1880, walked end to end — where this week began with it being sampled at every third frame.*

**⭐ IT HAS ITS OWN ALPHABETICAL INDEX, and the archive did not know.** *(M01069167.)* *Under* **D**, *two households told apart by their fathers and by a byname:*

> **«Defranceschi Joan. Bapta defuncti Josephi · N.º 5»** — *Joseph (2), Franciscus (struck), Catharina «quæ obiit» (4), Catharina Helena (6),* **Maria Rosalia** *(8), Maria Antonia (11)*
> **«Defranceschi Joanes Bapta DETTI LEONARDI · N.º 12»** — *Franciscus Antonius (3), Joanes Bapta (6)*

***«Detti Leonardi» is the byname this archive had reasoned out from elsewhere — here in the register's own hand***, *doing what a byname is for. And since the archive identifies that household as* **casa 31**, ***31 and 12 are the same door***: *[the first anchored pair for worklist 171](/worklist/).*

**⭐ CARLO DE FRANCESCHI STANDS AT THE FONT.** *«1874 Octob. 11 ·* **FRANCISCUS CAROLUS NATALIS** *die 6. Octob. natus», of* «Franciscus Defranceschi, possidens» *and* «Clotildis nata Ortis», *godparents* **«CARLO DEFRANCESCHI»** *and* «Natale Stipanich», *with* **«† Tergeste 17-2-1942»** *in the margin.* ***Six days before his own sixty-fifth birthday, and the child carries both godparents' names.*** *The archive has Carlo's writings, his letter, his book and his grave; this is the first time it has him in his own village's register doing an ordinary family thing.*

**⭐ THREE HOUSEHOLDS THE ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE:** **Aloysius Defranceschi, *mercator*** × Joanna n. Udovicic *(Elvira Gisella 1873, Ersilia 1878)*; **[Leonardus Defranceschi, *textor*](/who/leonardus-defranceschi/)** × Maria n. Flegar *at house 6 (Carola 1875, Joannes Aloysius 1876, Theresia 1879)*; *and* **Rosa née Defranceschi** × *Fortunatus Sestan (Maria Anna 1877).*

**⚠ AND THE FIRST IS A CONTRADICTION.** *This archive has [Aloysius Defranceschi dead 25 November 1870](/who/aloysius-defranceschi/).* ***A man dead in 1870 cannot father daughters in 1873 and 1878.*** *Nothing changed on his record; it is [the FOURTH death-year collision in this family](/worklist/), and the four between them make the unread burial register the most valuable thing left on either reel.*

**⭐ A circle closed.** *[Rosa, born 7 June 1848](/person/joanna-defranceschi-1848/) — renamed from the tree's «Joanna» at eight o'clock this morning — is married at the far end of the book to* **Fortunatus Sestan**, *second son of* **[Sancta Alexandra Defranceschi](/who/sancta-alexandra-defranceschi-sestan/)**, *whose empty note was filled the same morning.* **(inf.)**

**⭐ And Sancta Alexandra was the parish MIDWIFE** — *her name in the* Obstetrix *column in 1873 and 1876, at fifty-four and fifty-seven.*

**Also:** *[Sylvia Helena](/who/sylvia-helena-defranceschi/) (b. 16 Dec 1872) verified to the day; [Lambertina Lina](/who/lambertina-lina-defranceschi/) baptised 29 June 1876 with* **no birth year written**, *left unresolved; a second, handwritten copy of [the 1920 Commissariato ruling](/carnia/) signed* **«Avv. Mellone»**; *a bishop's canonical visitation of 7 July 1876; and the priest handover when Blasius Zwölber stops writing in 1879 — the census gives his death as 22 May 1879 and the register brackets it, as it did for Milcetich in 1862.*

**NIL on Salamon across the whole stretch, in the exact terms tried.** *The sweep [worklist 174](/worklist/) asked for has now covered folios 105 to the end; folios 1–104 still need the second pass.*

rows.got:
**The book has an index, as the baptism book does. The index names the pages. The first two pages it pointed at settled the two oldest questions on the Gologorica page.**

**⭐ «1821. Die 30ma Januarii hora ½ 4ta a meridie · domus 104 · CLEMENTINA FILIA D.ni JOSEPHI DEFRANCESCHI · *dierum 2 et horarum 11½* · Imperfecta Structura»**, *buried 1 February 1821 (p. 62).* ***Her baptism has her born 28 January 1821 at four in the morning at the same house. The arithmetic closes to the hour.*** **[The name-reuse this archive inferred on 1 October is now a document](/corrections/)**, *and the 1870 death this roster carried for her is withdrawn — removed rather than moved, because [the dispute over her sister](/corrections/) is still open.* **It also settles the godmother of February 1840: there is only one Clementina left.**

**⭐ «1817. Die 19 Xbris · domus 17 · MAXIMILIANUS JOSEPH DEFRANCESCHI, D.ni Josephi filius · *annorum 4* · Vermes et Phthisis cum febri maligna»**, *buried the next day at sunset* «ob signa putrefactionis» *(p. 58).* ***A son this archive did not have, born about 1813***, *in a gap the pedigree had empty — and* ***eleven years before [the Maximilianus Antonius born 8 January 1828](/who/maximilianus-antonius-josephus-defranceschi/).*** **So this family reused TWO names, not one**, *which stops being an inference about what families did and becomes their documented habit.*

**THE INDEX IS A MAP OF THE REST.** *Under* «Defranceschi **Joseph · N.º 17**» *it lists fourteen deaths with pages, among them* **«R.dus Joan: Mathias, ex Parochus» (15)** — *a Defranceschi who had been parish priest —* **«D.na Helena, vidua q. Josephi» (25)**, **«D.nus Joan: Bapta q. Josephi» (39)** *and* **«Amalia, filia Josephi» (67)**. *Two more households follow:* «Joanes Bapta **detti Leonardi** · N.º 12» *and* «**Leonardus** · N.º 10».

**⚠ `walked` is FALSE and deliberately.** *Four frames of ninety-one have been opened. The index has been read and the book has not.*

rows.got:
**⭐ A DEFRANCESCHI HELD THE CURE OF GRAČIŠĆE.** *«Idem · domus 63 · 29 Martij [1798] ·* ***admodum R.dus D.nus MATH. DE FRANCESCHI, ex Parocho GALLEGNA[nensi]*** *· annorum 62 · Paralisia» (p. 15).* **Gallignana is [Gračišće](/the-eleven/)** — *not a neighbouring parish picked at random but this line's own second home, the parish [Francisca](/person/francisca-defranceschi-1819/) and [Joanna](/who/joanna-defranceschi-sestan/) came out of, whose registers are on the one reel the family does not hold.* ***He died at Gologorica aged sixty-two, of a stroke; born about 1736.*** **This archive held him as a row with no dates and the single word «Don».**

**⚠ His parents are not established.** *The entry gives age and office and no father; the index files him under* «Defranceschi Joseph · N.º 17» *— and an index is a clerk's filing decision, not a statement of descent. No parent is attached on the strength of it.*

**⭐ DOMINA HELENA, widow of the late Josephus Defranceschi**, *died* **26 August 1804, aged 84**, *of a malignant fever, house 36 (p. 25).* ***That puts her birth about 1720; this archive carries her as 1725–1809.*** **⚠ A fifth open date collision — and the first this book has MADE rather than closed.** *Unlike the other four it is a contemporary parish entry against a published archive date. [Nothing changed yet](/worklist/): four frames into ninety-one, and the dates should move together when the book is done.*

**⭐ AND THE DEAN SIGNED EVERY BOOK ON ONE VISIT.** *«Revisus in Visitatione Decanali die* **17ma Julii 1804** *— M. Franciscus Franovich … Decanus» stands on page 25 of the deaths — the same inspection, date and dean [already found in the baptism register](/worklist/).* ***So a visitation signed off the parish's registers together***, *which means a protocol of 1804 should account for baptisms, marriages and deaths rather than one series.*

*Pages 17–18 (1798–1800) read in full: no Defranceschi.*

ev: The French took the registers, and the priest wrote down what that cost him
Worklist 181 — the French civil registers of Pazin, 1812–1814
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ FOR EIGHTEEN MONTHS THIS PARISH DID NOT HAVE ITS OWN REGISTERS.** *Ruled across page 38 between two deaths of 1812, in the parish priest's hand:*

> «N.B. Hic Liber cum aliis ex justa ordinationem regiminis **GALLICI** consignatus fuit **MUNICIPALITATI PISINENSI** die **20ma Julii 1812**, et die **5ta Januarii 1814** fuere restituti ab Administratione Dominali; quamobrem Mortuorum eorum Nomina, qui per hoc intervallum obierunt, fideliter ex more solito **hic retuli**: ego idem Parochus **Mocovich** qui supra.»

*Istria was inside Napoleon's* **Illyrian Provinces**, *and the French took registration off the church and gave it to the commune. The books went to Pazin on 20 July 1812 and came back on 5 January 1814.*

**⚠ SO EVERY GOLOGORICA DATE FROM JULY 1812 TO JANUARY 1814 IS RETROSPECTIVE.** *The priest says it himself —* «hic retuli», *I have entered them here afterwards.* ***He is flagging it, not hiding it***, *which is more than most registers do; but an entry written up eighteen months later is not an entry made on the day, and this archive should say so wherever it cites one.*

**⭐ AND IT NAMES A RECORD SERIES NOBODY HAS ASKED FOR.** *If the commune held registration, the commune registered.* ***French civil registers of the Municipality of Pazin, 1812–1814***, *should exist and would be the only contemporary record of that window.* **[Worklist 181](/worklist/) carries it**, *with the note that Napoleonic registers are usually catalogued under the French administration rather than the parish — which is why a search by parish name has never found them.*

**⭐ AND A NIL, RECORDED BY A PRIEST IN 1812:** «N.B. A die **10ma Julii usque ad 19am Augusti exclusive nemo obiit in hac Parochia**» — *from 10 July to 19 August exclusive nobody died in this parish.* ***He wrote down an absence with its exact bounds so nobody would mistake a silent page for a lost one.*** *[It is the rule this archive works to](/method/), two hundred and fourteen years early.*

**⭐ AMALIA DE FRANCESCHI, eight months old.** *«Die 22 Xbris 1826 · domus 17 · AMALIA DE FRANCESCHI, filia Josephi · 8 Men[ses] · febres gastricæ, mali[gnæ]», buried the 24th (p. 67).* ***The pedigree carried her with neither birth nor death.*** *Born about April 1826.* **And she takes a strand out of [worklist 175](/worklist/): having died an infant she cannot be the Adelaidis of 1847, 1852 and 1868, so four names round that household become three.**

rows.got:
**⭐ A DEFRANCESCHI WAS PARISH PRIEST OF GOLOGORICA.** *The* **Sepeliens** *column — who performed the burial — reads at the head of* **1787**: «[Defran]**ceschi, P[aro]chus Loci**», *with* «Idem» *running down the page beneath. (M01069230, p. 5.)* ***Not a visiting priest borrowed for a day: the parish priest of the place, burying his own village.*** *Taken with [page 15](/gologorica-line/), where* «admodum R.dus D.nus **MATH. DE FRANCESCHI, ex Parocho GALLEGNA[nensi]**» *is buried in 1798 aged sixty-two,* **a priest of this surname held both Gologorica and Gallignana — which is [Gračišće](/the-eleven/)**. **⚠ One man or two is not settled**: *the index names only one Defranceschi priest, which favours one man with two cures and does not prove it.*

**⭐ D.NUS JOANNES BAPTA DEFRANCESCHI, VIDUUS**, *son of the late Josephus — died* **23 January 1813**, *aged* **60**, *of* **phthisis**, *at house* **17**, *and was buried by* **Martinus Sestan, parish priest of NOVAKI**, «de licentia mea parochi presentis». *(M01069248, p. 39.)* *This archive held the date already and the note* «Dominus» *and nothing else:* **verification, plus the cause, the age, the widowhood, the house and the officiant.**

**⚠ AND A TRAP, RECORDED.** *Three rows below him:* **«Josephus DE-PRATO, cœlebs, defuncti Joannis Baptæ filius»**, *a student of twenty-five dead of consumption in the same March.* ***At page scale the surname broken across a line reads as a Defranceschi*** — *and a man of that age, styled son of the late Joannes Baptista, dying two months after Joannes Baptista Defranceschi, is exactly what one would want him to be.* **He is a Deprato.** *Cut past the cell and the break is plain.*

**⚠ A reading corrected before publishing**: *the death day read as* **25** *at page scale and is* **23**, *which is what the pedigree already held.*

*Pages 6 (1788), 17–18 (1798–1800) and 40 (1814) read in full for the surname in every column: no further Defranceschi.*

ev: The Jablich wife, with dates at last
A woman the archive had no row for
rows.got:
**Three Defranceschi deaths inside eighteen months, all at house 36, and between them they turn a line in a pedigree into a sequence.**

| when | who | age | cause | buried by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **16 July 1791** | **Maria Antonia Defranceschi** | ***six months*** | *vermes* | «Defranceschi, Parochus» |
| **26 April 1792** | **Sancta Defranceschi, *cœlebs*** | **58** | *febris putrida* | **Joh. Marinich, Canon of GALLIGNANA** |
| **21 May 1792** | **Catharina Defranceschi** | **26** | *apoplexia* | **Petrus Anicich, priest of NOVAKI** |

**⭐ CATHARINA IS THE JABLICH OF BUCCARI, AND SHE HAD NO DATES AT ALL.** *[This archive knew her](/married-in/) from one line of the baptism book — «Cath. ejus uxor nata JABLICH ex BUCCARI», godmother in 1786 — and nothing else.* ***Dead 21 May 1792 aged twenty-six, of apoplexy. Born about 1766***, *so twenty at that font and twenty-six when she was carried out.*

**⭐ And ten months earlier the same house buried her daughter at six months old**, *which confirms [the 1791 birth year this archive carried off the tree](/who/maria-antonia-defranceschi/) and supplies the death it did not have.*

***So [Joannes Baptista Defranceschi](/person/joannes-baptista-defranceschi-1752/) buried a daughter of six months in July 1791 and his wife of twenty-six in May 1792, did not remarry, and died a widower in January 1813.*** *The pedigree had the two ends and nothing between them.*

**⭐ AND A WOMAN WITH NO ROW ANYWHERE.** **«SANCTA DEFRANCESCHI, CŒLEBS, annorum 58»** — *unmarried, born about 1734, dead four weeks before Catharina in the same house.* **A row is minted for her**; *no parents are attached, and the guess that she is of [Josephus's](/person/josephus-defranceschi-1722/) generation is written as a guess.*

**⚠ GRAČIŠĆE AT THE GRAVESIDE AGAIN.** *Sancta was buried by a* **Canon of Gallignana** *— the second churchman of that parish over this family inside a decade, after [the Defranceschi priest styled «ex Parocho Gallignanensi»](/gologorica-line/).* ***A pattern, not yet a reason.***

*And a small tie: Catharina's priest,* **Petrus Anicich of Novaki**, *is [the «Petrus Anicich» who signs this parish's visitation as DEAN in 1808](/worklist/) — a village priest in 1792, a rural dean sixteen years later.*

rows.got:
**⚠⚠ THERE IS A SECOND «De—» FAMILY AT GOLOGORICA WITH THE SAME GIVEN NAMES.** *The death book's index carries, one block below the Defranceschi,* «**DEPRATO Leonardus · N.º 6**» — *and the two households share* ***a Joannes Baptista, a Catharina wife of Joannes Baptista, a Reverend former parish priest, a widow, and a Josephus son of the late Joannes Baptista.*** **Both of the last two are on page 39**, *which is the page [this archive read yesterday](/gologorica-line/) and where it nearly wrote a Deprato student into the roster as a Defranceschi.* ***Both surnames begin «De—» and break across lines, and at page scale the second reads as the first.*** **[Worklist 183](/worklist/) carries the rule and the re-check.**

**⭐ CATHARINA DEFRANCESCHI, ELEVEN DAYS OLD** — *«12 Martij 1786 · domus 36 · dier. 11 · Debilitas».* ***The first of three that house buried in six years***, *before [Maria Antonia at six months in 1791](/who/maria-antonia-defranceschi/) and [her mother at twenty-six in 1792](/who/catharina-defranceschi-jablich/). A row is minted; her parents are inferred from the index and the house and are flagged as inferred.*

**⭐ MARIANA DEFRANCESCHI, TEN, OF DYSENTERY** — *«4 8bris 1786 ·* **domus 31** *· annorum 10».* *The index files her under* «detti Leonardi · **N.º 12**». ***So casa 31 ↔ index N.º 12, confirmed independently by the death book after the baptism book's index said the same yesterday.*** **Two books, two indexes, one pair** — *[worklist 171](/worklist/) now has its firmest result.*

**⚠ And a small self-correction**: *the officiant column shows* «Defrances[chi] Pbr Loci» *heading the year* **1786**, *not 1787 as this archive wrote yesterday. The Defranceschi priest was burying this parish a year earlier than published.*

rows.got:
**No Defranceschi death on these pages — and that is the finding, because at page scale there appears to be one.**

**⭐ «Defrances[chi] · domus 84 · 10 Augusti 1788 · ANTONIO DE-FRANICH · annorum 70 · febris putrida».** *At page scale it reads as one of ours: an Antonio of seventy, in the family's own parish, surname broken after* «De». ***Cut past the line break and the second syllable is*** «franich» ***— a third family.*** **No row minted, nothing entered.**

**⚠ SO THERE ARE AT LEAST THREE «De—» FAMILIES IN THIS VILLAGE**, *and the officiant column of the same page shows two of them working side by side:* «**DEFRANCES[CHI]**, Presbyter Loci» *and* «**D. JOSEPH: DEPRATO**, ex Parochus» *— alternating down the column, with the* **Defranich** *in the entries beneath.* *[The rule](/worklist/) goes from two surnames to three: at Gologorica a* «De—» *surname may be* **Defranceschi**, **Deprato** *or* **Defranich**.

**✔ AND THE BACKLOG WAS STARTED RATHER THAN DECLARED.** *Two entries published yesterday had been read at the first syllable only.* ***Both re-cropped past the break; both hold:*** «Maria Anton: **Defranceschi**» *(p. 11, written out in full on one line) and* «D.na Hellena, Vid. q. Joseph: **Defran-ceschi** ex Loco» *(p. 25).* **Neither needed a correction.** *The point of checking is that this archive could not have known that without looking, and it had already been wrong once this week.*

**NIL, in the exact terms tried.** *Pages 7–8 read entry by entry and officiant by officiant for* **Defranceschi · De Franceschi · Defrancesco · Franceschi**, *every column.* ***The surname appears on the page only as the officiating priest, never as a decedent.***
